name: Peeling Basement Drywall & Egg-Carton Soundproofing
note: Old grey drywall with a taped seam, mudded screw heads, a brown water stain and a patch where the paint is peeling off. Two charcoal egg-crate foam panels are glued on as DIY soundproofing (one a little crooked).

name: Wrinkled Bedsheet Projector Screen Tacked to Wall
Crate Table
note: Two blue milk crates turned upside down with a crooked plywood board on top. A pizza box, a can of soda and a crumpled napkin sit on it.

name: Torn Paper Movie Poster with Scotch Tape
note: A sun-faded "Space Squish" B-movie poster with fold creases, wrinkles and a torn-off bottom corner, held up with yellowed scotch tape. The top corner has come loose, folded over, and flutters in the draft.

name: Cracked Concrete Floor with Duct-Tape Cables
note: Bare grey concrete with saw-cut joints, a long crack with a chipped edge, an old oil stain and paint specks. A black cable and an orange extension cord snake across it, held down with strips of silver duct tape.

name: Hand-Me-Down VHS Player & Boxy Mini Projector
note: A chunky old VHS deck with its clock stuck blinking 12:00, a boxy beige mini projector on top with a hand-written "MOM'S" sticker, all stacked on a FRAGILE moving box. Two labelled tapes lie beside it and the cable trails off to the wall.

name: TV Tray
note: A mustard folding TV tray with flower prints on gold legs, holding a TV dinner: mashed potato, peas, nuggets and a fork.

name: Candy & 3D Glasses
note: An open box of colourful candy with its lid flipped up (a few pieces spilled) and a pair of red-and-blue 3D glasses.

name: Exposed Basement Pipes & Cobweb Rafters
note: Bare wooden joists under rough subfloor boards, a grey drain pipe and a copper water line on metal straps, a stapled wire sagging between the joists, and dusty cobwebs in the corners. A tiny spider bobs on its thread.

name: Buzzing PC Desktop Speakers
note: Two yellowed beige PC speakers propped up on old phone books, toed in toward the sofa: little tweeters, a volume knob with a green power light and a peeling MEGA BASS sticker. Every few seconds the right one buzzes and shakes. Tap it to play music: the cones pump.

name: Compact Graphite Microwave on an Oak Stool
note: A modern compact microwave: graphite body, flush black-glass door, touch strip with a glowing timer, on a round oak stool. Popcorn puffs up inside.

name: Old Futon
note: A saggy blue futon on a pine slat frame: the mattress dips in the middle, a plaid patch covers a hole, a mustard blanket is crumpled on one end and an old striped pillow slumps on the other. Duct tape holds one leg together.

name: Styrofoam Cooler with Ice Packs
playS: Lid open · ice cold · tap to close
note: A beaded white styrofoam cooler with molded bands, hand grips and a fitted lid. Tap it: the lid swings back onto its hinge edge, showing cans of soda buried in ice with two blue gel ice packs, and cold mist rolls out. Tap again to close it.

name: Bare Pull-Chain Utility Bulb
note: A clear utility bulb in a porcelain socket on a short cloth cord, with a glowing filament and a little pull chain. It sways gently, the chain swings and the light flickers now and then.

name: Camp Chair
note: A green folding camp chair on a black steel X frame, with canvas arms and a mesh cup holder holding a can of soda.

name: Brick Shelf
note: Grey cinder blocks and pine boards stacked into a shelf, full of VHS tapes (one has tipped over), a plant in a tin can, a SQUISH tape box and an old tape player.

name: Paper Lantern String Lights
note: A drooping cord of seven ribbed paper lanterns in soft pastel colours, hung from two wall hooks. Each one glows from inside, flickers a little and sways on its own.

name: Popcorn Box Bed
note: A giant red-and-white popcorn box turned into a pet bed: the front is cut low to climb in, a fluffy cushion fills the bottom and a few popcorn pieces are scattered around.

name: Frayed Braided Rag Rug
note: An oval rag rug braided from strips of old fabric in red, mustard, denim, green, cream and plum. The edge is frayed, and one loose strand sticks out and sways.

name: Matte Charcoal Cinema Paint Walls
note: Walls rolled in a deep matte charcoal that swallows stray light. You can see the fine roller stipple and soft lap marks up close.

name: 42-Inch Thrifted Plasma TV on Brackets
note: A thick 42-inch piano-black plasma with a silver speaker strip, perforated grilles, a red standby light and a glossy glass screen. It hangs on a steel tilt bracket (rails and safety knobs peek out underneath) with its power cable dangling down the wall.

name: Snack Table
note: A white coffee table whose oak top lifts up and back toward the sofa on chrome scissor arms, opening a storage well packed with movies. A bowl of chips, a soda and the remote wait on the raised top.

name: Framed Retro Sci-Fi Poster Trio
note: Three retro sci-fi posters (Rocket Rangers, Saucer Summer, Robo Pal) in satin black frames with cream bevel-cut mats and glass that catches the light. They are printed in faded halftone inks.

name: Low-Pile Gray Commercial Carpet Tiles
note: Low-pile grey carpet squares laid with the pile turned every other way, a worn path down the middle, one bluer replacement tile and a corner that has started to curl up.

name: 1080p Digital Home Projector on Ceiling Mount
note: A satin-white 1080p home projector hanging from a telescoping chrome ceiling pole on a spider cradle. Coated glass lens with focus ring, exhaust louvres, a control pad on top and a blinking status light.

name: Popcorn Bucket
note: A red-and-white striped bucket overflowing with buttery popcorn, with a few pieces dropped and two ticket stubs.

name: Drop-Tile Acoustic Foam Ceiling
note: A light grey T-bar grid holding charcoal acoustic foam tiles that soak up sound. One tile has been knocked a little askew and there is a return-air grille in the back row.

name: 2.1 Bluetooth Soundbar & Mini Woofer
note: A fabric-wrapped 2.1 soundbar with top touch buttons and a row of status lights, plus a compact black subwoofer with an exposed driver and bass port. Tap it to play music: the woofer cone pumps and the lights dance.

name: Countertop Hot-Air Popcorn Popper
note: A red-and-white hot-air popper with a clear amber chute, a yellow butter cup on top and an ON/OFF rocker. Kernels whirl inside the chute and fluffy popcorn shoots out into a red bowl heaped with popcorn.

name: Comfy Couch
note: A big puffy 3-seat couch on wooden legs: rolled arms, three fat seat cushions and three back cushions, two throw pillows, a striped knit throw folded over one arm and the TV remote on the other. Pick a colour.

name: 6-Can Mini Thermoelectric Soda Fridge
playS: Door open · cold light on · tap to close
note: A glossy mint 6-can thermoelectric mini fridge with a recessed handle and a blue 4°C display. Tap it: the door swings open on its hinge to show two rows of three cans on a wire shelf, a spinning cooling fan and a cool blue glow. Tap again to close it.

name: Dimmer-Switch Track Spotlight Bar
note: A black ceiling track on two rods with four spot cans. The cans pan slowly and their warm beams dim up and down like someone is playing with the dimmer.

name: Beanbag
note: A big slouchy corduroy beanbag with a deep dent to sink into, a soft lump behind to lean on, a stitched seam round the bottom and a little tag. Pick a colour.

name: DVD Tower
note: A tall wire tower with four round racks of colourful DVDs all the way round, topped with a red knob.

name: Retro Neon 'Now Showing' Wall Sign
note: Glass neon tubes on a black backer with chrome standoffs: pink NOW over cyan SHOWING inside an amber border, with chasing arrows. The NOW tube flickers now and then, and the whole sign glows on the wall.

name: Film-Strip Printed Nylon Runner
note: A long black nylon runner printed like a film strip: sprocket holes along both edges and eight frames telling a tiny story about a bouncing Squish, ending with THE END. A soft sheen slides across the nylon.

name: 85-Inch 4K QLED Flatscreen Display
note: A razor-thin 85-inch QLED with a brushed-metal edge and a deep black glass screen that mirrors the room. An ambient backlight glows on the wall behind it, slowly drifting through blue, violet, pink, amber and teal.

name: Glass Coffee Table
note: A black steel table with a smoked glass top and a glass shelf underneath holding movie cases and a game controller. A candy bowl, a little plant and two coasters on top.

name: Backlit Marquee Lightbox Poster Frame
note: A black marquee lightbox with a NOW PLAYING header and a backlit "Moonlit Matinee" poster behind acrylic. A ring of warm bulbs chases around the frame.

name: Plush Crimson Cinema Carpet with Aisle Strips
note: Plush crimson cinema carpet with a gold diamond pattern. Two aisle strips run toward the screen, with little amber lights that chase forward like in a real theatre.

name: 4K Ultra-Short-Throw Laser Projector
note: A satin-white ultra-short-throw laser projector that sits right under the screen: charcoal fabric speaker front, glossy laser window on top with a soft light inside, touch buttons, a breathing status light and its remote beside it.

name: Brass Side Table
note: A brass C-shaped side table that slides under the sofa, with a round walnut top, a cola on ice and a bowl of popcorn.

name: Director Kit
note: A movie clapperboard (SCENE 1, TAKE 3) that keeps snapping shut with a clap, next to a red director megaphone.

name: Coffered Dark Wood Cinema Ceiling
note: Deep coffers framed by dark walnut beams, each lined in burgundy to match the velvet walls, with a gold rosette at every crossing and a warm pin light glowing in each coffer.

name: 5.1 Surround Sound Bookshelf Speaker Kit
note: A walnut 5.1 kit: two bookshelf speakers on steel stands, two surround speakers on taller stands, a centre speaker and a black 10-inch subwoofer. Every driver has a real cone, surround and dust cap. Tap it to play music: all the cones pump to the beat.

name: Vintage Red Cart Kettle-Corn Machine
playS: Kettle stirring · corn popping… tap to stop
note: A glossy red kettle-corn cart with spoked wagon wheels, a push handle, pinstriped panels, a striped awning and a glass cabinet piled with popcorn. Tap it: the heat lamp glows, the steel kettle rocks and popcorn flies out into the cabinet.

name: Leather Loveseat
note: A cognac leather 2-seater with a tall rolled back and two thick diamond-tufted back cushions (pillowy diamonds with buttons in the dimples), plump seat cushions and padded arms with glowing cup holders. Sits on a black plinth with a warm light strip underneath.

name: Glass-Front Retro Cola Mini-Fridge
playS: Door open · ice cold · tap to close
note: A glossy red retro mini-fridge on chrome legs with an "Ice Cold COLA" door, a chrome-framed glass window and a chrome bar handle. Inside you can see glass cola bottles on wire shelves and cans below. Tap it: the door swings open and cold mist rolls out. Tap again to close it.

name: Art Deco Frosted Glass Ceiling Flush-Mount
note: An Art Deco flush-mount: a brass canopy with three stepped frosted-glass tiers, fluted lines and brass bands, glowing softly and lighting the ceiling around it.

name: Velvet Swivel Chair
note: A round velvet scallop chair: puffy channel tufts wrap round a deep button cushion, tall at the back and curving down into the arms, on a brass swivel base. Pick a colour.

name: Wood Media Console
note: A low walnut media console on splayed legs, with slatted doors, two drawers with brass pulls, and a plant, a record and a stack of movies on top.

name: Brushed Bronze Up-Down Theater Sconces
note: A pair of brushed-bronze cylinder sconces on wall plates. Each one throws a warm fan of light up the wall and another one down.

name: Thick Shag Blackout Acoustic Rug
note: A thick charcoal shag rug with deep, floppy tufts that spill over the edges. It soaks up sound and light so the room stays dark and quiet.

name: Backlit Walnut Acoustic Slat Walls
note: Vertical walnut slats with real grain over black acoustic felt. Amber LED strips behind them glow through the gaps and slowly breathe brighter and dimmer.

name: 150-Inch Motorized Drop-Down Laser Projection Screen
note: A 150-inch matte white screen hanging from a black motor housing with a blue status light, black masking borders, tab-tension side cables and a weighted bottom bar that keeps it perfectly flat.

name: Fridge Table
note: A charcoal coffee table with two lit glass fridge drawers full of cold cans (a little cold mist drifts out), a wireless charging pad with a phone that pulses, and a bowl of popcorn.

name: Signed Golden Age Prop Replica Shadowbox
note: A deep walnut shadowbox lined with green velvet: a replica silk top hat and gold-topped cane, a signed black-and-white star photo and an engraved brass plaque, under glass and a brass picture light.

name: Heated Dark Teak Hardwood with Recessed LED Guides
note: Long dark teak planks with soft grain and staggered joints, polished so the screen glow shows in them. Warm LED guide strips are set into both sides with a pulse of light running toward the screen, and the heated floor glows softly.

name: Dual-Lens Commercial 3D Digital Cinema Rig
note: A commercial dual-lens 3D cinema projector on a rolling rack: graphite head with two big coated lenses and a red/blue 3D modulator between them, a spinning cooling fan behind the side grille, a status screen, a ribbed exhaust duct, carry rails and a rack of blinking media servers below.

name: Marble Side Table
note: A white marble table on a fluted gold pedestal. Its blue glowing coaster keeps a frosty soda with ice and lemon ice-cold, with little puffs of cold rising.

name: Gold Trophy
note: A shiny gold award cup with curly handles, a film-strip band and a bevelled gold star on its lid, on a black base with a gold plate, next to a crystal decanter and a glass.

name: Fiber-Optic Twinkling Night Sky Dome
note: A navy night-sky dome full of fibre-optic stars in warm and cool white that twinkle at their own pace, a faint Milky Way, now and then a shooting star, and a walnut crown with an amber LED cove.

name: 7.2.4 Recessed Architectural Tower Array
note: Two piano-black tower speakers on brushed plinths with gold-ringed tweeters, copper cones and angled up-firing Atmos modules on top, two subwoofers and a wide centre speaker on top of them, plus a cyan floor glow. Tap it to play music: cones pump and the glow pulses.

name: Built-In Marble Concession Bar & Nacho Warmer
playS: Heat lamp on · cheese pumping… tap to stop
note: A built-in concession bar: fluted walnut front, brass CONCESSIONS band, brass footrail and kick plate, a veined white marble top, a glass nacho warmer, a cheese pump over a tray of chips, striped cup stacks, straws and three candy jars. Tap it: the heat lamp glows, the pump presses and hot cheese pours onto the nachos.

name: Recliner Sofa
note: Three caramel leather recliners in a row with consoles between them: cup holders with blue light rings, a cola and a tub of popcorn. The middle seat is reclined with its footrest out.

name: Dual-Zone Under-Counter Wine & Slushie Bar
playS: Doors open · cold air rolling… tap to close
note: An under-counter bar with a speckled quartz top: wine bottles on beech racks behind the left smoked-glass door, cans and juice bottles behind the right one, and a two-tank cherry / blue-razz slushie machine on top with augers always churning. Tap it: both doors swing open. Tap again to close them.

name: Motorized Brass & Crystal Cinema Chandelier
note: A brass chandelier on a motorized winch: a chain, two rings of candle bulbs and rows of crystal drops that sparkle. The motor slowly lowers and raises it and it sways a little.

name: Wood Lounge Chair
note: A classic rosewood lounge chair with black leather cushions and buttons, leaning back on a five-star base, with its matching footstool in front.

name: Movie Vault
note: A tall black cabinet with glass doors and lit glass shelves full of shiny metal movie cases, gold handles and a glowing keypad lock.

name: Smart RGBW Dolby-Synced Light Bars
note: Two aluminium light bars with frosted diffusers. Rainbow colour waves run up and down them and wash the wall, pulsing to the beat, with a small SYNC hub between them.

name: Hand-Tufted Art Deco Gold-and-Crimson Carpet
note: A hand-tufted crimson rug with a carved gold Art Deco design: a sunburst medallion, stepped corners, fan motifs and chevrons. A soft shimmer runs across the gold.

name: Sound-Absorbing Obsidian Starlight Fiber Walls
note: Padded obsidian fabric panels with hundreds of fibre-optic stars in warm and cool white. They twinkle at their own pace, and now and then a shooting star streaks past.

name: Curved Wall-to-Wall 16K MicroLED Holo-Screen
note: A curved wall-to-wall MicroLED screen: the black glass centre shows the movie while the two wings curve toward you, flowing with holographic colour. Light sparkles rise off the top edge and a floating 16K emitter beams up from below, with a colour glow on the wall behind.

name: Holo Table
note: A round white table on a glowing pedestal, with touch lights round the glass top and a spinning film-reel hologram beaming up from the middle.

name: Animated Living-Ink Holo-Poster Gallery
note: Three slim glowing frames with living posters: a rocket blasting through streaking stars, ink waves rolling under a pulsing moon, and a bouncy Squish blob that blinks. Holo shimmer sweeps across the glass.

name: Interactive Haptic Bass-Resonant Glass Flooring
note: Dark obsidian glass tiles with tiny stars underneath. Panels light up in waves of cyan, violet and pink with every bass hit.

name: Quantum Hologram Emitter with 4DX Motion Sync
note: A lens stack and three satellite emitters project a spinning planet and a film-strip ring. The platform rocks on four 4DX motion nodes.

name: Robot Butler
note: A round little robot butler on glowing wheels. It blinks, flashes its antenna and carries a tray with a soda and popcorn.

name: Holo Mascot
note: A little projector puck that beams up a waving hologram buddy.

name: 360-Degree Atmos Nebula Projection Vault
note: A 360-degree projection vault: violet, cyan and pink nebula clouds drift slowly over a field of twinkling stars while a soft projector sweep passes over, edged in obsidian with a violet light line.

name: Levitating Electrostatic Sphere Audio Matrix
note: Three glass spheres float over magnetic bases, with plasma arcs crackling inside.

name: Automated AI Gourmet Cinema Chef & Candy Dispensary
playS: Robot chef at work… tap to stop
note: A glossy white AI snack kiosk: three candy tubes, a popcorn dome, a pick-up window, a touch screen and a white robot arm with a gripper. Tap it: candy drops into the cup, the arm swings round, scoops a striped bucket of popcorn and serves it, and the screen shows the progress.

name: Zero-G Pods
note: Three white egg pods floating over glowing hover pads, with cushy seats, a light line inside each shell and glowing drink pillars between them. Pick the cushion colour.

name: Self-Filling Molecular Mocktail & Soda Fountain
playS: Dome open · glass filling… tap to close
note: A white pedestal fountain with a cyan glow ring and three chrome taps under a glass dome. Inside, three flavour spheres float in orbit around a tall glass. Tap it: the dome rises, the spheres speed up, pearls drop into the glass and it fills with fizzy pink mocktail. Tap again to close it.

name: Voice-Synced Ambient Aurora Ceiling Halo
note: Two floating rings on fine wires with aurora colours flowing round them, soft aurora curtains rising to the ceiling and a pulse ring that ripples out when it hears voices.

name: Hover Egg Chair
note: A white egg chair floating over a glowing hover pad. Light lines trace its opening and six massage lights pulse on the back cushion. Pick the cushion colour.

name: Holo Movie Library
note: A white pedestal that beams up a hologram library: two rings of glowing movie covers orbit round it and a play button spins on top.

name: Floating Holographic Film-Reel Light Sculptures
note: Two see-through holographic film reels float above a wall emitter bar and spin. A strip of film runs between them, light beams rise from the emitter, and the reels flicker like a hologram.

name: Self-Cleaning Silk Acoustic Cloud Rug
note: A cloud-shaped silk rug with quilted sound-soaking channels. Its pearly sheen shifts between pink and blue, and a sweep of sparkles keeps gliding across it to clean it.

name: Water-Stained Off-White Rental Wallpaper
note: Old off-white rental wallpaper with faded stripes and tiny rose sprigs. One seam has started to lift, there are brown water stains from a ceiling leak, a few old nail holes and a little torn spot.

name: Wobbly gooseneck Torchere with Cracked Shade
note: A cheap grey torchiere: scuffed, rusty base with a $4.99 sticker, a bent pole with rust streaks and a rotary switch, held together with wrinkled tape, a bendy gooseneck and a ribbed plastic bowl shade with a scorch mark and two cracks. The bulb flickers now and then.

name: Rough Plywood Hallway Trestle
note: A rough plywood board on two wooden sawhorses, with layered ply edges, mug rings, a sticky note, a pile of mail, keys and a coffee mug.

name: Tacked-Up Wall Calendar (Live Date Tracker)
note: A free calendar from Squish Pizza hanging on a nail. It always shows today, past days get crossed off, and you can tap days to mark them. A pencil on a string swings next to it.

name: Scuffed Linoleum Sheet Flooring
note: Old beige sheet linoleum printed to look like stone squares with little brown diamonds. A worn path runs across it, with black heel scuffs, a seam that curls up at the edge, an iron burn and a torn spot showing the plywood underneath.

name: lumpy Plaid Thrift-Store Two-Seater
note: A lumpy thrift-store two-seater in faded brown tartan with green bands and mustard lines, pilled all over. Saggy seats with dents and creases, a spring poking out of one cushion, a duct-tape X, a coffee ring, a corduroy patch sewn on the back, a threadbare arm, one odd wooden leg and a granny-square pillow.

name: Warped Particleboard 3-Cube Organizer
note: A cheap white particleboard 3-cube tower. The laminate is peeling off one shelf edge and the feet are swollen. A grey canvas bin with a sock flopping out, a row of books with one leaning over, board games, a coin jar, and a pen mug and rubber duck on top.

name: Stack of Old Coupons & Coaster
note: A little stack of six clipped coupons in faded colours, each with dashed scissor lines and a price box, a paperclip on the top one (50¢ OFF, long EXPIRED). Next to it a cork coaster with an old coffee ring, orange-handled scissors and a ballpoint pen.

name: Popcorn Stucco Ceiling with Peeling Paint
note: An old popcorn stucco ceiling gone yellow, with brown rings where the roof once leaked, a hairline crack, a cobweb in the corner and a peeled patch where a curl of paint hangs and flutters in the draft.

name: Mismatched Wooden Folding Chair with Pillow
note: A grey metal folding chair that doesn’t match anything: a scratched pine seat with a carved heart and a water ring, a back slat painted teal and chipped down to the wood with a star sticker, rusty spots on the legs, rubber feet (one is missing) and a red gingham pillow tied on with bows.

name: Rabbit-Ear Portable TV on a Stool
note: Needs speakers in the room for sound: without them it only shows static. With speakers, tap to flip through 3 channels (Squish Toons, Squish Cup football, Space Trip) and off. A chunky mint CRT with two channel dials sits on a three-legged pine stool. The rabbit-ear antenna sways a little, one ear has a tinfoil ball on the tip, and a strip of duct tape holds a corner together. Tap it: Squish Toons comes on with fuzzy scanlines and a rolling bar.
playS: Squish Toons is on · tap to turn it off

name: Cracked Single-Pane Window with Bent Plastic Blinds
note: A cracked single-pane window with chipped paint and a taped crack. The bent plastic blinds are missing a slat and the bottom rail hangs crooked.

name: Duct-Taped Cardboard Box Footrest
note: An old moving box turned footrest: corrugated cardboard held shut with silver duct tape, THIS SIDE UP arrows, a red FRAGILE stamp, a shipping label with a barcode, a crushed corner taped back up, a coffee ring and a water-stained bottom. A folded fleece blanket and the TV remote sit on top.

name: Drafty Brick Faux-Fireplace with Space Heater
note: A drafty fake fireplace: a printed brick panel with a seam, nail heads, a sun-faded patch, scuffs, a gold star sticker and one corner peeling off, on a speckled tile hearth with a cracked tile. In the empty firebox a little space heater glows orange behind its guard, cord trailing past a paper ball. A grainy wood mantel with a water ring, a plastic clock that ticks and a dripping candle that flickers sideways; a sock dries on a pin, swinging in the draft.

name: Cable-Spool Wooden Coffee Table
note: An old cable spool coffee table: layered plywood with rust round the bolts, splinters and stencilled letters, black cable still wound round the drum. A succulent in a tomato tin, a folded newspaper, a stack of wooden coasters and a mug on top.

name: Yellowed Plastic Dome Boob-Light
note: A cheap frosted plastic dome light that has gone yellow, on a metal ring with a chrome nut at the bottom. A few dead bugs sit inside and it flickers now and then.

name: Plastic Milk Crate End Table
note: A scuffed red plastic milk crate turned upside down, with a barcode sticker on the side, a cup of instant noodles and a fork on top, and a phone whose charger cable hangs over the side.

name: Half-Wilted Pothos in a Plastic Yogurt Cup
note: A half-wilted pothos in an old strawberry yogurt cup with a torn label, a taped crack, a bit of foil stuck to the rim and holes poked in the bottom, standing on its lid as a saucer with a little puddle and fallen leaves. A pink plastic spoon is stuck in the soil.

name: Warm Sage Matte Emulsion Painted Walls
note: Walls rolled in a soft sage matte paint (you can see the roller texture), with a crisp white skirting board, a light switch and a little round thermostat.

name: Tripod Wooden Floor Lamp with Linen Drum
note: Three oak legs meet at a brass hub under a glowing linen drum shade, with a little pull chain and the cord trailing off one leg.

name: Slim Black Iron & Glass Entry Console
note: A slim black iron frame with green-edged glass top and shelf: keys, a coin and a letter in the brass tray, a framed photo and a succulent on top, a woven basket with a knit throw and books below.

name: Round Brass-Rim Entryway Mirror
note: A round mirror with a thick brass rim hanging from a stitched leather strap on a brass peg. A soft glint slides across the glass.

name: Click-Lock Oak Laminate Planks
note: Honey oak laminate planks with bevelled edges and staggered joints. The wood print repeats every few planks like real laminate, with a soft satin sheen and a few light scratches.

name: Scandinavian Gray Fabric 3-Seat Sofa
note: A clean Scandinavian three-seater in heathered grey woven fabric with piped welts, button-tufted back cushions and tapered oak legs on an oak rail. A mustard rib-knit pillow, a white pillow with a black zigzag print and an oatmeal waffle-knit throw over one arm.

name: 5-Tier Industrial Pipe & Pine Bookshelf
note: Five thick pine planks on black iron pipes with flanges at every board. Blanket rolls and a crate of records at the bottom, books with an iron bookend, a pothos whose vines trail and sway over the front, a red alarm clock ticking, a glowing Edison bulb on its cord and an old camera on top.

name: Scented Soy Candle & Ceramic Trinket Dish
note: A soy candle in an amber glass jar with a kraft lavender & fig label, a soft melt pool and a flickering flame, its wooden lid beside it. A speckled ceramic dish with a gold rim holds a ring, two pearl studs and a hair tie, next to a matchbox and a burnt match.

name: Smooth Skimmed Ceiling with Simple Cove Molding
note: A smooth, freshly skimmed warm-white ceiling with a deep curved cove moulding all round, a soft sage glow from the walls, a white air vent and a smoke alarm whose little red light blinks.

name: Mid-Century Tufted Mustard Wingback Chair
note: A mid-century wingback in mustard wool tweed flecked with rust, cream and olive, with button-tufted back, self piping on every edge and tapered walnut legs with brass tips. A rust knit throw hangs over one arm.

name: Wall-Mounted Smart Frame Art TV
note: A slim TV in a light oak picture frame with a white mat. When it is off it shows a sunrise painting (art mode) with a soft sheen sweeping over it; tap it and the painting turns into Squish Toons.
playS: Squish Toons is on · tap to turn it off

name: Double-Hung Window with Cotton Roman Shades
note: A white double-hung window with a brass sash lock and a cotton roman shade, looking out on a sunny garden.

name: Cloud Puff Pouf
note: A round floor pouf that squishes when you sit on it, with a piped welt round the middle, a gathered button on top and a little pull loop. Each colour has its own fabric: chunky cable knit, macramé cord with knots and fringe, soft velvet, stitched leather panels or nubby bouclé.

name: Cast-Iron Electric Stove Insert
note: A cast-iron electric stove on cabriole legs over a slate hearth pad, with cast relief side panels and a glass door showing flickering flames over glowing logs. A flue pipe rises behind, a red kettle steams on top, and a basket of birch logs and the remote sit on the pad.

name: Two-Tier Pine & Hairpin-Leg Coffee Table
note: A pine coffee table with a lower shelf on black hairpin legs. Magazines and a basket of yarn below, a terracotta plant and coasters on top.

name: Geometric Woven Jute Area Rug
note: An oval rug braided from chunky jute rope, with a wide black band and a cream zigzag, cream and black rings, a woven star in the middle and a trim of cream and black pompoms that bob.

name: Woven Rattan Boho Pendant Shade
note: A bell-shaped pendant of criss-cross woven rattan on a black cord. Warm light glows through the gaps and throws dappled spots on the ceiling while it sways gently.

name: Round White Pedestal Bistro Side Table
note: A glossy white tulip table on one slim pedestal, with a bud vase holding a pink tulip, a little book and a cup of tea on a gold-rimmed saucer.

name: Potted Snake Plant in Terracotta Planter
Half-Height Shaker Wainscoting & Cream Walls
note: Cream plaster on top and white shaker panels below a chair rail, every panel a real recessed square with soft shadows.

name: Mid-Century Chrome Arc Floor Lamp
note: A chrome arc with jointed collars that rises from a veined white marble block and curves over the sofa, ending in a vented, mirror-shiny dome shade that throws a pool of warm light below. A foot switch on the cord.

name: Cane-Front Rattan & Teak Credenza
note: A teak credenza on tapered legs with two woven cane doors, three drawers with brass pulls, a vase of pampas and a stack of books on top.

name: Triptych Textured Canvas Abstract Gallery Set
note: Three deep gallery-wrapped canvases that make one abstract painting together, with thick raised brush strokes, the paint wrapping round their sides.

name: Solid White Oak Chevron Parquet
note: Pale white oak boards laid in a chevron zigzag, with straight oak border boards and a thin walnut inlay line round the edge. Oiled to a soft matte sheen.

name: Cognac Full-Grain Leather L-Shaped Sectional
note: An L-shaped sectional in full-grain cognac leather with a chaise, rubbed to a warm patina on the seats and arms, soft creases, dark welts with cream saddle stitching. A cream bouclé pillow, a charcoal herringbone wool pillow and a striped grey wool blanket folded across the chaise.

name: Built-In Archway Alcove Bookcases
note: Painted built-in bookcases with three true arches. The side bays are full of books on oak shelves with LED strips. The middle is a window seat with a blue cushion, pillows, a throw, an open book whose pages turn, a brass sconce and a little floating shelf with trailing ivy.

name: Hardcover Art Books & Brass Magnifying Glass
note: Three cloth-bound art books stacked a little crooked, with gilt titles on the spines, debossed covers, worn corners and a red ribbon bookmark, a postcard tucked in the bottom one. A brass magnifying glass with a turned wooden handle lies on top.

name: Exposed Rustic Cedar Beams
note: Four heavy cedar beams across the room with real grain, knots and checks, held by black iron straps, over whitewashed pine boards and a cedar wall plate.

name: Velvet Swivel Papasan Accent Chair
note: A papasan on a black and brass swivel base: the woven rattan bowl tilts back so its high back holds you, with binding bands and a wrapped rim. A deep round velvet cushion with pleats running into buttons and a piped edge, a plump channelled head pillow against the back and a gold tassel on the rim.

name: Retro Walnut TV Console & Turntable
note: A mid-century walnut console on brass-capped legs with orange grille-cloth speakers, a cream Squish-o-Vision TV on a brass swivel, a turntable and a little tube amp. Tap it: the TV warms up, the record spins, the tubes glow and the VU needles dance.
playS: Squish Toons is on · tap to turn it off

name: Floor-to-Ceiling Bay Window with Linen Drapes
note: A floor-to-ceiling bay window with three glass walls, a sunny wood floor and long linen drapes on a brass rod.

name: Multi-Level Felt & Birch Pet Climbing Tree
note: A pet climbing tree of real birch logs with white bark and black marks on a felt base: a sisal-wrapped scratching post, a felt cave with a round door, felt beds with paw prints on the platforms, felt leaves on the logs and a red felt ball on a cord.

name: Classic White Painted Mantel with Gas Logs
note: A classic white mantel: fluted pilasters, carved swags and bellflower drops on the frieze, a dentil crown and panelled sides, over a cleft black slate surround with brass trim and a flecked granite hearth. Ceramic gas logs with white ash and glowing cracks burn on a grate with blue-based flames in a sooty brick firebox behind a brass mesh screen; dripping candles flicker either side of a beaded gilt mirror.

name: Live-Edge Walnut Slab Table
note: A thick walnut slab with flowing grain, fine pores and ray flecks round two knots, a resin-filled crack held by bowties and a pale sapwood rim with bark, on brushed black steel frames. A turned bowl heaped with a red apple, an orange, a lemon, a green pear and two bananas, a latte and a book.

name: Vintage Overdyed Persian Wool Carpet
note: A vintage Persian wool carpet overdyed deep crimson: a big lobed navy and ivory medallion with a gold star, a gold-thread lattice full of little flowers, teal corner pieces and a rosette border. The gold threads shimmer and the velvet pile catches the light.

name: Sputnik Brushed-Brass 12-Arm Chandelier
note: A brushed-brass Sputnik chandelier: a brass ball on a rod with 12 arms reaching out in every direction, each ending in a round glowing bulb that twinkles softly.

name: Fluted Oak Tambour Door Night/Side Table
note: A small grained-oak cabinet on brass-capped legs with a fluted tambour door slid half open to show books inside. A glass of water, reading glasses and a novel with a ribbon bookmark on top.

name: Tall Fiddle-Leaf Fig in Ceramic Stand
Herringbone Oak Feature Wall & Limewash Plaster
note: A herringbone oak feature wall in mixed honey and walnut planks on the back wall, and chalky limewash plaster on the side walls.

name: Sculptural Alabaster Totem Standing Lamp
note: A sculptural totem of six hand-carved alabaster pieces (a rough block, a soft disc, a sphere, a chiselled drum, a river pebble and an open bowl shade) on bronze spacers over a square bronze plinth. Amber and white veins wrap round every stone and the light glows from inside, breathing from stone to stone.

name: Burl Wood & Lacquered Brass Gallery Console
note: A swirly burl-wood top full of tiny burl eyes under a glossy lacquer, on fluted brass legs with a gallery rail at the back. A brass bowl of fruit, a veined stone orb and art books on top.

name: Custom Neon & Venetian Etched Mirror Installation
note: An arched Venetian mirror made of bevelled, etched glass pieces with little glass rosettes, and a pink "hey cutie" neon script glowing on it.

name: Polished Terrazzo with Radiant Underfloor Heating
note: Polished cream terrazzo full of marble chips in grey, terracotta, sage, blush and black, split into big panels by brass strips. Heating pipes under the floor make it glow softly warm.

name: Curved Bouclé Cloud Modular Pit Sofa
note: A curved pit sofa of five puffy bouclé modules on oak plinths, each seat with a piped welt, nubby loops all over, a chunky-knit mustard throw over the middle back cushion, a rust cable-knit pillow with pompoms and a fluffy faux-fur pillow.

name: Floor-to-Ceiling Walnut Library Wall with Rolling Ladder
note: A floor-to-ceiling walnut library: raised-panel cupboards below, three bays of books and curios above, brass picture lights washing the shelves, and a rolling ladder that slowly glides along its brass rail.

name: Crystal Ikebana Vase & Artisanal Incense Burner
note: A cut-crystal vase holding a plum branch in blossom, a leafy branch and a red camellia, on a cleft slate tray. Beside it an incense stick glows in a black dish of raked sand, its smoke curling up, with a wooden incense box, a little stone cairn and a moss ball.

name: Ornate Parisian Plaster Medallion & Crown Molding
note: A cream plaster ceiling with two panel mouldings (the inner one with a thin gilded line), corner rosettes, a carved acanthus medallion right above the light and a deep crown moulding with a dentil row.

name: Sculpted Walnut & Shearling Lounge Chair
note: A low lounge chair in sculpted walnut with flowing grain, little knots and fine edge grain on every piece, holding fluffy cream shearling cushions. Two cognac leather straps run over the back with brass buckles.

name: Concealed Pop-Up Rollable OLED Credenza
note: A smoked-walnut credenza with fluted doors and gold trim. Its huge 200-unit OLED screen (the biggest TV in the house) rolls up out of the slot on top when you turn it on, and the wall behind it glows.
playS: Squish Toons is on · tap to turn it off

name: Motorized Smart-Tint Panoramic Window Wall
note: A panoramic black-steel window wall over the hills and the city. The smart tint slowly rolls down the glass and back up.

name: Suspended Mid-Century Black Steel Wood-Burning Cone
note: A black steel egg that hangs on its flue over a round slate plate. Real logs burn in its round opening, sparks drift up and the plate glows. A steel holder of split logs stands beside it.

name: Nesting Travertine & Smoked Bronze Drum Tables
note: A big cream travertine drum with broken bands and little pores all round, nested with a smaller brushed, smoky bronze drum with a brass rim. A book, a brass orb and a white bowl of river stones.

name: Hand-Knotted Silk & New Zealand Wool Abstract Rug
note: A free-form pebble-shaped designer rug: deep teal, rust, mustard, blush and charcoal islands in raised wool with carved grooves and contour lines, crossed by iridescent silk rivers whose colours flow and glint.

name: Tiered Murano Hand-Blown Smoked Glass Chandelier
note: Three brass rings in tiers hung with hand-blown smoked-amber Murano glass drops. Warm light glows inside, each drop swings on its hook and catches a glint.

name: Solid Nero Marquina Marble Plinth Table
note: A solid block of glossy black Nero Marquina marble with white veins running over its faces, with a brass candle holder and a flickering candle.

name: Bookmatched Calacatta Viola Marble & Brass Inlay Walls
note: Bookmatched smooth white marble with thin brass inlay strips.

name: Bioluminescent Living-Plant Aura Floor Tower
note: A glass column ribbed in brass, misted with drops, on a carved stone pot with glowing runes. A glowing vine spirals up inside, moss and tiny glowing mushrooms ring its foot. Spores drift up and a pulse of light climbs the vine.

name: Sculpted Liquid-Metal Parametric Console Table
note: A mirror-chrome console that looks poured: its legs flow up like liquid metal into the top, reflecting the room, with drips frozen under the edge. A dark glass vase with a dried branch and a chrome droplet on top.

name: Framed AI-Generative Living Oil Masterpiece
note: A living painting in a carved gilt frame with a brass picture light. It moves on its own. Tap it to repaint.

name: Seamless Heated Onyx Stone with Gold Vein Illumination
note: One seamless slab of honey onyx with soft cloudy bands, lit from below. Thin gold veins glow and little pulses of light run along them.

name: Self-Warming Cashmere & Smart-Gel Levitating Salon Sofa
note: A cloud-soft cashmere sofa in fine rib-knit with cable-knit back cushions, floating above a black-glass magnetic pad. The smart-gel seats glow with warm heat nodes and a touch dial sets the warmth; a caramel cashmere throw with fringe drapes over one arm. Magnetic rings rise under it and warm air shimmers over the seats.

name: Automated Robotic Archive Wall with Illuminated Niches
note: A graphite grid of softly lit niches holding archive boxes, books, specimen jars, vases and sculptures. A robot gantry glides along its rails and the picker rises and falls carrying a box, while status lights blink on the base.

name: Levitating Chronometer Sphere & Rare Meteorite Sculpture
note: A black marble plinth with white veins and a brass inlay. On the left a navy enamel clock sphere with a white dial and ticking hands floats over a glowing magnetic pad, held in three brass armillary rings that circle it. On the right a real iron meteorite, pitted and rusty, with a polished cut face showing its silver crystal pattern, on a walnut stand.

name: Double-Height Glass Atrium Sky-Vault
note: A brass-rimmed opening in the polished white ceiling rises to a glass barrel vault: steel ribs, blue sky, slow drifting clouds, a sun glint gliding over the glass and now and then a bird flying over.

name: Kinetic Zero-G sculptural Carbon-Fiber Lounge Throne
note: A floating lounge throne with a gloss carbon-fibre twill shell, quilted perforated leather seat and back with stitched welts, cyan LED loops on the scrolls and wings, speakers in the wings and a glowing crest on the back. Two gyro rings orbit it over a black-glass magnetic pad.

name: Floating Holo-Screen & Acoustic Sculpture
note: A giant see-through holo-screen floats over a glowing emitter, wrapped by a ring of walnut acoustic fins with cyan tips. When it is off a little hologram mascot waves hello; tap it for Squish Toons in holo colour.
playS: Squish Toons is on · tap to turn it off

name: Holographic Weather-Shifting Skyline Panorama Window
note: A frameless holographic panorama of a future skyline that changes weather on its own: sunshine, rain, a starry night and snow.

name: Three-Sided Floating Bio-Ethanol & Water-Vapor Fire Column
note: A honed black basalt slab that seems to float on a warm under-glow, glass on three sides with green edges. A brushed steel burner sends up a row of flames and softly glowing water-vapour mist between glinting river stones; the flames reflect in the dark back glass and a little panel shows the flame level.

name: Interactive Koi-Pond Holographic Glass Coffee Table
note: A low glass table that is a little pond: three koi swim round under the glass between lily pads and a lotus, the water shimmers and ripples spread across it.

name: Color-Shifting Mood-Responsive Fiber-Optic Tapestry Rug
note: An oval fibre-optic rug with a spiral galaxy of light points that slowly turns. Its colours drift through moods, rings of colour pulse out from the glowing core and a chasing light runs round the rim.

name: Kinetic Floating Crystal Constellation Chandelier
note: A slim glowing disc on the ceiling with 26 cut crystals floating below it on no wires, each bobbing on its own, joined by fine light lines with pulses running along them while the crystals shift colour and sparkle.

name: Floating Levitation Side Pedestal with Wireless Power
note: A white round top ringed with tiny lights floats over a vented glowing base and gently bobs. Rings of light rise between them and the phone on the top charges wirelessly.

name: Self-Watering Floating Zen Sky-Garden Terrarium
note: A tiny sky island floats inside a glass orb above a glowing base with a water ring: a bonsai on a mossy lawn with a gravel path, stepping stones, a tiny pond with lily pads and a glowing stone lantern. The rocks underneath have moss, roots and glowing crystals, and a little waterfall spills over the edge.

name: Cracked White Tiles with Mildewed Grout
note: Old 4 inch white tiles up to a chipped bullnose cap, every one a slightly different white, with grout going grey and then black-green with mildew toward the floor. Several tiles are cracked (one crack runs across two), a corner is chipped, one tile is missing down to the combed mortar and one too-blue replacement sits in fresh grout. Two plastic anchors and rust runs show where a towel bar was ripped off. Soap scum, yellowed caulk, and above it all yellowed paint with a water-stain ring, peeling flakes and mildew creeping from the ceiling. Beads of condensation slide down the tiles.

name: Peeling 'Wash Your Hands' Vinyl Sticker
note: A sun-faded vinyl "WASH YOUR HANDS" sticker (cartoon hands under a tap, soap bubbles and a "20 SEC!" burst) with air bubbles, scratches and grime round the edge. Its top corner has peeled and folded over, showing the grey back and a dusty sticky patch, and it flutters in the draught. Beside it the ghost and tape scraps of an older sticker, and a cloudy suction-cup hook that has slid down the wall, holding a pink mesh loofah that sways and drips.

name: Peeling Vinyl Checkerboard Squares
note: Tired red and cream vinyl squares flecked like cheap sheet vinyl, the grout gone grey and dark toward the walls, mildew blooming from the back corner. Three corners curl up off the yellow glue, one square is missing down to the paper backing, and a yellowed ring with two rusty bolt caps shows where the old toilet stood. A rust ring from a can, soap scum, hair, a worn path and heel scuffs; a slow leak drips into a little puddle at the back.

name: Cracked Porcelain Pedestal Sink with Exposed Pipes
note: A chipped, yellowing basin on a cracked pedestal with two old cross-head taps (red and blue buttons). Copper supply lines and a rusty drain pipe run bare into the wall, there is a rust streak in the bowl under the taps and a worn bar of soap stuck to the rim. The hot tap drips and rings spread on the water.

name: Steamy Bucket of Hot Water & Menthol Drops
note: A dented, rust-spotted galvanised bucket with pressed ribs and a wire bail handle, full of hot water gone pale minty green, a little green bottle of menthol drops with a rubber dropper, a thin worn towel on the floor with a dented tin ladle, and a splashed puddle. Steam curls up, a mint swirl turns in the water, ripples spread and a drip runs down into the puddle.

name: Half-Squeezed Toothpaste Tube & Bar Soap Sliver
note: A grimy translucent blue soap dish with drain ridges holding a cracked, worn-thin pink soap sliver with a stray hair, and a crumpled half-squeezed toothpaste tube with a faded red band, its cap lying aside and a worm of paste oozing out. A soap bubble swells and pops on the sliver and a drip gathers under the dish.

name: Rusted Rattling Exhaust Fan & Peeling Paint
note: Yellowed drywall with taped seams (one cracked, a strip of tape peeling and swaying), brown leak rings and mildew creeping in from the back corners. Big patches have blistered and peeled down to the old blue-grey coat, with curling flakes hanging. A rust-streaked exhaust fan with dust-caked louvres spins lopsided and rattles its grille, with a lint strand dangling and a cobweb in the corner.

name: Unframed Mirror with Desilvered Corners
note: A plain rectangle of mirror glass with a ground edge, held by plastic clips (one snapped and replaced by a bent nail). Black-brown desilvering creeps in from the corners and bottom edge, with a crack across one corner, scratches, toothpaste flecks and a sticker scrap. Steam fogs the bottom of the glass and slowly clears.

name: Plastic Washbasin & Rubber Duckie
note: A big (3 bathing spots) cheap faded-blue plastic washtub, scuffed and grimy outside, with moulded grip slots and a crack patched with silver duct tape; soapy water with foam patches, a rubber duck and a pink squeaky bone floating. The duck bobs, bubbles pop, ripples spread and a drip seeps from the taped crack into a puddle.

name: Flickering Fluorescent Tube Over Mirror
note: A cheap enamel strip light over the mirror with a yellowed, cracked prismatic lens full of dead bugs. One end cap is gone so the bare tube shows its blackened end, there are rusty screws with a rust dribble, a grey cord stapled up the wall and a ball-chain pull switch that sways. The tube stutters and the greenish wash on the wall flickers with it.

name: Soggy Threadbare Cotton Bath Mat
note: A faded blue terry bath mat gone thin and lumpy: bald patches showing the backing, a dark soggy middle, pink mildew dots, hair and lint, a little hole and a frayed fringe at both ends with a loose thread. Wet footprints soak in and slowly fade.

name: Chipped Cast-Iron Clawfoot Tub with Rust Ring
note: An old roll-top cast-iron tub on four rusty claw feet: tired cream enamel inside with a brown rust ring at the waterline and a rust streak under the spout, the outside paint flaked off in patches down to black iron, chips along the rolled rim, tarnished brass taps and spout, cloudy water and a rubber duck. The spout drips, rings spread and the duck bobs.

name: Plastic Step-Stool with Cracked Leg
note: A cheap faded mustard plastic step stool with a ribbed anti-slip top and a hand-grip slot, four splayed legs with braces, one leg split and bound with grey duct tape, a peeling sticker and scuffs, standing in a wet ring. A drop slides off the edge and plinks into the puddle.

name: Plastic Faux-Fern on Toilet Tank
note: The dollar-store fake fern off the toilet tank: stiff moulded fronds with identical leaflets in a too-bright green, two sun-bleached and one kinked, stuck in green-dyed foam in a thin faded terracotta-look plastic pot with a moulding seam and a half-peeled 99c sticker, standing on a pastel crocheted doily beside a dust bunny and a snapped-off leaflet.

name: Low-Pressure Dripping Chrome Showerhead
note: A dingy stall of grey 4 inch tiles with darkened grout and mildew creeping up from the floor, a cracked acrylic tray with a rusty drain, an exposed chrome riser with a crusty old showerhead, two worn cross handles, a sagging wire soap rack with a soap sliver and a peeling "shower" sticker. The head only dribbles, in weak uneven bursts.

name: Plastic Mesh Pop-Up Laundry Hamper
note: A dingy white pop-up mesh hamper on a spring-wire frame, sides sagging and grubby toward the base, a frayed grey rim binding and cloth carry loops, with laundry heaped over the top (jeans, a pink tee, a grey towel, a black sock), a striped sleeve and a sock hanging over the edge, a split in the mesh and a lost sock on the floor.

name: Clean Mint Subway Tiles with White Grout
note: Glossy mint subway tiles in a running bond, each a slightly different mint with a soft cushion glaze and a crisp bevel, set in clean white grout with one white accent row. A rounded white pencil liner caps them under warm white eggshell paint, with a GFCI outlet and its little green light. Window light reflects in the glaze and a slow glint slides across it.

name: Framed Botanical Seaweed Prints
note: Three pressed-seaweed specimens on cream rag paper in pale oak frames with white mats, hung on picture wire from nails: red Plocamium with fine branching fronds, translucent green Ulva sea lettuce and olive Fucus bladder wrack with its air bladders, each with a handwritten label and number. A little orange starfish is tucked into one frame, and the crooked right frame gently sways.

name: Hexagonal Matte White Porcelain Tile
note: Small matte white hexagon porcelain tiles, each softly bevelled, in grey grout that darkens toward the tub, with a black border band and little black hex flowers. A few chips, one replaced tile a shade too white, splash spots by the tub and a round chrome drain with a thin film of water. Soft daylight drifts slowly across.

name: Single-Basin White Cabinet Vanity
note: A crisp white shaker vanity with two doors, brushed nickel knobs and a toe kick under a cultured-marble top with an integrated oval basin and a short backsplash. A single-lever chrome faucet, a blush soap pump, a mint cup of toothbrushes and a folded peach hand towel. Soap bubbles drift up from the pump now and then.

name: Portable Zip-Up Personal Steam Tent
note: A sage nylon pop-up steam tent with a padded collar and drawstring round the head hole, a U-shaped zip door with a dangling pull, soft creases and a side hose port; beside it a small white steam generator with a dial, a green light and a ribbed hose. Steam leaks from the collar and the zip, the light blinks and the nylon slowly puffs.

name: Matching Ceramic Soap Dispenser & Toothbrush Tumbler
note: A speckled oatmeal stoneware set on a matching oval tray: a pump dispenser stamped "savon" with a brushed-steel pump, and a tumbler holding a teal and a coral toothbrush. A pearl of soap gathers on the nozzle and drops, and glints slide down the glaze.

name: Moisture-Resistant PVC Panel Ceiling with LED Vent
note: Glossy white tongue-and-groove PVC strips running to the back wall, each a hair different white, with V-grooves and soft reflections, finished with a white cove trim. A round low-profile vent with concentric slots and a warm white LED ring glows softly on the panels while little wisps of air curl into it, with a few condensation beads.

name: Medicine Cabinet Mirror with Chrome Trim
note: A white steel medicine cabinet with a bright chrome trim round its mirrored door and a chrome finger pull, a "dentist Tue 4pm" sticky note and a kid's gold star sticker. A glint slides across the mirror.

name: Non-Slip Pet Tub Insert & Foaming Brush
note: A roomy (4 bathing spots) clean white acrylic pet tub with a rolled rim; a teal non-slip insert with rows of suction-cup bubbles shows through the clear water, a teal palm foaming brush with soft nubs sits on the rim, and a pink paw-print shampoo bottle on the other side. Foam bubbles bloom round the brush and float off, ripples cross the water and a glint slides on the rim.

name: Frosted Glass Globe Vanity Bar
note: A polished chrome backplate with three curved chrome arms holding satin-frosted glass globes that glow warm white (one a slightly whiter replacement), with soft pools of light on the wall that gently breathe.

name: Memory-Foam Microfiber Pebble Bath Rug
note: A big oval rug in plush sage microfiber, moulded into puffy memory-foam pebbles of different sizes with soft grooves between them, a velvety sheen that drifts and a bound edge. Now and then one pebble squishes in and springs back as if someone just stepped on it.

name: Standard Acrylic Alcove Soaking Tub
note: A clean glossy white acrylic alcove tub with a tall front apron and wide ledges, a chrome spout and overflow plate at the tap end, a soft grey bath pillow at the other, mounds of bubble foam, a rubber duck and a jar candle on the back ledge. The candle flickers, the foam shimmers and the duck bobs.

name: Foldable Bamboo Shower Stool
note: A round slatted bamboo seat on two X-folding bamboo leg frames with nodes, steel hinge rivets and foot rails, water beaded on the slats and a white face cloth folded over the edge. Drops fall between the slats and a glint slides along a rail.

name: Hanging Eucalyptus Bundle on Showerhead
note: A fresh bundle of silver-dollar eucalyptus (round blue-grey leaves with a white bloom on red-brown stems) tied with jute twine looped over a plain chrome shower arm, hanging upside down below a bell showerhead with limescale spots. The bundle sways, steam wisps rise through the leaves and drops fall from the head.

name: Handheld Dual-Spray Chrome Shower Wand
note: A clean stall in white subway tile with a mint band and a white tray: a chrome slide bar with a handheld wand on its silver hose, a chrome mixer, and a chrome corner caddy with pastel bottles and a lilac pouf. The wand sprays a gentle stream, then switches to its wide ring spray.

cat: Minor Table: Tub Caddy & Side Table
name: Expandable Bamboo Bathtub Reading Caddy
note: A slatted bamboo bath caddy with both extension arms pulled out to their end grips, a hinged book rest holding a paperback open, a sage stoneware mug of tea with the tea-bag tag hanging over the rim and a tealight in a tin. Steam curls off the tea and the tealight flickers.

name: Woven Seagrass Lid Hamper
note: A tapered round hamper hand-coiled from natural seagrass with darker stitches, a braided rim and twisted rope handles, a domed coiled lid with a loop handle sitting a little ajar on a white cotton liner folded over the rim, a striped sleeve escaping from under the lid and a lavender sachet tag hanging from the loop.

name: Matte Slate Stone Slabs & Cedar Accent Wall
note: Large staggered slate slabs from floor to ceiling, each its own blue-grey, with split cleft layers, little step edges, rusty iron blooms and mica glints, darker and damp near the floor, on a matte black steel base. Once, in the middle of the back wall, a red cedar accent wall: vertical tongue-and-groove boards with grain and knots in a black steel frame, washed by a warm cove light that slowly breathes.

name: Carved Wooden Onsen Kanji Sign & Hanging Noren Curtain
note: A thick weathered cedar board with a deeply carved, gilded 湯 ("hot water") and a red seal, pegged to the wall. Under it, an indigo cotton noren hangs in two panels from a bamboo pole on wooden brackets, with a big white ゆ across the split, a wave pattern at the hem and soft folds. The panels sway gently.

name: Non-Slip River Pebble & Teak Duckboard Flooring
note: A packed mosaic of smooth, rounded river pebbles in grey, cream, slate and rust, set in dark wet grout, with an oiled teak duckboard of slats on battens and little brass screws over the middle. Water beads glint between the stones and a drip runs off the front slat.

name: Floating Teak Vanity with Ceramic Vessel Bowl
note: An oiled teak drawer unit floating off the wall with a finger-pull groove, a teak top with a hand-thrown matte white vessel bowl, a tall matte black gooseneck faucet, a stone soap dish and a bud vase of eucalyptus that gently sways. A floating teak shelf below holds two rolled linen towels, and a warm LED line glows under the drawer.

name: Corner Cedar Barrel Dry Sauna with Lava Rocks
note: A cedar barrel sauna on two cradles, with grooved staves held by black steel bands, a board end wall with a round-topped glass door, cedar pull and thermometer, and a black stovepipe. Through the glass: cedar benches, a heater piled with lava rocks, a bucket and ladle. The rocks breathe red-orange, steam puffs off the stones and heat shimmers over the pipe.

name: Reed Diffuser, Volcanic Pumice Stone & Rolled Hand Towels
note: A teak tray with a smoked-glass reed diffuser (black collar, kraft "Cedar & Sage" label) and a fan of rattan reeds, a grey porous volcanic pumice stone, three rolled waffle hand towels in oatmeal, white and sage, and a eucalyptus sprig. Faint scent curls rise from the reed tips and an oil glint creeps up a reed.

name: Aromatic Red Cedar Plank Ceiling with Skylight
note: Aromatic red cedar boards run across the room with staggered joints, flowing grain, knots and warm colour shifts, under a cedar crown. In the middle, a deep white skylight well with a slim bronze frame looks up at blue sky where clouds drift past, with a fallen maple leaf and condensation on the glass and warm daylight spilling onto the cedar.

name: Round Backlit Anti-Fog LED Vanity Mirror
note: A big frameless round mirror floating off the wall on a warm halo of backlight, with a frosted LED ring inside its edge and a glowing defog touch button. Steam mist creeps in from the rim and the anti-fog clears it from the middle out.

name: Mini Hinoki Pet Onsen Barrel with Yuzu Citrus
note: A big round (5 bathing spots) pale hinoki-cypress soaking tub bound with two copper hoops, full of clear hot water with yuzu bobbing in it, beside a little hinoki stool with a wooden ladle and a spare yuzu. Steam curls up, the yuzu bob and ripples spread.

name: Warm Wood & Rice-Paper Onsen Lantern Sconces
note: A hinoki lantern post on a split-granite base with a little cap and two carved arms, each holding an andon lantern: a hinoki frame and kumiko lattice over warm rice paper glowing like candlelight. A pool of light falls on the floor, the paper softly flickers and a tiny moth circles one lantern.

name: Quick-Dry Diatomaceous Earth Stone Mat
note: A thin pale-grey diatomaceous earth stone mat with a fine sandy speckle, a soft bevel, a faint pressed wave pattern and a little embossed leaf, sitting on a cork pad. A pair of wet footprints appears dark and dries away in seconds.

name: Freestanding Matte-White Egg Soaking Tub
note: A seamless egg-shaped tub in matte white stone resin, thin-rimmed and wide at the shoulder, on a recessed plinth, with a tall matte black floor-standing filler and hand shower at the head end. A teak bath bridge across the middle holds a book, a glass of iced tea and a tea-light. The tea-light flickers, the hand shower sways and slow ripples cross the clear water.

name: Traditional Hinoki Wood Onsen Wash Stool & Bucket Set
note: A tall pale hinoki stool with a round seat, four square legs and a lower shelf holding a matching hinoki oke bucket bound with dark copper hoops and full of warm water, a hishaku ladle resting across it. Steam curls from the bucket, ripples cross the water and a drop falls from the ladle.

name: Potted Lucky Bamboo & Humidity-Loving Boston Fern
note: A tall clear glass cylinder of lucky bamboo cut in three heights with darker nodes and fresh sprouts, standing in white pebbles and clear water and bound with a gold ribbon, beside a lush Boston fern spilling arching fronds over a matte white ceramic planter on a slim three-legged brass stand.

name: Brushed Brass Rainfall Overhead Shower Column
note: Warm grey microcement walls with a lit recessed niche holding amber bottles and a candle, a slate tray under an oiled teak duckboard, and an exposed brushed-brass column: riser, mixing valve with two handles, a long arm to a big round rain head and a handheld on a brass cradle. Soft rain falls in waves and the candle flickers.

cat: Minor Table: Tub Caddy & Side Table
name: Teak Pedestal Spa Side Table for Tea & Towels
live: Tea steam + glint on the oiled top
note: A solid oiled-teak round side table with a softened edge on a turned teak pedestal and round foot, golden grain. At the back: a white ceramic teapot with a bamboo handle, a celadon cup of green tea and a little pyramid of rolled white spa towels. Steam rises from the cup and spout, and a warm glint moves across the top.

name: Dual-Compartment Bamboo Tilt-Out Laundry Cabinet
note: A caramelised strand-bamboo cabinet on short legs with two tilt-out laundry bins: the left tipped open showing a grey linen bag heaped with whites, the right shut with a cut-out finger pull, each with a small brass label holder (WHITES / COLOURS), and a glass jar of laundry pods on the top.

name: Seamless Tadelakt Moroccan Waterproof Plaster & Hinoki Wood
note: Seamless warm sand tadelakt burnished to a soft waxy stone sheen: cloudy lime tones, curved trowel strokes and polished pinpoints, with scallops of warm light grazing down from above and a sheen that slowly drifts across it. A polished brass inlay line and cap rail sit on a pale golden hinoki wainscot with fine straight grain, over a black basalt skirting with a brass edge.

name: Hydronic Heated Brass Towel Warmer Cabinet
note: A walnut cabinet on brass bun feet with a polished brass frame, crown and glass door: brass hot-water rails glow along the back above walnut shelves stacked with rolled white, cream and taupe towels, and a brass thermostat plate reads 52°C. A warm amber glow breathes behind the glass and heat shimmers above the crown.

name: Bas-Relief Zen Sand-Ripple Stone Wall Sculpture
note: A honed travertine panel carved like a raked zen garden: straight grooves swirl into rings around three raised stones, lit from above so every groove shows. It floats on a dark bronze reveal under a polished brass picture light whose warm wash slowly breathes while a soft sheen glides across the ripples. Below, a floating stone ledge holds a candle in a brass cup that flickers on the wall and a curl of incense.

name: Heated Black Basalt Stone Slabs with Linear Brass Drains
note: Big honed black basalt slabs, each a slightly different black, with a flamed grain, pores and pale mineral flecks, crossed by two long polished brass slot drains with a glint running along them. A film of water near the shower drain reflects warm light with slow ripples, condensation beads sit on the stone, and the heated floor breathes a warm glow as wisps of steam lift off it.

name: Double Carved River-Stone Basins on Quartz Countertop
note: A thick white quartz top veined in grey and gold with a matching backsplash, on a slim brushed brass console with a walnut shelf holding rolled towels and a woven basket. Two hand-carved river-stone basins in dark green-grey stone with chisel marks sit under brass wall spouts with levers, and a brass tray with a perfume bottle sits between them. The spouts trickle in turn, rings spread on the water and a glint runs down a brass leg.

name: Glass-Front Finnish Infrared & Himalayan Salt Sauna
note: A smoked thermo-ash cabin under a black cornice with a gold edge, its whole front bronze-tinted glass with a door mullion, a tall gold pull and a touch panel. Inside: a wall of glowing Himalayan salt bricks, a two-tier hemlock bench, red infrared panels, a brushed-steel heater with stones and a cedar bucket. The salt wall and the IR panels breathe, heat shimmers off the stones and the panel reads 65°.

name: Artisanal Aesop-Style Amber Glass Apothecary Set & Jade Roller
note: A honed travertine tray with two amber glass pump bottles (black pumps, minimal cream labels with fine black type), a small amber dropper bottle of face oil, and a double-ended jade facial roller in a gold frame. Honey-gold light drifts through the amber glass, an amber caustic shimmers on the tray and a sheen slides over the jade.

name: Vaulted Steam-Dome Ceiling with Chromotherapy Halo
note: Warm ivory tadelakt rising into a hammam dome that climbs to a glowing oculus, pierced by rings of star-shaped glass lenses that twinkle and edged with a polished brass rim. A hidden halo slowly cycles through soft amber, rose, lavender and sea-glass, tinting the dome, while steam curls drift up into it.

name: Archway Brass Smart Mirror with Built-In Weather & Clock Display
note: A tall arch mirror in a slim polished brass frame with a fine beaded inner edge, on a little brass ledge with a perfume bottle and a tiny trailing plant. Through the glass a soft champagne display shows the clock with a sweeping second hand, the date and the weather (sun and cloud, 24°).

name: Automated Warm-Air Pet Blow-Dry & Bubble Spa Pod
note: A big pearl-white bubble-spa pool (6 bathing spots) with a champagne rim band and a soft blue glow under the lip, backed by a curved pearl blow-dry hood with warm amber vents, two round dryer fans and a WARM AIR 38°C display. Jets fizz bubbles up, warm-air ribbons stream down, the fans spin and the glow breathes.

name: Recessed Waterproof Himalayan Salt-Glow Wall Lights
note: Three square niches set into the wall near the floor, each with a brushed brass bezel and a sealed glass cover beaded with condensation over a rough block of pink-orange Himalayan salt with facets and white veins, lit from behind. Warm rose light spills across the wall, and each block slowly breathes out of step with the others.

name: Slatted Burmese Teak & Plush Egyptian Cotton Runner
note: A long runner of oiled golden Burmese teak slats on a teak frame with polished brass corner caps, its three middle panels inset with deep plush ivory Egyptian cotton framed by a fine gold line, with a little monogram. A warm glint slides along the oiled teak and the cotton pile sheen drifts.

name: Traditional Deep Square Hinoki Cypress Onsen Tub
note: A deep square tub of pale golden hinoki boards with fine straight grain, bound by two hammered copper bands under a wide hinoki rim. A bamboo spout on a hinoki post pours hot spring water in at the back corner, a hinoki bucket with a ladle sits on the rim and yuzu float on the steaming water. Rings spread, the yuzu bob and steam curls rise.

name: Heated Marble Hammam Massage Slab Bench
note: A long white Carrara marble slab with soft grey and gold veins on a fluted marble body over a stepped plinth, with brass trim along the edge; on the plinth ledge a hammered brass hammam bowl of water and a rolled striped peshtemal. Thin steam lifts off the heated slab and ripples cross the bowl.

name: Living Vertical Moss Wall with Trickling Bamboo Water Spout
note: A tall walnut-framed panel planted solid with living moss (cushion mounds in many greens, pale reindeer-moss clusters, tiny ferns) washed by a warm LED strip under the top frame; a cut bamboo spout juts from the moss and trickles into a long honed basalt basin trimmed in brass with river stones under the water. Rings spread, mist lifts and the light breathes.

name: Thermostatic 6-Jet Body-Spray & Waterfall Shower Panel
note: Calacatta marble walls with soft grey-gold veins and a brushed-gold base trim, a white marble tray with a gold linear drain and a glass side screen with a slim gold profile. On the back wall, a tall smoked-glass shower panel framed in champagne gold, with six round gold body jets, a warm thermostat display reading 38.0° and a gold blade waterfall spout. The jets fire soft mist in turns, the waterfall pours and steam drifts up.

cat: Minor Table: Tub Caddy & Side Table
name: Brass & Travertine Rolling Spa Trolley
note: A brushed-brass tube trolley on four brass casters with two honed travertine shelves and a towel bar carrying a waffle hand towel. On top a glass carafe of cucumber-mint water with two tumblers; below a stack of folded white towels and a bowl of pink Himalayan bath salts with a wooden scoop. Condensation runs down the carafe and a glint travels along the brass.

name: Compact Smart Washer-Dryer Combo Hidden in Cabinetry
note: A run of rift-sawn white-oak cabinetry with shaker doors and brass knobs over a recessed toe-kick; the lower pocket doors are slid back to reveal a graphite front-loading washer-dryer set into the bay, with a chrome porthole on smoked glass, a detergent drawer and a slim touch strip glowing soft white with the time left. The drum turns, laundry tumbles, suds slosh and the display blinks.

name: Backlit Translucent Onyx & Self-Cleaning Nano-Ceramic Walls
note: Book-matched honey onyx from the brass band to the ceiling: nested wavy growth bands in amber, cream and caramel, milky crystal zones and dark resin veins, lit from behind with a warm glow that breathes. Below, pearl-white nano-ceramic panels on brass hairline seams, where water beads gather and roll off and a clean sheen wipes down after them. Bronze plinth with a champagne light line.

name: UV-Sterilizing & Lavender-Infusing Robe Warming Vault
note: A tall ivory-lacquer vault on a champagne-gold plinth under a gold crown: one closed door with raised gold-lined panels and a smoked display, one smoked-glass door showing a plush white robe on a gold rod over a lavender sachet. The robe glows in a slow UV-to-warm cycle, lavender mist curls inside, sparkles twinkle and the display ring fills.

name: Holographic Mountain Hot-Spring Window Illusion
note: A deep walnut window frame with a polished brass bezel that looks out on a snowy mountain hot spring at dusk: a violet-to-peach sky, the moon and twinkling stars, snowy peaks, a ryokan with glowing windows among snowy pines, and a rock-ringed pool where a snow monkey soaks with a towel on its head beside a stone lantern. Steam rises, snow falls and the layers drift with slow parallax for depth, with a faint iridescent sheen crossing the glass. A brass sill with an engraved plaque and a warm light line.

name: Thermal Hydro-Massage Glass & Heated Quartz Flooring
note: Warm white quartz slabs with soft grey and gold veins, polished brass seams with travelling glints and brass diamond keystones, framing a big walk-on glass panel in a brass bezel. Under the glass, warm-lit water: hydro-massage jets send up ribbons of bubbles while golden caustic light ripples across the basin. Steam curls up at the glass edge and the heated stone breathes a warm glow.

name: Sculpted Floating Alabaster Waterfall Basin with Sensor Faucets
note: A polished black marble panel with a gold inlay line; a sculpted block of translucent honey-white alabaster floats off it, glowing warm from within. A gold blade spout pours a clear sheet of water into its shallow basin, which overflows the front lip in a second sheet into a long gold-and-black-glass trough on the floor, with a gold sensor plate and its glowing ring. Ripples spread in the basin and the trough and a glint travels along the gold.

name: Cryo-to-Thermal Dual Chamber Bio-Rejuvenation Pod
note: Two tall pearl-white capsules with champagne-gold bands and finials on an oval marble plinth, joined by a slim column with a gold cap and a bio readout. The cryo window is frosted ice-blue with swirling mist and sparkling frost; the thermal window glows amber with rising heat waves. Readouts pulse, base light rings breathe mint and amber, and cold fog spills over the plinth.

name: 24K Gold Elixir Dispensers, Floating Lotus Candles & Crystal Singing Bowl
live: Gold flakes, lotus flames, sound rings
note: A white marble tray with a gold edge: two faceted crystal dispensers of golden elixir with 24k gold pumps and tiny ELIXIR plaques, a frosted quartz singing bowl on a plum silk ring cushion with a suede mallet, and a glass bowl of water with two blush lotus candles floating in it. Gold flakes twinkle, the flames flicker over ripples, and soft sound rings pulse from the bowl.

name: Atmospheric Rain-Cloud & Negative-Ion Mist Canopy
note: A honed charcoal stone ceiling with a champagne light line glowing in the shadow gap round a huge brass-framed canopy of luminous opal glass where soft clouds drift. A grid of polished brass rain nozzles twinkles in a slow wave, fine rain streaks fall from them, cool mist rolls beneath and negative-ion sparkles glint in the air.

name: AI Skin-Diagnostic & Holographic Styling Vanity Mirror
note: A large rounded mirror in a champagne-gold frame studded with glowing globe bulbs. In the glass a soft rose-gold hologram scans a cute creature face, shows little readings (hydration, glow, a sunscreen reminder) and floats a styling preview that cycles through a bow, a tiara and a flower crown.

name: Royal Pet Hydro-Massage & Diamond-Fur Grooming Sanctuary
note: A grand oval white-marble pool (7 bathing spots) on a stepped marble plinth with a 24k gold rim and gold jet rosettes, rose petals on the water, a gold swan fountain pouring into it and two gold lantern columns. The stream pours and splashes, jets swirl bubbles, diamond sparkles drift and the lanterns glow.

name: Circadian Bioluminescent Jellyfish Light Orbs
note: A polished brass wall rail with three swan-neck arms, each hanging a hand-blown glass orb on a fine brass chain. Inside each, a glowing moon jelly pulses and drifts among sparkling plankton. The light follows a slow day (dawn amber, soft daylight, dusk rose, night blue) and washes the wall behind, and the orbs gently sway.

name: Self-Drying Heated Moss & Silk Spa Carpet
note: A living oval carpet of preserved cushion moss in many greens: plump bun-moss mounds, fine sheet moss, tiny fern fronds and white star flowers, framed by a wide ivory silk border with a champagne-gold key pattern and a gold edge. A warm glow breathes underneath; dew twinkles on the moss and lifts away as faint wisps of steam.

name: Infinity-Edge Overflowing Thermal Mineral Pool with Whirlpool Jets
note: A pool of honed warm travertine capped in polished gold, filled with milky turquoise mineral water lit from below. The front is a knife-thin infinity edge where the water slides over in a glassy sheet into a gold-lined channel, a gold slot spout in the back wall feeds a thin waterfall, three whirlpool jets swirl rings of bubbles, and mineral sparkles and steam rise.

name: Floating Zero-Gravity Thermal Spa Lounge Bed
note: A sculpted zero-gravity lounger of quilted pearl panels with mint piping (raised head, cradled hips, lifted knees) hovering over a black glass disc ringed with mint light, with a lavender control orb floating at its foot. The under-light breathes mint to lavender, warm shimmer rises off the cushions, motes drift up through the gap and the orb pulses.

name: Bonsai Mist-Waterfall Island with Koi Pond Perimeter
note: A pond sunk into the floor, ringed with weathered granite stones, deep teal water lit warm from below round a craggy stone island crowned by an old juniper bonsai with silver deadwood over moss cushions; a thread of water slips down the rock, lily pads and a pink lotus float, petals drift. Five koi circle the island while low mist rolls off the water.

name: 360-Degree Sonic Mist & Vitamin-Infused Hydro-Capsule
note: A round walk-in pod: a polished gold plinth with a black-glass floor ring and a softly lit control strip, a curved wall of clear glass faintly tinted champagne, and a pearl-white and gold dome with a ring of mist nozzles. Warm citrus "vitamin" mist swirls round inside, sonic rings travel up and down the glass, droplets sparkle and the plinth light breathes.

cat: Minor Table: Tub Caddy & Side Table
name: Levitating Waterproof Holo-Book & Beverage Tray
live: Floating tray + turning pages + champagne bubbles
note: A honey-onyx puck glowing warm from inside, ringed in gold, holds a polished walnut tray with a gold gallery rail in the air: a crystal flute of champagne, a gold-rimmed dish of strawberries, water beading on the lacquer and a slim gold emitter projecting an open book of warm amber light. The tray bobs, pages turn, bubbles stream up and the light breathes.

name: Sonic Dry-Cleaning & Steam-Pressing Wardrobe Closet
note: A tall atelier wardrobe in figured walnut with gold pinstripe inlay and a gilded crown. Behind a full-height glass door, a warm-lit chamber holds a camel coat, a charcoal suit jacket, a cream silk dress and a white shirt on walnut hangers along a brass rail, steam drifting through them while slow rings of sound pulse from gold emitters above; beside it a closed walnut door with a gold dial ringed in amber light.

name: Grease-Splattered Drywall Behind Stove
note: Builder-beige drywall behind the stove: taped and mudded joints, screw pops, an unpainted spackle patch, a yellow haze from years of frying and amber grease splatter with runs (one drip slowly forms and falls), a scorch mark and a greasy outlet. The vinyl base is peeling.

name: Shallow Single-Bowl Stainless Sink with Leaky Tap
note: A shallow, dull stainless single bowl dropped into chipped beige laminate, with a rust halo round the crusty drain, water spots and scratches.
