The old two-handle chrome faucet has lost its cold cap, and a rag and duct tape are wrapped round its leaking base. Every couple of seconds a drop swells on the limescaled tap and plinks into a chipped "#1 DAD" mug. Below, a water-swollen laminate cabinet: the left door sags off a broken hinge, the right one has lost its knob, the edge banding is peeling and a "SAVE WATER!" sticker smiles on. A dingy dishcloth sways on the door. On the counter: a toothbrush cup, toothpaste, an almost-empty bottle of dish soap, a crusty sponge in a puddle and a pan of dried mac and cheese.

name: 3-Tier Plastic Rolling Utility Cart
note: A cheap three-tier rolling cart in off-white plastic gone yellow, on four grey swivel casters (one wheel swapped for a black one that doesn't match). Scuffs, grime in the corners, a cracked top lip patched with clear tape and a half-peeled $9.99 sticker whose corner flutters. On top: a paper towel roll, a ketchup bottle stored upside down on its cap over a crusty red stain, three speckled bananas and a jar of peanut butter. Middle: a stack of canned soup and beans, a box of Crunch-O's and two ramen cups. Bottom: a bleach jug, a blue spray bottle and a red mesh bag of onions. A white THANK YOU grocery bag hangs from the push handle and sways.

name: Tacked-Up Takeout Menus & Paper Towel Holder
note: Takeout menus tacked straight onto the wall with plastic push pins: Tony's Pizza (with a grease spot), the Golden Wok, a taped-up Taco Loco flyer whose half-torn coupon flutters, a Burger Barn coupon and a "pizza Fri!" sticky note. Below, a cheap white plastic paper-towel holder, one arm cracked and patched with duct tape; the hanging sheet sways.

name: Cracked Yellow Linoleum with curled corners
note: Old mustard-yellow vinyl squares with a marbled swirl, laid quarter-turned. Grime in the seams, cracked tiles, four corners curling up off the black glue, one tile missing (combed tar and stuck bits), grease spots in front of the stove and a scorched pot ring.

name: Plastic Dish Drying Rack & Dishpan
note: An old "FARM FRESH" apple crate standing in as a counter, with a gingham towel hanging off the front. A blue plastic dishpan of greasy water hides a few plates under the surface, a sponge waits on the rim and a fly buzzes overhead. Beside it, a white wire drying rack sits on a drip tray with two mismatched mugs and a cutlery caddy, next to a squeezy bottle of green dish soap and a little stack of side plates. Wash up and the foam builds while the sponge scrubs and bubbles rise; when it's done, clean plates and bowls stand in the rack, dripping into the tray and sparkling.

name: Cracked Glass Drip Coffee Pot
note: A yellowed Brew-Rite 12-cup drip coffee maker with a cloudy reservoir window (running low), a used filter peeking out from under the lid, a coffee streak down the front and old stain rings on the base. The glass carafe is cracked and held together with masking tape, with a dark ring above the old coffee. The red ON light glows, a drip falls from the basket every couple of seconds, the crack weeps a drop that sizzles on the warming plate, steam rises from the pot and every few seconds the machine gurgles and puffs from its back vent. A chipped MONDAY mug of coffee steams beside it next to a sugar packet and a stirrer.

name: Box of Cereal & Dish Soap Bottle
note: A battered box of Frooty Rings with a crushed corner, the top flap torn open and the crinkly liner bag poking out, next to a bowl of soggy rings in milk with a spoon, a few rings and a splash of milk on the floor. A half-empty green Lemon Fresh dish soap bottle with a crusty flip cap and a peeling label, and a grimy two-tone sponge. Every so often a soap bubble drifts up from the cap and pops.

name: Stained Acoustic Ceiling & Greasy Window Fan
note: An old drop ceiling of fissured acoustic tiles in a yellowed metal grid. Brown leak rings, one soggy tile sagging out of the grid, one tile missing with a wire loop hanging out, and over the stove a grease-caked exhaust fan that spins, rattles and drips.

name: Chipped Laminate Counter over Curtain-Skirted Shelves
note: A yellowed plywood counter with no doors, just a faded 70s daisy curtain on a sagging tension rod; one side is tied back with a gingham ribbon to show the shelves: a bucket and sponge, a bleach jug, a mousetrap with cheese, dented pots, a spray bottle and steel wool. The aqua boomerang laminate top has a ribbed aluminium edge with one length missing over chipped particleboard, a burn ring, knife cuts and a lifted seam. A bag of bread with a twist tie, red FLOUR and SUGAR tins and a stack of bills sit on top. The curtain sways, a line of ants marches to the bread and now and then a little mouse peeks out from behind the curtain.

name: Pop-Up 2-Slice Chrome Toaster
note: A worn chrome two-slice toaster with scratches, a dent, fingerprints, rust freckles and a black "Toasty" badge, a burn smudge by the slot, a bakelite lever and browning dial, and a frayed cord with a tape patch. Two slices of bread wait on a chipped plate with a butter knife. Tap to pop the bread in: the lever goes down, the slots glow, the dial ticks round and heat shimmers up; after 5 seconds the toast springs up golden (one corner a bit burnt) and steams.

name: Tiny Basement Hopper Window with Rust Screen
note: A tiny hopper window high up in a deep concrete well, the steel frame chipped and rusting down the wall. The sash tilts in on two arms, the insect screen is rusty and torn at a corner, and through the grimy glass you see the grass at ground level: a dandelion clock sways, a pigeon struts past, a snail creeps along.

name: Wobbly Folding Card Table with Vinyl Cloth
note: A wobbly folding card table under a red gingham vinyl cloth with fold creases, a coffee ring, a ketchup smear, a cigarette burn and a taped-up tear. The black enamel legs are chipped down to bare steel, and one has lost its rubber foot and stands on a folded piece of cardboard. Every few seconds the whole table rocks. On top: a steaming takeout box of noodles with chopsticks, a paper plate with a leftover pizza crust and a dented can of soda with a straw.

name: Open Pine Plank with Rusty Brackets
note: A knotty pine plank on bent, rusty iron brackets that have left drip stains on the wall. On it: a mason jar of wooden spoons, a chipped "#1 COOK" mug, a dented can of beans, a blue salt tub, Grandma's recipe book and a pothos trailing down. A plaid tea towel sways on a cup hook and a tiny spider bobs on its thread.

name: Tiny Dented Dorm Cube Mini-Fridge

cp.playS: Door open · light on · tap to close

note: A yellowed second-hand dorm cube on three wobbly feet and a folded cardboard shim. Dented door, a takeout menu under a pizza magnet, a photo strip, peeling smiley and EnergyGuide stickers, a scratched band sticker and a "my YOGURT!!" note. Duct tape holds the door shut, rust creeps along the bottom and cold mist seeps out of the tired seal into a little puddle. Every few seconds the compressor rattles the note and the spoon in the mug on top. Inside: a frosted-up freezer box, a wire shelf and some sad leftovers under a flickering bulb.

name: Mismatched Plastic Stackable Stool
note: A faded turquoise plastic stacking stool with a hand-knit pink and orange seat cozy that doesn't match at all; its two pompom ties sway. One cracked leg is wrapped in grey duct tape, three legs still have black rubber feet and the fourth stands on a red bottle cap. A half-peeled $2.99 sticker and scuffs on the skirt, and a fly that circles lazily above it.

name: Bare Fluorescent Strip Light
note: A bare fluorescent strip hung on two chains: a grubby enamel channel with two tubes, one burnt black at the end with a couple of dead bugs inside. The old tube stutters now and then and the pull-chain sways.

name: Single-Burner Plug-In Coil Hot Plate

cp.playS: Coil glowing · noodles bubbling · tap to switch off

note: A yellowed "HEAT-O-MATIC" single-burner hot plate balanced on an upside-down blue milk crate (the embossed DAIRYLAND letters read upside down). Greasy chrome drip pan with a heat-tinted ring, a black spiral coil, a dented saucepan of ramen with a wooden spoon and a salt shaker on the side. The frayed cord is patched with electrical tape (it sparks now and then) and runs into a cheap power strip. Switch it on and the coil glows red, the pilot light comes on and the noodles bubble and steam.

name: Rusty Metal Garage Shop Stool
note: A tall steel garage shop stool gone orange with rust: four splayed legs, a foot ring bent in four pieces, a threaded height screw under the seat and a cracked black vinyl pad patched with duct tape. Three legs still have rubber feet; the fourth is bare and scraped. A greasy red shop rag hangs over the foot ring and sways, and every so often a flake of rust drops to the floor.

name: Peel-and-Stick Faux-Tile Vinyl Backsplash
note: Peel-and-stick vinyl "subway tile" sheets over mint paint. The grout lines are printed flat and every tile has the same printed shine. The sheet seams do not quite line up, there are air bubbles, a rough cut round the outlet and one corner peeling off its sticky back. Cherry-red vinyl base.

name: Double-Basin Drop-In Sink with Pull-Out Sprayer
note: A brushed stainless double-bowl drop-in sink in speckled faux-granite laminate, over a light oak cabinet with raised-panel doors and brushed nickel pulls. The left bowl is full of soapy water over a couple of plates, suds drifting and bubbles popping; the right one holds a mug and a dish brush. A chrome pull-down faucet swings over the soapy side, and every few seconds its spray head gives the dishes a quick rinse. A blue-striped tea towel sways on the drawer pull. On the counter: a blue crock of spoons, a white soap pump, a sponge on a dish, two glasses drying on a mat and a pot of rosemary.

name: Wire & Bamboo Microwave Stand
note: A matte black wire stand on levelling feet with a carbonised bamboo top, a bamboo slat middle shelf with a back rail and a wire-grid bottom shelf. A white microwave with a smoky mesh window and a sticky note that says 2 MIN STIR!, its clock still blinking 12:00. A pothos on top of the microwave trails vines down the side that sway, next to a speckled crock of wooden spoons and a blue dish of lemons. Middle: nested mixing bowls, a jar of pasta and a basket of mint, chai and chamomile tea. Bottom: two big bottles of spring water and a twin pack of paper towels. An oven mitt and a striped tea towel hang from S-hooks on the side and sway.

name: Magnetic Wooden Knife Strip & Chalkboard Menu
note: A pine-framed chalkboard hung on jute twine from a nail, swaying a little: "Today's Menu" in chalk with pastel hearts, a cupcake and a steaming mug, old eraser smudges, chalk and a felt eraser on its ledge. Beside it an acacia magnetic strip holds a chef's knife, bread knife, santoku, a red paring knife, kitchen shears and a honing steel.

name: Black-and-White Retro Diner Vinyl Tile
note: Glossy black and white vinyl checkerboard like a 50s diner, each tile flecked with little chips, framed by a cherry-red border and a polished chrome strip. Waxed to a shine, with a few heel scuffs.

name: Countertop Portable Mini Dishwasher
note: A glossy white 6-place countertop dishwasher on a little white rolling cart, with rolled towels and a box of SPARKL pods on the lower shelf. A grey faucet hose loops off the back. It has a drop-down door with a smoky window, a dark control strip with a display and four buttons, and a tub of pods on top next to a stack of dirty plates. Load it and the door drops with the rack rolled out; while it washes, the window glows blue with a spinning spray arm, water jets, drips running down the glass and suds, water runs through the hose and a puff of steam escapes. Then the rack comes out sparkling and steaming, and the display reads DONE.

name: Single-Serve Pod Coffee Brewer
note: A glossy cherry-red Brew·Bud pod brewer with a clear water tank on the back, three cup-size buttons (the middle one ringed in breathing blue), a blinking amber DESCALE light and a slotted drip tray with old water spots. Every few seconds it brews: a little shudder, bubbles glug up the tank, a hiss of steam from the lid and a thin coffee stream into a polka-dot mug, then two last drips. A wire caddy of pods and a spent pod with a coffee puddle sit beside it.

name: Wire Fruit Basket & Glass Cookie Jar
note: A round black wire fruit basket on little ball feet piled with red and green apples, oranges, a pear and a bunch of grapes, with a curly wire hook holding a hand of ripe bananas that sways gently. Beside it a big glass cookie jar with a pale wood lid and a ceramic knob, half full of chocolate-chip cookies, a kraft "yum" tag on twine round its neck, and one cookie with crumbs on a little plate in front. A glint slides across the glass now and then.

name: Under-Cabinet Recirculating Range Hood
note: A cosy painted beadboard ceiling in soft buttercream: tongue-and-groove boards with rounded beads, nail heads and brush marks, a bundle of drying herbs on a brass hook, and steam from the under-cabinet hood curling along the boards.

name: Butcher-Block Counter with White Shaker Base Cabinets
note: Warm white shaker drawers and doors with brushed nickel cup pulls and knobs (a couple of scuffs down by the kick) under a thick oiled oak butcher block, with a white subway-tile splash. A crusty loaf and two slices wait on a board with a bread knife, beside a jar of wooden spoons, a bowl of apples and a mug of tea that steams. An open cookbook on a wooden stand shows Apple Crumble, its page lifting now and then. A red gingham towel sways on the drawer pull.

name: Retro Pastel Stand Mixer & Blender Duo
note: A retro tilt-head stand mixer and matching blender in your pastel: chrome hub and band, "Kitchenette" script and a speed lever. The balloon whisk spins through cake batter in a stainless bowl with splatters on the side, while the blender whirls a strawberry smoothie with a vortex and rising bubbles, its button lights running along the chrome panel. A bowl of strawberries sits on a gingham towel between them.

name: Double-Hung Window with Gingham Cafe Curtains
note: A white double-hung window with red gingham cafe curtains on a brass tension rod and a gathered valance. Outside, laundry sways on the line and a little bird visits the swinging feeder. A geranium sits on the sill and a glass suncatcher throws rainbow spots.

name: Rolling Pine Butcher-Block Prep Cart
note: A rolling pine prep cart with a thick edge-grain butcher-block top (knife marks and a water ring), a drawer with a white knob, a slatted lower shelf with wicker baskets of potatoes and onions, and four rubber casters, two with red brake tabs. A green-striped towel sways on the chrome bar at one end; a ladle, a whisk and a wooden spoon swing from S-hooks at the other. On top a rolling pin rolls back and forth over a floury sheet of dough, next to a blue bowl of brown eggs and carrots with a paring knife.

name: White Laminate Wall Cabinets
note: Cheap white laminate wall cabinets with yellowed edge banding (one strip peeling), chrome bar pulls and a left door that sags a little. The right door is left ajar on cans, peanut butter and cereal. A dusty basket and cookie tin sit on top, a strip light flickers underneath and three mugs sway on hooks.

name: Compact White Top-Freezer Apartment Fridge

cp.playS: Door open · light on · tap to close

note: A compact warm-white top-freezer fridge with a chrome "Chillmate" script. The freezer holds a crayon drawing and letter magnets; the fridge door has a grocery list with a pencil swinging on a string, a beach postcard, coupons in a clip, fruit magnets and a gold-star certificate. A gingham towel sways on the handle, an oven mitt hangs on the side and a pothos trails over the top next to the cereal and a basket of rolls. Inside: crisper drawers of veg, three glass shelves of food, a warm bulb and door bins with bottles and eggs.

name: Spindle-Back Painted Wooden Windsor Chair
note: A comb-back Windsor chair in sage milk paint: turned legs on an H-stretcher, a carved saddle seat and six spindles between two posts up to a crest rail with scrolled ears. The paint is rubbed back to warm maple on the seat front, the ears and the stretchers where feet rest. A red gingham tie-on cushion, its ties swaying at the back posts.

name: Enamel Barn-Style Hanging Pendant
note: A farmhouse barn pendant in glossy green porcelain enamel with a wide rolled white rim, chipped to black steel in a few spots, on a braided cloth cord. It sways gently with the bulb peeking under the rim.

name: 4-Burner Freestanding Electric Coil Range

cp.playS: Coils glowing · pancakes flipping · tap to turn off

note: A warm white enamel freestanding range with a chrome lip and "Hearthmate" script. Four coils sit in chrome drip bowls (two big, two small) under a backguard of chrome-skirted knobs, a little analog clock that ticks the seconds and SURFACE / OVEN lamps. A quilted red oven mitt sways on the chrome door handle over a black glass window, with a storage drawer below. A cast-iron skillet of pancakes, a red enamel kettle and a spoon rest with a wooden turner sit on top. Turn it on and the coils glow, the oven window lights up on a tray of cookies, a pancake flips and the kettle steams and whistles.

name: Backless Wooden Saddle Barstool
note: A backless honey-oak saddle barstool: a carved seat with a gentle dip and a raised front, on four splayed oak legs joined by a square of rungs; the front rung is worn pale where feet rest. A blue-striped tea towel is draped over one side of the seat and sways.

name: Glossy White Herringbone Subway Tile & Sage Walls
note: Glossy white subway tile laid in a true 45 degree herringbone, every tile a slightly different white with a glazed bevel, under eggshell sage walls, finished with a bullnose cap. A soft glint slides over the glaze.

name: Deep White Fireclay Farmhouse Apron Sink & Gooseneck Faucet
note: A deep, glossy white fireclay farmhouse sink with its apron standing proud of sage-green shaker cabinets with matte black cup pulls, under an oiled oak butcher-block top. A tall matte black gooseneck runs a thin, steady stream over an enamel colander of cherry tomatoes and radishes, droplets bouncing off. Now and then a glint of sunlight slides across the apron. A cream linen towel sways on the drawer pull. On the counter: an amber glass soap pump, basil in a white pot and an oak board with a halved lemon, a lemon and a paring knife.

name: Vintage Brass & Glass Tea/Bar Cart
note: A vintage bar cart in polished brass tube with two tempered-glass shelves in brass rails, a low gallery rail round the top, two big spoked brass wheels at one end and brass ball feet under a curved push handle at the other. On top: a cut-crystal decanter of whisky, two tumblers (one with ice), a hammered cocktail shaker, a gin and tonic with a lime wedge and rising bubbles, a bowl of lemons and limes and a bud vase of pink ranunculus that nod. Through the glass below: gin, a bottle of red, a brass ice bucket with tongs and a stack of linen napkins. A glint slides across each glass shelf now and then.

name: Wall-Mounted French Copper Saucepan & Skillet Rail
note: A black wrought-iron rail on scrolled brackets with polished brass finials. Hammered French copper hangs from S-hooks on long iron handles: a wide skillet, three graded saucepans and a little butter warmer, plus a copper ladle and a brass whisk. Each piece sways gently, its hammered bottom catching the light.

name: Terracotta Quarry Tiles with Warm Grout
note: Hand-made terracotta quarry tiles in fired orange to brick-brown, with wavy edges, darker kiln flashing, pits and chalky bloom, set in warm sandy grout. A cat walked over three of them before they were fired.

name: Built-In Stainless Quiet-Wash Dishwasher
note: A brushed stainless built-in under a speckled quartz counter, with a black toe kick, a black-glass control strip (display, programme icons, start) and a QUIETWASH 42 dB door. A sage linen towel sways on the tubular bar handle, and an amber soap pump and a pot of basil sit on the counter beside the dirty dishes. Open it to see the stainless tub, an upper rack of glasses and mugs, and the lower rack rolled out onto the door with plates, bowls and a cutlery basket. It washes so quietly that only a red light and the time projected on the floor show it is running; at the end the door drops on sparkling, steaming dishes.

name: Italian Chrome Dual-Boiler Espresso Machine & Burr Grinder
note: A brushed-chrome Italian dual-boiler espresso machine with two E61 group heads, lever paddles and walnut-handled portafilters, boiler and pump gauges, a red pilot lamp and a railed cup warmer of upside-down cups. Every few seconds it pulls two double shots into crema cups while the pump needle swings up to 9 bar, and the steam wand stretches milk in a steel pitcher. Beside it a black conical burr grinder with a bean hopper and grind dial trickles grounds into a dosing cup, next to a walnut tamper on a rubber mat.

name: Marble Mortar & Pestle, Olive Oil Cruet & Salt Pig
note: A heavy Carrara marble mortar with grey veins full of crushed peppercorns, rosemary and garlic, its pestle grinding in slow circles and flicking up a fleck now and then. A glass cruet of golden-green olive oil with a slim steel pourer, a soft light drifting through the oil, and a glazed terracotta salt pig of flaky salt with an olive-wood spoon. A sprig of rosemary and a garlic bulb lie beside them.

name: Stainless Steel Chimney Wall Hood & Recessed Pot Lights
note: A smooth matte white ceiling with eight recessed pot lights glowing warm in their grooved trims, a flush speaker grille, a slim slot vent by the stainless chimney hood and a crisp shadow-gap edge.

name: Speckled White Quartz Counter with Navy Soft-Close Cabinets
note: Deep navy slim-shaker cabinets with brushed brass bar pulls under a speckled white quartz top and splash. Every so often the cutlery drawer glides open on a bamboo organizer of forks, spoons, knives and a whisk, then closes slowly and silently. On top: glass canisters of pasta and coffee beans with bamboo lids, a sourdough boule on a round board, a white bowl of oranges and eucalyptus swaying in a slim white vase.

name: Digital Air-Fryer Toaster Oven & Sous-Vide Circulator
note: A matte black air-fryer oven: through the smoked glass the element glows and the convection fan spins behind a basket of fries and wings, with AIR FRY 200° and a timer counting down. Heat shimmers off the top vents. Next to it a clear sous-vide tub with a black circulator clipped on (57.0°), rising bubbles and ripples, and a vacuum-bagged steak with rosemary swaying in the water.

name: Sunny Herb-Garden Greenhouse Box Window
note: A glass greenhouse box pushed out past the wall, with a glass shelf and a zinc pebble tray full of terracotta pots: basil, rosemary, chives, thyme, mint and parsley all swaying in the sun. Sunbeams fall through the panes, a butterfly flits in the garden and a brass watering can waits on the stone sill.

name: 4-Person Round Oak Bistro Dining Table
note: A round four-person bistro table in oiled white oak: a plank top with a soft bevelled edge on a turned oak pedestal with four splayed feet. Four woven rattan placemats; one is set with a croissant and a cup of coffee that steams, another with a folded linen napkin and a fork. Salt and pepper mills and a speckled vase of yellow tulips swaying in the middle, with dappled sunlight drifting slowly across the top.

name: Glass-Front Mullion China Cabinets with Interior Lighting
note: A creamy painted shaker hutch with brass knobs and cup pulls under a honed marble counter with a lemon cake on a stand. Above, two glass doors with mullions show a warm-lit interior: blue-and-white plates on a brass plate rail, teacups on saucers, bowl stacks, a tureen and a pitcher.

name: Brushed Stainless French-Door Fridge with Ice Dispenser

cp.playS: Doors open · LED on · tap to close

note: Brushed stainless French doors over a freezer drawer, long tubular bar pulls on standoffs and a recessed ice and water dispenser with a soft LED light and a 37° / 0° display. Now and then an ice cube drops into the tray. Glass canisters of pasta and a vase of eucalyptus stand on top. Inside: bright LED light, a deli drawer, glass shelves with stainless trims (grapes, cheesecake, sparkling water, lemon water) and clear door bins.

name: Bentwood Thonet Bistro Chair with Woven Cane Seat
note: A classic bentwood bistro chair in dark walnut-stained beech: four tapered legs with felt pads, a bent leg ring fixed with little brass screws, and a round seat with a woven cane insert in a bent rim. The back posts rise into a big loop with a smaller loop and a cross rail inside, leaning gently back. A mustard knit scarf is draped over the top, its fringe swaying.

name: Trio of Ribbed Clear Glass Globe Pendants
note: Three ribbed clear glass globes on a slim brass canopy bar. Through the fine ribs you see an amber Edison bulb in each, its looped filament glowing, and every globe sways on its own cord.

name: 5-Burner Convection Gas Range with Cast-Iron Grates

cp.playS: Flames on · fan spinning · tap to turn off

note: A brushed stainless pro range with an island trim and three continuous matte cast-iron grates over five sealed burners, the middle one a dual-ring wok burner. Stainless knobs sit in red bezels around a blue LED display, and a big black glass convection door shows the rear fan and racks above vented kick plates. An orange enamel cocotte, a carbon-steel wok of stir-fry and a stainless pasta pot sit on the grates. Light it and blue flame rings flicker under all three, the bezels glow, the fan spins behind the glass with a chicken roasting, stir-fry hops out of the wok, the cocotte lid rattles and the pasta water boils.

name: Industrial Swivel Leather & Iron Tractor Stool
note: An industrial swivel stool: a black cast-iron base with four splayed legs on wide pads, rivets and a foot ring, a threaded swivel column and a pressed-iron tractor seat with drain slots round the rim. On top, a cognac leather pad with stitching and a ring of brass nailheads, its warm sheen shifting slowly. A leather strap with a brass buckle hangs from the seat and swings.

name: Hammered Copper Backsplash & Venetian Plaster Walls
note: Hand-hammered copper sheets with hundreds of little dents catching the light in rose, gold and brown, joined by standing seams with domed copper rivets and a polished half-round cap, under soft troweled Venetian lime plaster.

name: Workstation Hammered Brass Sink with Pot-Filler & Glass Rinser
note: A deep hammered-brass workstation sink in a cream Taj Mahal quartzite top, over bottle-green lacquered shaker cabinets with polished brass cup pulls and knobs and a warm glow under the toe kick. A walnut board of rainbow carrots and a chef's knife glides along the brass ledges inside the basin, and a glint of light slides round the polished rim. Beside the brass gooseneck, a glass rinser presses an upside-down wine glass and jets it clean, and a brass wall pot-filler swings out over a hammered copper stockpot, fills it and lets it steam. A striped linen towel sways on the brass bar, next to a brass bowl of pears.

name: Marble-Top Pastry Slab & Copper Pan Rack
note: An oiled walnut baker's cart on brass casters under a thick honed Calacatta pastry slab, with a slatted lower shelf holding a linen-lined basket of flour sacks and a stack of baking tins. Two polished brass uprights rise from the back to a rail where a copper saucepan, a sauté pan and a little butter warmer hang from S-hooks and sway, glints sliding round their rims. On the marble: a block of laminated dough dusted with flour, a brass-handled French rolling pin, a bench scraper, a tray of golden croissants still steaming, a jar of flour with a brass scoop and a jug of lavender. Flour motes drift over the slab.

name: Framed Vintage Wine Maps & Brass Utensil Gallery Rail
note: Two antique wine maps of Bordeaux and Burgundy on aged parchment, in walnut frames with a gilt fillet and linen mats, each lit by a polished brass picture light whose warm glow softly breathes. Below, a brass gallery rail holds olive-wood and brass utensils: ladle, skimmer, slotted spoon, whisk, fish slice, carving fork and pastry brush.

name: Wide-Plank Distressed French Oak Kitchen Flooring
note: Wide smoky French oak planks of random lengths: wire-brushed grain, cracked knots, hand-scraped ripples, old dents and wormholes, square oak pegs at the board ends and dark open joints, finished with a low oiled sheen.

name: Dual-Drawer Wood-Panel Integrated Smart Dishwasher
note: Two walnut drawer fronts with book-matched grain and slim brass edge lips, built in under a honed soapstone counter over a recessed black toe kick. Soft light lines glow in the gaps between the fronts: warm amber breathing at rest, a cyan shimmer running along them while it washes, with a puff of steam from the top slot. A wooden bowl of lemons, a linen napkin in a brass ring and the dirty plates with a wine glass sit on the counter. Load it and both drawers glide out: stainless tubs, glasses, mugs and a cutlery tray on top, plates, bowls and a cutlery basket below, and a little smart strip on the top drawer's edge. When it's done the drawers open on sparkling, steaming dishes.

name: Built-In Plumbed Latte-Art Barista Wall System
note: A built-in barista wall: walnut cabinet under a Calacatta counter, a fluted walnut back wall with a floating shelf of bean jars, cups and syrup washing it in warm light. The black-enamel machine with a brass bezel and amber display is plumbed in with brass pipes, a red hand-wheel valve and a glass water filter. Every few seconds it pulls two shots while a brass arm tilts a steel pitcher and pours a latte-art heart that grows in the cup.

name: Glass Cloche Cookie Jar with Choc-Chip Cookies
note: A tall hand-blown crystal cloche with a polished brass knob on a round Calacatta marble board with a brass rim, over a warm stack of chunky chocolate-chip cookies glowing softly underneath. Every few seconds the cloche lifts a little and a breath of warm steam escapes, and a glint slides round the crystal. Beside it a gold-rimmed plate with two more cookies, a glass bottle of milk with a striped paper straw and a folded linen napkin.

name: Custom Brass & Plaster Artisan Canopy Range Hood
note: Hand-troweled Venetian lime plaster with soft burnished sweeps. Above the island a recessed tray lined with hand-laid gold leaf glows from a hidden warm cove, edged in polished brass, under a deep plaster crown that goes with the brass canopy hood.

name: Walnut Fluted Cabinetry with Honed Soapstone Countertops
note: Book-matched walnut drawers with polished brass finger-pull strips (a glint runs along them now and then) over fluted walnut doors with round brass knobs, floating on a recessed plinth above a warm amber glow. A thick honed soapstone top and tall splash in soft grey-green with pale veins. A beeswax pillar candle flickers beside a cream stoneware vase of swaying olive branches, a brass tray with a crystal decanter of whisky and two tumblers, and a walnut bowl of figs.

name: Copper Commercial Pasta Extruder & Blast Chiller
note: A brushed stainless blast chiller with copper trims, a frosted glass door over shelves of pasta nests, an amber -18° display and a copper dial, with cold mist sinking from the door. On top a hammered-copper PASTAIO extruder with a dough hopper and turning paddle pushes bucatini out of its bronze die; the cutter sweeps round and the pieces drop onto a semolina-dusted tray. A walnut drying rack of tagliatelle sways beside it.

name: Steel-Frame Accordion Pass-Through Bar Window
note: Six thin black-steel glass panels that fold open like an accordion and close again, turning the window into a pass-through bar. The walnut bar top runs out onto the patio ledge, with cocktail coupes and a brass bowl of lemons; outside, string lights twinkle over a golden-hour terrace.

name: Waterfall Calacatta Marble Kitchen Island with Prep Sink
note: A waterfall Calacatta island: a book-matched marble slab that falls to the floor at both ends, over deep emerald lacquer slim-shaker drawers and doors with polished brass bar pulls. An undermount marble prep sink with a brass gooseneck: every so often the tap runs over a brass colander of grapes, and a glint slides along the marble edge under a warm pendant glow. White peonies in a glass vase, a walnut board with cheese, figs and grapes, and a carafe of lemon water with two tumblers.

name: Walk-In Butler's Pantry with Rotating Brass Spice Carousels
note: A butler's pantry in deep green lacquer with brass bin pulls and little labelled spice drawers under a Calacatta marble counter. Open walnut shelves lit by warm strips hold glass canisters, copper pots and cookbooks, copper ladles hang from a brass rail, and two brass spice carousels slowly turn on the counter.

name: Built-In Glass-Front Sub-Zero Chef's Refrigerator & Wine Column

cp.playS: Door open · light on · tap to close

note: A built-in chef's refrigerator and wine column clad in walnut with brass edge strips, a stainless face frame, a brass louvred grille and a little "SOUS·ZÉRO" plaque over a glowing toe-kick line. Through the glass door: warm LED light, brass-trimmed glass shelves, a parmesan wheel, a dry-aged parcel, berry punnets, a glass milk bottle, preserves, a lemon tart on a stand, champagne and basil in a glass of water. Next to it, behind bronze-tinted glass, seven walnut racks of wine lie necks-out under breathing amber light, with a decanter on top and a 12° display.

name: Upholstered Bouclé & Brushed Brass Dining Armchair
note: A nubbly ivory bouclé dining armchair: a plump round seat on a brushed-brass plinth and four tapered brass legs, low curved arms capped with a brass band and a rounded back rising behind them. A caramel cashmere throw lies over one arm, its fringe swaying, and now and then a glint slides down the brass legs.

name: Linear Hand-Forged Brass & Alabaster Island Chandelier
note: A long hand-forged brass bar with scrolled ends, hammer marks catching the light, holding five veined alabaster drums in brass cups. Each stone glows warm from inside and a glint slides along the brass.

name: 6-Burner French-Top Dual-Fuel Heritage Brass Range

cp.playS: French top glowing · ovens heating · tap to turn off

note: A heritage French range in deep bleu nuit enamel with polished brass everywhere: bun feet, trims, eight fluted knobs and a MAISON DORÉE medallion between two jewel pilot lamps. A striped linen towel sways on the full-width brass rail as a glint slides along it. Below are a gas oven and a narrow electric oven, each with a brass-framed panel, a bar pull and a round thermometer. The black enamel deck has six brass-capped burners on cast-iron grates around a cast-iron French-top plaque. A copper stockpot with a bouquet garni and a copper saucier of béarnaise sit on top, and the brass-trimmed back shelf holds a utensil crock, a salt pig, olive oil and a pepper mill. Light it and flames lick the stockpot, the French top glows red from the centre with a heat shimmer, the lamps light and both thermometers climb.

name: Tufted Velvet Counter Stool with Brass Footrest
note: A counter stool in emerald velvet: a plump round button-tufted seat with gold buttons on a brushed-brass ring, a low curved velvet back with a brass band, four slim brass legs and a brass footrest ring. The velvet sheen drifts slowly and glints slide down the brass legs.

name: Bookmatched Patagonia Quartzite Slab with Interactive Recipe Display Wall
note: Floor-to-ceiling book-matched Patagonia quartzite lit from behind: milky quartz with clusters of black, smoky and caramel crystals, mirrored at a brass seam. A frameless smoked-glass display set into the stone pages through recipes with a timer ring. Bronze plinth with a champagne light line.

name: Ultrasonic Wave-Clean Basin in a Royal Calacatta L-Kitchen
note: A Royal Calacatta L-kitchen: fluted ivory lacquer runs with champagne-gold reveals floating over a soft amber glow, a book-matched marble top with a waterfall end and low marble backsplashes. The integrated marble basin is trimmed with a gold inlay; soft ultrasonic rings ripple across the water from a glowing gold ring while fine bubbles rise round a crystal glass and a bowl of strawberries. A sculptural gold arc faucet stands over it. Beside it the instant tap cycles its modes: boiling water into a gold-rimmed teacup, sparkling water into a coupe and golden broth into a celadon bowl. A bowl of lemons, white hydrangeas and a marble tray with olive oil and salt.

name: Autonomous Robotic Sous-Chef Delivery Cart
note: Rolls back and forth delivering. A polished ivory ceramic robot cart with champagne-gold trims, floating on a dark base over a warm amber glow while a light chases round it. A black-glass strip reads TABLE 4 · 0:42. On its gold gallery tray: seared scallops under a silver cloche, a dish of macarons and a flute of champagne with rising bubbles. At the back a slim gold neck carries a friendly black-glass face with amber eyes that blink; the head tilts now and then, and every few seconds a jointed gold arm lifts the cloche and steam curls out.

name: Digital Smart-Glass Recipe Wall & Floating Spice Orb Rack
note: A frameless smoked-glass recipe wall in a champagne-brass bezel, glowing warm. It pages through Saffron Risotto, Lemon Meringue Tart and Coq au Vin with the current step lit, a timer ring and the ingredients. Beside it, two floating walnut shelves of glass spice orbs (saffron, paprika, turmeric, pink pepper, cardamom, black pepper, fleur de sel, sumac) bob over soft pools of light.

name: Anti-Fatigue Heated Cushion-Stone & Self-Sweeping Vacuum Plinth Floor
note: Large book-matched cream Calacatta slabs with soft pillowed edges that spring back underfoot, their grey and gold veins flowing from slab to slab. Polished brass seams glow warm from the heating, brass keystones glint at the corners, and gold dust drifts into a bronze-and-brass vacuum plinth under a champagne light.

name: 30-Second Plasma-Steam Sanitizing & Robotic Dish-Shelving Unit
note: A low graphite cabinet with iridescent edge strips, floating on a dark plinth over a violet glow, with a black-glass ring timer and a dish vault below. On top stand a glass plasma chamber with a violet emitter ring, a white-and-graphite robot arm with a cyan eye on its wrist, and a hovering glass plate rack. The arm lifts each dirty plate from the rack into the chamber; then violet plasma fills the glass with flickering arcs and a glow sweep while the ring timer fills, 30 seconds and done. Finally the arm shelves the gleaming plates back in the rack while steam curls out of the empty chamber.

name: 3D-Printed Foam & Bean-to-Cup AI Sommelier Beverage Hub
note: An ivory ceramic tower with champagne-gold trims floating over a warm glow. Its smoked-glass display shows a breathing flavour wheel and tasting notes cycling through Ethiopia, Colombia and Kenya, next to a pearl AI orb with an amber iris. In the arched brew bay a gold print head draws a little bear face into the foam of a glass cup, line by line. On top, a gold carousel of three bean hoppers (light, medium, dark) clicks round; a marble tasting paddle holds espresso, cold brew and nitro.

name: Silent Whisper-Vortex Downdraft & Ionizing Air-Purifier Ceiling
note: Book-matched slabs of honey onyx lit from behind so the whole ceiling glows warm, joined by polished brass seams. In the middle a brass-rimmed vortex slowly turns its brass vanes, drawing in drifting gold motes without a sound.

name: Self-Healing Obsidian U-Kitchen with Motorized Lift Cabinets
note: A U-shaped kitchen in seamless polished obsidian: deep black stone with smoky depths, fine champagne-gold veins and a slow reflection across the top, waterfall ends on both runs, handle-less smoked-obsidian fronts with gold reveals and finger channels floating over a warm amber glow. A glass-fronted lift cabinet of crystal wine glasses, plates, gold-rimmed cups and spice jars glides silently down into the counter until its cap is flush, then rises again. Now and then a knife scratch appears in the stone, a thread of molten gold runs along it and it fades back into seamless obsidian. A white orchid in a gold pot, a chocolate cake under a glass dome, a hammered-gold bowl of pomegranates and espresso for two on a gold tray.

name: Holographic 3D Food Synthesizer & Instant Pastry Printer
note: An ivory Calacatta block with champagne-gold trims floating over a warm glow. Under a glass cloche a gold gantry prints a fraisier layer by layer (sponge, cream with strawberry halves, pink glaze and berries) while the panel's progress bar fills. Beside it a gold emitter projects a pearl hologram of a macaron tower with a rising scan ring and orbiting sparkles. A croissant and three macarons wait on a gold tray sliding out of the front.

name: Smart Hydroponic Vertical-Farm Panorama Window
note: Frameless floor-to-ceiling glass on a golden-hour valley, lined with polished brass gutters on fine hangers: butterhead lettuce, basil, kale, herbs and strawberries that slowly ripen. Warm grow-light bars glow down, water trickles gutter to gutter, mist puffs now and then, over a bronze planter base with a champagne light line.

name: Gilded Teppanyaki & Smart-Scale Chef's Island
note: A chef's island in fluted walnut with champagne-gold reveals over a warm amber glow, under a thick Nero Marquina slab that cantilevers far out past the base. The floating end holds a brushed-steel teppanyaki plate in a gold rim: shrimp, scallops and zucchini sizzle and hop, steam curls up, heat shimmers and a gold-handled spatula scrapes the plate. The smart scale is a flush black-glass square in a gold rim, its amber readout weighing a slate of marbled wagyu. A black bowl of yuzu and a sake set on a walnut tray.

name: Patisserie Pantry
note: A cream lacquer and polished brass patisserie cabinet on a bronze plinth with a champagne light line, under a blush-and-cream scalloped awning. In the middle an arched glass vitrine glows pink, and a three-tier brass cake stand slowly turns: cupcakes, macaron towers and little cakes, with a strawberry cake on top. On each side a glass candy cabinet of apothecary jars (gumballs, lollipops, jelly beans, peppermints, cookies, marshmallows) twinkles over labelled drawers.

name: AI Holographic Cryo-Pantry & Auto-Inventory Smart Mega-Fridge

cp.playS: Door open · light on · tap to close

note: An ivory ceramic-glass mega-fridge veined like Calacatta marble and trimmed in champagne gold, floating on a recessed plinth over a soft glow. Smoked obsidian glass doors show a warm-lit pantry of sushi on slate, cold-pressed juices, figs and grapes, caviar on ice, strawberry shortcake, a macaron tower under a cloche, champagne, a cheese board and preserves, while a scan line quietly sweeps the shelves. A pearl hologram floats in front of the right door with a turning apple and live stock levels. Below, the frosted cryo drawer holds gelato pints in drifting frost at −18°; open the door and cryo fog spills to the floor.

name: Ergonomic Heated Floating Dining Pod Seat
note: A polished ivory ceramic egg pod floating a hand's width above a black-glass disc in a champagne-gold rim: a rounded bowl, a cognac leather seat and a hood that curves up round the back like an egg, with a tufted leather back pad inside. The seat breathes a warm amber glow, heat shimmers above it, warm light pools under the pod and a ring of gold ticks turns slowly in the glass.

name: Suspended Living Herb-Halo Grow-Light Chandelier
note: A polished brass halo on four fine cables, planted all round with living basil, purple basil, rosemary and thyme. Trailing thyme hangs over the edge, a warm grow-light glows under the ring and dew twinkles on the leaves.

name: Invisible Induction Countertop & Molecular Laser-Bake Smart Oven

cp.playS: Halos on · laser-bake running · tap to turn off

note: A polished ivory quartz block veined in grey and gold with champagne-gold trims, floating on a dark recessed plinth over a soft glow. The top is one seamless slab: the four induction zones are only hinted by faint etched rings and tiny gold ticks. A black-glass touch band holds a zone map, an AURA display with a breathing standby light and a power slider, over a handle-less black-glass oven with a gold laser rail, a glass tray and a soufflé inside. A matte black sauté pan of seared scallops, a borosilicate glass pot of eggs and a marble salt cellar with a gold spoon sit on top. Start cooking and cyan halos ripple up through the stone under both pans with floating SEAR 210° / SIMMER 98° readouts, the scallops sizzle and bubbles rise through the glass pot; in the oven seven violet lasers flicker onto the soufflé, a scan line sweeps, the tray levitates and the soufflé rises.

name: Auto-Height Adjusting Hydraulic Levitation Bar Stool
note: A bar stool that hovers a hand's width above a black-glass disc in a champagne-gold plinth, held up by a warm amber beam. A gold hover bell, a fluted gold hydraulic sleeve with a little 78 height readout whose arrows pulse, a gold collar and a mirror-chrome piston carry an ivory nappa seat with channel stitching and champagne nailheads and a low curved nappa back capped in gold. The gold foot ring floats on its own round the sleeve. A gold halo turns in the hover gap as motes drift up through it, gold ticks circle in the glass and the glow underneath breathes slowly.

name: Rusted Chain-Link Fence with Gaps
note: Dull galvanised pipe posts with rust blooms and streaks, one leaning, hold a sagging top rail and diamond chain-link mesh with rusty patches. There is a torn hole with cut wire ends and a peeled-back flap, and the bottom of the mesh is curled up over a hollow dug underneath. A plastic bag is snagged on the wire, and weeds and a bindweed vine grow along the base. The bag flutters, the flap and a loose tie wire swing, and the weeds sway.

name: Rusty Portable Charcoal Hibachi Grill
note: A heavy cast-iron hibachi with casting ribs, flaky rust, sliding draft doors, wooden end handles and twin grates on notched posts. A torn paper sack of briquettes slumps beside it with a few spilled on the ground, rusty tongs lie in front and grey ash dust marks the ground underneath. Tap to light the coals.

name: Junkyard Charm: Flamingo & Garden Gnome
note: A sun-faded plastic pink flamingo on two bent wire legs, with chipped white spots and a scuffed beak, beside a small resin garden gnome with a faded red hat, a chipped beard and a tiny shovel. They stand in a scruffy patch of grass with a dandelion. The flamingo wobbles on its wire legs in the breeze and the dandelion nods.

name: Patchy Dirt Yard with Crabgrass & Mud Puddles
note: A neglected yard of sun-baked brown dirt with dry cracks, pebbles, wheel ruts and thin dead grass. Scruffy clumps of crabgrass, half green and half straw-yellow, sprawl here and there, and two brown mud puddles reflect a grey sky, with sneaker and paw prints pressed into the mud around them. A rusty bottle cap and a popsicle stick lie in the dirt. Drips ring the puddles and the crabgrass stirs in the breeze.

name: Sun-Bleached Cracked Plastic Lawn Chairs
note: Two cheap resin stacking chairs gone yellow-grey in the sun, with hairline cracks, dirty water marks on the seats, a missing back slat and a split leg patched with silver duct tape. Grass grows up between the legs. Seats 2.

name: Old Rubber Tire Filled with Potting Soil
note: An old cracked rubber tire with worn tread, filled with potting soil and a few marigolds, with soil spilled on the ground and weeds growing round it.

name: Torn Blue Tarp Tied to Broomsticks
note: A sun-faded blue tarp with metal grommets, tied with frayed yellow rope and a bungee cord to four mismatched broomsticks. One still has its broom head, two lean, one stands in a bucket of rocks and one in a cinder block. It sags into a rain puddle, has duct-tape patches and a couple of holes, and one corner is torn off with a flap hanging down. The flap flutters, the tarp breathes and water drips from the flap.

name: Scraggy Sapling Supported by Twine
note: A scraggy little sapling tied to a bamboo cane with fraying twine, with a plastic nursery tag, a ring of dry dead leaves and weeds round it.

name: Cinderblock & Unpainted 2x4 Plank Bench
note: Grey weathered, unpainted 2x4 planks laid across stacked cinderblocks, with splits, rusty nail heads, chipped block corners, moss in the block holes, a cobweb under the seat and a squashed soda can by a block. Seats 2.

name: Inflatable Plastic Kiddie Pool
note: A blue inflatable kiddie pool, a little sun-faded, with grass clippings and a dead leaf floating in it and a green garden hose snaking over the rim. Seats 2.

name: Circle of scavenged Bricks & Campfire Twigs
note: A rough ring of mismatched broken bricks and a couple of stones on scorched dirt, with a tepee of twigs burning low over grey ash, a crumpled newspaper ball and a marshmallow stick dropped by the ring. Small flames flicker, embers float and thin smoke rises.

name: Upended Plastic 5-Gallon Bucket
note: An orange plastic 5-gallon bucket turned upside down as a seat-side table, with scuffs, a hairline crack and a ring of dirt where it sat. Tap to tip it over.

name: White Painted Wooden Picket Fence
note: A cosy white-painted picket fence: pointed pickets on two rails and square posts with pyramid caps. Wood grain shows faintly through the paint, a few chips show bare wood, the bottoms carry a little dirt splash and one picket leans a touch. A pink climbing rose winds up a post, tulips and daisies line the base and the pickets cast stripes of shadow on the lawn. The flowers nod and a butterfly flits past.

name: Classic Red Kettle Charcoal BBQ
note: The classic red enamel kettle grill: glossy dome lid with a chrome vent and thermometer, black handle, ash catcher, triangle rack and two wheels. A grill brush and a spatula hang from the side handle, a chimney starter waits on the ground and a little grease drip runs down the bowl. Tap to grill.

name: Solar-Powered Plastic Pathway Stake Lights
note: A row of five cheap black plastic solar stake lights pushed into the lawn, one leaning and one with a cracked cap: thin stems, frosted faceted lanterns and little blue solar cells on top. Each throws a soft glow on the grass. The glows breathe gently and the leaning one flickers on a low battery.

name: Cottage Garden: Copper Wind Chime & Birdhouse
note: Copper chime tubes with green verdigris hang from a black shepherd hook beside a weathered cottage birdhouse on a post, with grain showing through peeling paint, moss on the roof edge and a little bird peeking from the hole. Birdseed is scattered underneath and pink cosmos grow at the foot of the post. The chimes sway and ring.

name: Seeded Green Clover & Ryegrass Lawn
note: A young lawn grown from a ryegrass and white clover seed mix: soft bright grass with patches of three-leaf clover and little white-pink pom-pom flowers. A couple of thin spots have not filled in yet and show soil, seed and golden straw mulch. A dandelion and a few daisies pop up. The grass waves in slow rows and the clover flowers nod.

name: Folding Wooden Adirondack Chair Pair
note: A cedar Adirondack chair with a tall slatted back that rounds over at the top, wide flat arms, a sloped slatted seat and grain silvering in the sun. A red plaid blanket is folded over one arm and an enamel mug of cocoa sits on the other. Steam curls from the mug and the blanket fringe stirs.

name: Cedar Raised Vegetable Garden Bed
note: A cedar raised bed planted in rows: butterhead lettuces, feathery carrot tops, a staked tomato with red and green fruit and little wooden row markers. The leaves stir in the breeze.

name: Cottage Garden: Galvanized Drinks Tub & Gingham Napkins
note: A galvanised beverage tub full of ice and bottles, beaded with condensation, with a red checkered napkin holder beside it. The ice cubes glint.

name: Crank-Open Striped Patio Umbrella
note: A crank-open patio umbrella with blue and cream canvas panels that sag softly between the ribs, stitched seams, a pinstripe band near the rim and a little sun fading. It has a raised wind vent with a finial, a scalloped valance, white steel ribs, a two-piece pole with a crank handle and a tilt button, a moulded base and a tie strap hanging from one rib, and it casts soft shade on the ground. The canopy breathes, the valance flutters and the strap swings.

name: Dwarf Meyer Lemon Tree in Half-Barrel
note: A dwarf Meyer lemon tree in a half-barrel planter, dotted with lemons and white blossoms, with a couple of fallen lemons on the ground.

name: Painted Wooden Potting Shed with Window Box
note: A cosy sage-green board-and-batten potting shed with white corner boards and a cedar shingle roof. It has a cream door with a four-pane window and a brass knob, a white window with blue-grey shutters and a window box of red geraniums, white alyssum and trailing ivy, a heart cut-out in the gable and a black lantern by the door. A potting bench at the side holds terracotta pots, seedlings and a watering can. The flowers nod, the ivy sways, the lantern glows and a butterfly visits.

name: Cast-Iron Park Bench with Oak Slats
note: A cast-iron park bench with oak slats: chipped black paint showing rust on the iron, weathered slats with grain, a few fallen leaves on the seat and a small brass plaque on the back rail. One leaf skitters in the breeze. Seats 2.

name: Above-Ground Timber-Wall Plunge Pool
note: An above-ground cedar-wall plunge pool with steps, a rolled towel and a lantern on the cap, and light shimmering on the water. Seats 3.

name: Redwood Classic A-Frame Picnic Table
note: A classic redwood A-frame picnic table with grain and knots, a checkered cloth, a jar of lemonade beaded with condensation and a citronella bucket candle flickering on the table. Seats 4.

name: Plastic Cornhole Boards & Beanbags
note: A pair of plastic cornhole boards with red and blue beanbags scattered on the grass and one on a board. Tap to play.

name: Portable Steel Bowl Fire Pit
note: A black steel bowl fire pit on curved legs with a spark screen ring, a few seasoned logs stacked beside it and a fire poker leaning on the rim. Tap to light the fire.

name: Rough-Cut Tree Stump Side Table
note: A rough-cut tree stump side table with moss on the bark, crack lines through the rings and a cluster of little mushrooms at its foot. A trail of ants marches over the top.

name: Horizontal Cedar Privacy Slat Fence
note: A tall modern privacy fence of horizontal western red cedar boards in honey to reddish-brown, with long grain, the odd knot and narrow, even gaps. A cedar cap rail runs along the top between black powder-coated steel posts, a small black wall light washes the boards with warm light, and ornamental grass grows in a gravel strip at the base. Leaf shadows drift across the boards, the grass sways and the light glows softly.

name: 4-Burner Stainless Propane Grill & Smoker
note: A brushed stainless cart grill with a two-door cabinet on casters, a domed hood with a thermometer and handle, four black knobs and an igniter, a side shelf with a spatula, tongs and a brush on hooks over a white propane tank, and a black steel offset smoker barrel with a firebox door and chimney. Tap to grill: the hood swings open on steaks, corn and peppers, flames lick the grates, the knobs glow and smoke pours from the hood and the smoker.

name: Edison Bulb Bistro String Lights Across Yard
note: Strands of amber Edison bulbs criss-cross the yard from the house gutter to posts on the fence tops: black sockets, teardrop glass and glowing filaments with warm halos, bigger toward the front. The bulbs flicker softly out of step and the strands sway a touch.

name: Tuscan Terrace: Stone Sundial & Tiered Birdbath
note: A two-tier cast-stone birdbath on a fluted pedestal, its small upper bowl spilling into a wide lower basin, beside a short stone sundial pedestal with a bronze dial, engraved hour lines and a gnomon. Moss and lichen grow on the stone and a sparrow bathes in the lower basin. Water trickles down, ripples spread, the sparrow dips and flicks water and the gnomon shadow creeps round.

name: Manicured Zoysia Turf with Flagstone Stepping Path
live: Wind sheen and sun dapples drift
note: A dense, carpet-like zoysia lawn cut short with crisp mowing stripes, and a curving path of irregular bluestone flagstones set flush in the turf, with pale worn tops, a little moss in the joints and clean grass edges. Wind sheen slides across the stripes and soft sun dapples drift over the lawn and stones.

name: Woven All-Weather Wicker Sectional Sofa with Navy Cushions
note: A dark espresso resin-wicker L sectional with basket weave on every face and a woven rim, deep navy seat and back cushions with white piping and a chaise end. It has throw pillows in white with a navy stripe, coral and sand, a knitted throw over the chaise and a woven tray with a candle lantern and glasses. The lantern flickers. Seats 4.

name: Tiered Terracotta Herb & Strawberry Tower
note: A tiered terracotta tower of herbs and strawberries, with ripe berries hanging over the pocket lips and small white flowers. A bumblebee buzzes round it.

name: Wisteria-Draped Cedar Pergola
note: A cedar pergola with notched rafters under a fresh green leaf canopy. About forty long wisteria clusters hang down, pale lilac at the top deepening to violet at the tips, and vines spiral up the posts. Underneath is a cushioned bench with lavender and cream pillows and a stone table set with a teapot and two cups, in dappled shade. The clusters sway, petals drift down and the shade shifts. Seats 2.

name: Woven Rattan Hanging Egg Swing Chair
note: An egg of honey rattan in a diagonal weave with a woven rim round the opening, hanging by a chain from a black steel C-stand on a weighted base, with a thick cream seat cushion, a back cushion and a mustard pillow. The egg sways gently on its chain.

name: Blooming Pink Weeping Cherry Blossom Tree
note: A weeping cherry tree in full pink bloom, with a carpet of fallen petals round the trunk and more petals drifting down.

name: Victorian Cedar & Glass Greenhouse
note: A Victorian glass house on a red-brick knee wall, with a cedar frame and glazing bars, a glass gable roof with white ornamental cresting and turned finials, a propped roof vent and a glazed cedar door. Inside are slatted benches with terracotta pots, tomato vines with red fruit, ferns and a hanging basket, with condensation beading on a few panes. A sheen glides across the glass, the vent breathes open and shut and the hanging basket sways.

name: Curved English Limestone Garden Bench
note: A curved English limestone bench with lichen and moss on the stone, ivy creeping up the legs, a folded linen cushion and an open book on the seat. The ivy stirs and a page lifts in the breeze. Seats 3.

name: Natural Rock Waterfall Koi Pond with Lily Pads
note: A natural stone koi pond with a little waterfall, lily pads and koi, with a blue dragonfly darting over the water.

name: Mosaic Tile & Wrought-Iron Bistro Table
note: A round bistro table topped with colourful mosaic tiles on a scrolled wrought-iron base, with an espresso cup steaming beside a little pot of basil.

name: Outdoor Ping-Pong Table
live: Ping-pong ball rallies over the net
note: A weatherproof blue ping-pong table on a folding steel frame with two paddles; the ball rallies back and forth over the net. Tap to play (2 players).

name: Terracotta Mexican Chiminea Fireplace
note: A terracotta Mexican chiminea with a painted band, a smoke stack and a glowing mouth, with a little stack of wood and a saucer of pine cones beside it.

name: Glazed Cobalt Ceramic Barrel Garden Stool
note: A barrel-shaped porcelain garden stool in deep cobalt glaze with two raised nail-head bands, pierced coin openings on the sides and a white crackle-glaze top. The glossy glaze glints.

name: Ivy-Covered Limestone Garden Wall with Wrought-Iron Railing
note: A dressed limestone garden wall in warm cream courses with fine recessed joints and a moulded coping stone. Two square pillars with stone caps carry iron lanterns either side of an arched black wrought-iron double gate with scrollwork and gilded spear tips, with a garden path glimpsed through it. English ivy cascades over the coping. The lanterns flicker warm on the stone and the ivy tendrils sway.

name: Built-In Stone Outdoor Kitchen with Wood-Fired Pizza Oven
note: A stacked fieldstone outdoor kitchen with a thick honed quartzite counter, a stainless built-in grill with a hood, two stainless access doors and a board of tomatoes, basil and olive oil. At the end stands a domed terracotta pizza oven with a brick-arched mouth, an iron door leaning against it, a black flue and a log store underneath; embers glow low inside. Tap to fire it up: flames roar, a pizza bakes in the mouth and smoke rises from the flue and the grill.

name: Architectural Brass Uplights for Trees & Pathways
note: A planted strip in grey river-pebble mulch with a steel edge: a slim Japanese maple with red leaves and two clipped boxwood balls, each lit from below by a polished brass bullet uplight with a glare snoot on a knuckle stake, plus two short brass louvred path bollards that throw pools of light on the pebbles. The warm beams breathe, glints slide on the brass and the maple leaves sway.

name: Zen Temple Garden: Limestone Buddha & Pagoda Lanterns
note: A raked white-gravel garden with ripple rings round mossy boulders and a seated limestone Buddha in meditation on a lotus plinth, with robe folds, hands resting in the lap, a serene face and a topknot, weathered with lichen. Two stone pagoda lanterns glow warm, a stone water basin is fed by a bamboo spout and moss cushions and mondo grass edge the gravel. The lanterns flicker, water drips from the bamboo and rings spread in the basin.

name: Travertine Paver Courtyard with Moss-Inlaid Checkerboard
note: A courtyard checkerboard of honed, tumbled travertine squares in ivory, cream and walnut tones, each with soft banding and the little open pits travertine is known for, alternating with squares of velvety cushion moss with tiny red-brown spore stalks. Warm late sun lies across it. Leaf shadows drift slowly over the stone and dew twinkles on the moss.

name: Teak Daybed Cabana with Flowing Linen Curtains
note: An oiled teak daybed platform with a thick white mattress, bolsters and sand and sage pillows under a four-post teak canopy with a taut linen roof. Long sheer linen curtains are tied back at the rear posts and flow loose at the front, and a rolled towel and a teak tray with a citrus drink sit on the corner. The front curtains billow, the back ties sway and the ice in the drink glints. A spot to nap.

name: Zen Temple Garden: Brass Ice Bucket & Bonsai Shears
note: A polished brass ice bucket with ring handles, full of ice and a bottle, a cut-crystal pitcher of cucumber water and black-and-gold bonsai shears on a walnut tray. Light glints over the crystal and brass.

name: Motorized Louvered Aluminum Bioclimatic Cabana
note: A charcoal aluminium bioclimatic cabana whose roof louvers tilt open and shut on their motor, with a warm light line round the frame. It stands on an oiled teak deck with a cream wool rug, a deep cushioned sofa with throw pillows, a teak coffee table with a brass hurricane lantern, a potted olive tree and sheer linen drapes tied back at the front posts. The drapes sway, the candle flickers and warm light pools on the deck. Seats 2.

name: Suspended Cedar Porch Daybed Swing
note: A cedar daybed swing with a thick mattress and pillows, hanging on ropes from a cedar A-frame, with a brass candle lantern at one end of the beam, a trailing fern basket at the other and warm string lights wound along it. The bed swings, the lantern glows and the lights twinkle. Seats 2.

name: Ancient Twisted Mediterranean Olive & Cypress Grove
note: An ancient twisted olive and tall cypresses over gravel and lavender, with fallen black olives, a weathered terracotta urn on its side and bees buzzing over the lavender.

name: Heated Saltwater Lap Pool with Sunken Sun Shelf
note: A long heated saltwater lap pool in travertine with lane ropes and a sunken sun shelf, light dancing on the water and faint steam curling off the warm shelf. Seats 4.

name: 10-Foot Reclaimed Teak Harvest Dining Table
note: A ten-foot harvest dining table of reclaimed teak with a linen runner, three brass candlesticks with flickering tapers and wine glasses that catch the light.

name: Sunken Concrete Conversation Pit with Linear Gas Fire Table
note: A square sunken conversation pit edged in board-formed concrete with built-in benches and charcoal cushions, around a long low concrete fire table with a bed of glass beads and a row of dancing flames. Warm light glows on the walls.

name: Cast-Bronze Lattice Drum Side Table
note: A drum of cast bronze in an open interlocking lattice with a warm patina and polished high points, a smoked-glass top and a hurricane candle inside. The candle flickers and its light dances through the lattice.

name: Living Vertical Rainforest Wall with Acoustic Force-Field Perimeter
note: A tall living wall planted like a rainforest: deep moss behind ferns, split monstera leaves, red and orange bromeliads, white and pink orchids and trailing vines, held in a dark bronze frame over a long honed-stone planter with warm uplights. Above it a faint iridescent hexagon force field shimmers. Misting nozzles breathe little clouds, the fronds sway, the force field ripples and the uplights glow warm.

name: Automated Teppanyaki & Rotisserie Chef Pavilion with Outdoor Fridge
note: Under a slim bronze canopy with a warm light line and two glass pendants stands a black marble island with gold veins on walnut slats. A white robot arm flips shrimp and vegetables on a mirror-steel teppanyaki plate, a chicken turns in a glass rotisserie cabinet over a glowing element, and a glass-door outdoor fridge glows full of bottles. Steam and sizzle rise and the pendants breathe.

name: Firefly-Swarm Micro-Drone Ambient Light Choreography
note: A sculptural docking plinth of black marble with a polished brass band and a frosted glass cap ringed with soft light. Twenty-one tiny glass-orb drones glide in slow figure-eight loops in three layers, glowing gold, pale lime and warm white like fireflies; each blinks out of step and trails fading ghosts of light, and warm light pools on the lawn.

name: Sky Garden: Levitating Mirror-Chrome Wind Sculpture
note: A low plinth of polished black granite with a brass inlay ring, with a mirror-chrome sphere floating above it inside three nested chrome rings that turn on different axes, reflecting sky and garden. A faint cool glow shines under the float. The sphere bobs, the rings turn at their own speeds and the glow and shadow breathe with the bob.

name: Bioluminescent Star-Moss Lawn & Heated Porcelain Patio Deck
live: Moss glows in waves, deck shimmers
note: A velvet lawn of deep emerald star moss with a raised patio deck of large porcelain slabs in warm white, with soft grey and gold veins running across the joints and a polished sky reflection. A bronze edge and a warm light line wash the moss below the step. Pale mint specks in the moss glow in slow waves and glowing spores float up, while a glint slides over the heated slabs and the warm deck gently shimmers.

name: Sky Garden: Holo Star-Map Globe & Floating Carafe
note: A holographic star-map globe turning over a dark pedestal, with constellation lines glowing across it, beside a self-chilling carafe floating in mid-air.

name: Retractable Geodesic Glass Conservatory Dome
note: A geodesic dome of triangular glass panes in a slim bronze frame on a honed marble plinth with a polished brass ring. Inside are a teak daybed with cream cushions and terracotta and saffron pillows, a potted fan palm, a fern, a brass side table and a brass chandelier hanging from the top. One wedge of panes slides open and closed, a sheen glides over the glass, the chandelier glows warm and the palm sways. Seats 2.

name: Giant Bioluminescent Spirit-Willow Tree
note: A giant spirit-willow whose curtain of glowing strands sways in slow waves, with glowing roots spreading across the ground, spirit motes rising and a soft light pooled under the canopy.

name: Floating Glass Zen Tea Pavilion over Water
note: A koi pond with lily pads, stepping stones and a stone lantern, with a hinoki-timber tea pavilion standing in the water on slim posts. It has frameless glass walls in thin bronze frames, a shoji screen at the back and a deep charcoal-copper hip roof. Inside are a low tea table with a tea set, two cushions and a paper floor lantern, and a red maple leans over the water. Koi swim, ripples spread, steam curls from the teapot and the lanterns glow. Seats 2.

name: Glass-Walled Infinity Lagoon with Swim-Up Bar & Grotto Waterfall
note: A glass-walled infinity lagoon with a rock grotto waterfall and a swim-up bar, with light shimmering across the water. Seats 5.

name: Illuminated Onyx & Waterfall-Channel Banquet Table
note: A banquet table of backlit honey onyx with a water channel running down its length. Light pulses slowly through the stone and a shimmer runs down the channel.

name: Floating Water-and-Fire Obsidian Obelisk Hearth
note: A black obsidian obelisk floating over a ring of fire and a water moat, with embers rising around it and a warm glow on the water.

name: Solar-Charging Levitating Drink Pedestal
note: A sleek solar pedestal that holds a drink floating in mid-air above its charging cells. A glint sweeps over the cells and the floating glass beads with condensation.

name: Self-Cleaning Hydrophobic Cushion-Weave Patio Tapestry
note: A plush quilted outdoor tapestry of pearl-white pillow cells with an iridescent sheen and champagne piping. Water beads roll off to the edges, the seams pulse with light as it cleans itself and a sheen slides across.

name: Scuffed Eggshell Drywall with Poster Tack Marks
note: Tired eggshell paint over drywall with roller stipple and lap marks, a taped seam showing through with two nail pops and a hairline crack. Brighter rectangles show where posters hung for years, with greasy blue-tack stains, leftover blue and white tack and pulled-off paint at the corners, plus pin holes, a bent nail, grey furniture scuffs, a black shoe scuff, a cracked almond outlet painted round its edge and a cheap MDF skirting with chipped paint. A torn poster corner still stuck under yellowed tape flutters in the draught.

name: Cardboard Moving Box Next to Mattress
note: An upturned double-wall moving box doing duty as a nightstand: soft scuffed kraft board with corrugated edges, THIS SIDE UP arrows now pointing down, a red FRAGILE stamp, marker scrawl "BEDROOM - MISC" crossed out and replaced with "BOOKS!!", a crushed top corner, packing tape across the top and down the front with a torn end curling off, a coffee ring on top and hand-holes on the sides. The torn tape end lifts and flutters in the draught.

name: Plastic Folding Stool
note: A sun-faded sky-blue plastic folding stool: a rounded top with a carry slot and a grid of anti-slip dimples, two leg panels with big cut-outs, cross braces, grey hinge rivets and scuffed feet, white stress marks at the hinges, a crack bound with clear tape and a half-peeled $3.99 sticker. One leg is a bit short, so now and then it rocks and settles.

name: Paper Star Cutouts Taped Above Bed
note: A kid-made night sky above the bed: wonky hand-cut stars in yellow construction paper with scissor nicks and pencil lines still showing, two in crinkled kitchen foil, one crayon-coloured and one crusted with glitter glue, and a smiling crescent moon cut from a cereal box and painted yellow, the printed cardboard showing at a torn edge. Everything is stuck up with yellowed clear tape and masking tape, with glow-in-the-dark plastic stickers in between, a torn tape scrap where a star fell and a faint pencil guide arc. One star hangs by a single corner of tape and swings in the draught while the glow stickers glow softly.

name: Cold Splintery Subfloor Planks
note: Bare rough-sawn pine subfloor boards gone grey, with uneven dark gaps between them, circular-saw swirls, lifting splinters, rows of rusty nail heads over the joists, a knothole right through, one fresher yellow patch board, old white paint drips and a roller swipe, a water ring, a leftover tack strip along the wall, carpet-pad crumbs and dust bunnies. A cold draught breathes up through the gaps.

name: Clip-On Plastic Desk Lamp
note: A cheap clip lamp clamped onto a stack of three old paperbacks for a base: black spring-clamp jaws with a rusty spring, a crinkled chrome gooseneck and a yellowed white plastic dome shade with a heat-browned vent ring, with a bare bulb glowing under it and a thin white cord with an inline switch trailing off the books. The bulb flickers now and then and a moth circles the light.

name: Battered Wooden Footlocker Trunk
note: An old pine footlocker in scuffed olive-drab paint worn to bare wood on every edge, with dented tin corner caps, riveted steel straps, a sprung hasp with no padlock, rope side handles (one frayed), a faded stencil "PROPERTY OF - BUNK 7" and a peeling band sticker. The lid sits ajar on a striped sock caught in it, which sways gently.

name: Half-Empty Water Glass & Paperback Book
note: A well-thumbed paperback lying face-down and open, with a cracked spine, dog-eared corners, yellowed page edges and a coffee ring on the cover, beside a cheap ribbed tumbler half full of yesterday's water with bubbles clinging inside and a fingerprint smudge, sitting in its own wet ring. Now and then a bubble lets go and rises, and light shimmers through the water.

name: Water-Spotted Plaster Ceiling
note: Old lath-and-plaster gone ivory-yellow, with trowel swirls, the faint ghost lines of the joists and a network of hairline map cracks. Three old brown tide-ring water stains, and one fresh dark one where the plaster sags into a bulge with a crack across it. A patch of white filler someone sanded and never painted, paint flakes lifting to grey plaster and a tired cove moulding. A drop of water slowly swells under the fresh stain, lets go and falls.

name: Bare Bulb with Paper Origami Shade
note: A yellowed plastic ceiling rose with paint overspray, a twisted white flex and a cream bakelite lampholder, with a bare pear bulb hanging half out of a home-folded paper shade: a faceted origami lantern in cheap printer paper, a bit lopsided, one facet split and mended with tape and a brown scorch where it sits too close to the bulb. The bulb flickers now and then, the paper glows warm and the whole thing sways in the draught.

name: Narrow Plastic-Frame Wall Mirror
note: A tall narrow budget mirror in a yellowed white plastic frame hung on two bent wire hooks, its thin acrylic glass warping the reflection, with a photo-booth strip tucked into one corner, a dusty smudge, a peeled price sticker and a cracked corner held with clear tape. Now and then the flexible glass makes the reflection wobble.

name: Drafty Window with Paper Accordion Shade
live: Paper shade flutters in the draught
note: An old single-hung wood window with its white paint flaking to grey wood. The sashes gap at the meeting rail, foam weatherstrip peels off and hangs, a cracked pane is held with yellowed tape and the lower corners fog with condensation. A cheap pleated paper shade is stuck on with its adhesive strip, half down, one pleat torn and the cord lock clipped crooked. Outside are a grey sky, the neighbour's brick wall and a bare branch, and a rolled towel blocks the draught on the sill. The paper pleats flutter, faint cold wisps slip in under the sash, the branch sways and a dry leaf blows past.

name: Wobbly Metal Garment Rack with Wire Hangers
note: A cheap chrome-look garment rack gone dull, its top rail bowing, one upright joint wrapped in duct tape and one caster missing, so that foot is propped on a paperback. Wire dry-cleaner hangers hold a dry-cleaning bag over a white shirt, a grey hoodie, a red flannel shirt and folded jeans, plus one bare hanger. A wire shelf below holds a pair of sneakers and a shoebox. The whole rack wobbles, the clothes jiggle and the empty hanger swings.

name: Shoebox Lined with a Hand Towel
note: An old brown cardboard shoebox with one corner crushed and a strip of masking tape across the front with a scribbled name and a heart, lined with a faded striped hand towel whose frayed corner flops over the front edge. The lid lies behind it, and a chewed tennis ball and a knotted sock toy wait beside it. The tennis ball rocks a little and the towel corner stirs.

name: Thin Twin Foam Mattress Directly on Floor
note: A sagging thin foam twin mattress straight on the floorboards, its faded ticking cover split at one corner to show yellowed foam, a blue fitted sheet half pulled off, one flat yellowed pillow and a red-and-grey fleece blanket kicked into a heap at the foot. On the floor are a cheap alarm clock, a phone on a long charging cable, a mug and a face-down paperback. Now and then the phone lights up with a notification, and the clock's colon blinks.

name: Plastic 3-Drawer Sterilite Tower
note: A frosted white plastic 3-drawer tower on little casters, colourful clothes blurred behind the drawer fronts. The top drawer is stuck half open and overstuffed, a sock is caught in the middle drawer and dangling out, and a stack of folded T-shirts and a hair tie sit on top. Beside it is a blue plastic laundry basket heaped with clothes, a red sleeve hanging over the edge. The caught sock sways.

name: Small Acrylic Bathmat Beside Bed
note: A cheap peach acrylic bath mat pressed into service as a bedside rug, lying a bit crooked: pilled synthetic fuzz with a faint embossed seashell, a flattened grey patch where feet land every morning, bleach spots, crumbs and a hair, a dropped grey sock, and the back corner curling up to show the cracked rubber backing.

name: Pilled Polyester Blanket & Flat Pillow
note: A faded maroon polyester fleece blanket folded sloppily in three, covered in pills and lint, its satin binding frayed and coming loose in a dangling strip, with a flat yellowed pillow sagging on top and a loose thread trailing to the floor. The loose binding sways and a little static spark crackles now and then.

name: Lap Tray on the Bed
note: A scuffed white plastic lap tray with fold-out legs and a raised lip, doing duty as a desk: a steaming cup of instant noodles with a fork, a spiral notebook with doodles and a pen, a phone propped up beside it, crumbs and a ring stain. Steam curls from the noodles and the phone lights up with a message.

name: Ticking Wind-Up Alarm Clock & Box Fan
note: A yellowed beige plastic box fan with a dusty white grille (fluff caught in the corners), a cracked carry handle mended with tape, a three-speed dial and a faded brand sticker, its blades spinning behind the grille with a strip of paper tied on that streams in the breeze. Beside it a chrome twin-bell wind-up alarm clock on two splayed legs, with the hammer between its bells, a key on the back and a yellowed dial. The blades spin, the paper streamer flutters and the second hand ticks.

name: Soft Lavender & Cream Painted Walls
note: Soft lavender matte paint above a white painted chair rail, with warm cream below.
