A fresh but home-painted job: faint roller stipple and lap bands, a slightly wavy cut-in line along the rail with one tiny lavender drip on the cream, a touch-up patch that dried a shade off, the soft shadow of the ceiling corner, a white outlet and a satin white skirting. A warm patch of afternoon window light slides slowly across the lavender.

name: Single-Drawer White Pine Nightstand
note: A budget flat-pack pine nightstand in thin white paint with the grain showing through: a single drawer with a turned wooden knob and a hairline gap, an open shelf below on square legs, a chipped corner showing raw pine, a ring mark and a scuff on the top and a cam-lock cap on the side. On the shelf sits a stack of paperbacks with a red ribbon bookmark hanging out, swaying gently.

name: Faux-Fur Round Vanity Stool
note: A plump round stool upholstered in long shaggy blush-ivory faux fur that spills over the edge and hides the base, with a soft dip in the middle of the seat, on four short tapered gold-tone legs with felt pads (one leg worn through to silver). The fur ripples in a soft draught and a sheen moves over it.

name: Macramé Woven Wall Hanging & Fairy Lights
note: Natural cotton macrame on a pale driftwood dowel, hung from a nail by a cord loop: lark's head knots over the dowel, a band of square knots, an alternating square-knot net that opens into a V, a big double-half-hitch diamond round a gathering knot, spiral twists down both sides and a long brushed-out fringe cut in a V. Copper-wire fairy lights are draped in swags from coloured push pins either side, ending in a little battery box. The lights twinkle in a slow wave, throwing warm spots on the wall, and the fringe sways.

name: Beige Loop-Pile Bedroom Carpet
note: Wall-to-wall oatmeal berber in tight looped rows, heathered with darker and lighter flecks, with vacuum stripes, a matted traffic lane to the bed, a faded coffee stain, a couple of snagged loops, a flattened square where a dresser stood and a line of dust along the skirting. A warm patch of morning light drifts across with dust motes glinting in it.

name: Ceramic Base Table Lamp with Pleated Shade
note: A plump gourd-shaped ceramic base in sage-green crackle glaze with a cream foot ring, a brass neck and harp with a little finial, and a box-pleated cream linen drum shade glowing warm from inside, on a linen cord. The shade's glow breathes softly and the pool of light beneath it warms and cools.

name: Upholstered Linen Storage Ottoman Bench
note: A long ottoman in warm oatmeal slub linen: a deep padded lift-up lid with a button-tufted top and flax piping round both edges, a gathered pull-tab at the front where it opens, linen-wrapped sides with soft wrinkles at the corners, on four turned beech legs, with a chunky cable-knit cream throw slung over one end. The throw's tassels sway and a soft sheen moves along the lid.

name: Ceramic Ring Cone, Sleep Mask & Lavender Pillow Spray
note: A little hand-thrown ring cone on a saucer in speckled oatmeal glaze holding a thin gold band and a silver ring with a tiny stone, a dusty-rose satin sleep mask with a ruffled edge and a looped elastic, and a frosted lilac bottle of lavender pillow spray with a silver pump and a kraft label printed with a lavender sprig. Now and then a fine puff of mist drifts from the sprayer, and the rings glint.

name: Flat White Ceiling with 3-Blade Paddle Fan
note: A freshly rolled flat white ceiling with faint roller laps, one taped seam ghosting through, a nail pop and a grey dust halo round the fan. A budget white ceiling fan on a short downrod: plain white motor housing, three light-oak laminate blades on white steel irons, a switch housing with a small frosted bowl light and two pull chains with wooden beads, plus a round smoke alarm off to one side. The blades turn on low, the pull chains sway and the alarm LED blinks now and then.

name: Woven Bamboo Drum Flush-Mount
note: A white steel ceiling plate holding a shallow drum of hand-woven bamboo: honey and natural strips in an over-under basket weave with braided rims, warm light leaking through every gap, a rice-paper diffuser glowing underneath and dappled spots of light thrown onto the ceiling around it. The dapples shimmer and the glow breathes.

name: Freestanding Oak Cheval Tilt Mirror
note: A tall honey-oak cheval mirror: a framed, bevelled mirror tilting between two turned uprights on trestle feet, with brass tilt knobs, a slim stretcher bar and a cotton scarf hung over one upright. A glint slides slowly down the glass and the scarf's fringe stirs.

name: Casement Window with Sheer Lace & Blackout Curtains
note: A white-painted wood casement pair: the left sash shut with a cockspur handle, the right one pushed open outward on its stay arm. A floral lace sheer hangs inside, the open side billowing into the room, and over it a pair of dusty-navy cotton blackout curtains hang from a wooden pole with ball finials, tied back with fabric tiebacks. A little succulent sits on the sill. Outside is a sunny garden with a lilac tree, a hedge and the neighbour's roof, and a butterfly flits past.

name: 2-Door White Laminate Armoire
note: A flat-pack white laminate wardrobe on a grey kick plinth with two doors and slim aluminium bar handles. The right door's hinge has dropped, so it never quite shuts and keeps drifting open on a dark glimpse of hanging clothes. The edge banding is peeling at the top corner, there is a barcode assembly sticker on the side, a canvas tote hangs off the left handle, and a rattan basket and a taped cardboard box sit on top. The door creaks open a little and drifts back, and the tote sways.

name: Plush Donut Cuddle Cushion
note: A round calming donut bed in oatmeal-and-blush shag faux fur: a high fluffy rim all the way round a sunken cushion, with a non-slip base peeking out underneath. A folded blue fleece blanket and a plush carrot toy lie in the hollow. A soft sheen travels round the rim and the carrot's leaves wiggle.

name: Pine Platform Frame with Spring Mattress
note: A honey-pine platform bed with a plank headboard and a low footboard, a white quilted spring mattress with blue border tape and side vents, a faded blue gingham duvet with the white sheet turned down, two plump pillows and a well-loved plush bunny. A warm sunbeam drifts slowly across the duvet and the bunny's ear flops.

name: 4-Drawer Pine Chest with Wooden Knobs
note: A honey-pine chest of four graduated drawers with turned wooden knobs, a rounded overhanging top, a shaped plinth and visible knots, the top drawer sticking out a hair. On top are a crocheted doily, a small framed photo, a ceramic trinket dish with a ring, a jar candle and a trailing pothos in a terracotta pot. The candle flickers and the pothos sways.

name: Soft Cream Moroccan Berber Shag Rug
note: A Beni Ourain-style cream wool shag with long soft pile and lighter tips, an irregular hand-knotted charcoal diamond lattice (each line a run of dark knots) with a few wobbles, tasselled fringe on both short ends, slightly flattened where it is walked on. A soft sheen rolls through the pile.

name: Crisp Cotton Percale Duvet & Down-Alternative Pillows
note: A neatly folded set of crisp cotton percale: white duvet cover folds with a navy stitched hem stacked on a soft blue-stripe fitted sheet and pillowcases, wrapped in a kraft paper band with a little swing tag on twine, and two plump down-alternative pillows stacked beside it. The swing tag turns on its string and a sheen slides along the folds.

name: Compact Folding Laptop Writing Desk
note: A small birch-ply folding desk with white steel A-frame legs that fold flat and a slim rail underneath. On it are an open laptop, a mug of tea with the tag hanging out, a pencil cup, a cluster of sticky notes and a little succulent. Lines of text type out on the laptop with a blinking cursor, and the tea steams.

name: White-Noise Sound Machine & Cool-Mist Humidifier
note: A squat cream sound machine with a slotted lid, a ring of side vents and a soft amber power dot. Beside it a pebble-shaped ultrasonic humidifier: a frosted clear tank half full of water on a white base with a warm amber night-light ring and a mist nozzle, sitting on a knitted coaster. A cool mist plume rolls up from the nozzle, the water trembles, the night-light breathes and soft sound ripples ring out of the vents.

name: Botanical Chinoiserie Wallpaper & Wainscoting
note: Hand-painted-style chinoiserie paper on a soft celadon ground with a linen weave: two flowering plum trees in umber brush strokes covered in blush and white blossoms and buds, a stand of bamboo with ink-green leaves and a little indigo songbird perched on a branch. Below, a sage-painted raised-panel wainscot with a moulded cap rail, bevelled panels and brush marks in the satin paint, a slim outlet on a stile and a matching skirting. Flecks of mica in the paper glimmer as the light moves.

name: Mid-Century Cane & Walnut 2-Drawer Bedside Table
note: An oiled American walnut case with softly rounded edges and long straight grain, two drawers faced in hand-woven rattan cane framed in walnut with slim brass pulls, a lipped top, on four splayed tapered legs ending in brass ferrules. A warm sheen slides along the oiled top and the brass pulls glint.

name: Velvet Scalloped-Back Shell Chair on Gold Casters
note: A round blush-rose velvet seat in a curved shell back of seven stitched channels, each rising to a rounded scallop (tallest in the middle), on a slim polished-gold frame ring with four short tapered legs on gold ball casters. The velvet sheen drifts slowly across the channels and seat.

name: Framed Pressed-Flower Botanical Gallery Set
note: Five slim natural-oak frames hung as a gallery, each with a deep bevel-cut white mat and a pressed specimen on cream cotton paper, faded the way real pressed flowers fade: a big bracken fern frond with a sprig of Queen Anne's lace, a violet pansy, a pink cosmos, three lavender sprigs tied with raffia and golden ginkgo leaves, each with a pencilled Latin label. A soft glint travels along the glass from frame to frame.

name: Honey Oak Hardwood Floors
note: Narrow honey red-oak strips with random butt joints, open cathedral grain and ray flecks, a few darker mineral streaks and tight hairline joints under a satin finish, with a couple of fine scratches by the bed and a chair-leg dent. The window reflection slides slowly across the boards.

name: Articulated Brass Swing-Arm Wall Sconce
note: A round brushed-brass backplate with a rocker switch, a two-section swing arm with knurled knuckles and a tension knob, a linen cord running along the arm and a brass cone shade lined in white enamel, angled down to throw a warm reading cone. Dust motes drift through the beam and a glint slides along the brass.

name: Woven Leather & Teak Mid-Century Daybed Bench
note: An oiled teak frame on tapered legs with brass ferrules, its deck and raked head end strung with saddle-leather straps in a tight basket weave, every strap stitched and wrapped round the side rails, with a round cognac leather bolster with button-centred ends and a folded mustard wool throw with fringe at the foot. A warm sheen slides along the leather and the brass ferrules glint.

name: Crystal Carafe Set, Leather Journal & Brass Bookmark
note: A cut-crystal night carafe half full of water with its tumbler upturned over the neck, standing on a little round brass tray, beside a tan pebbled-leather journal with a wrap tie, gilt-edged pages and a slim brass leaf bookmark on a silk tassel. Light catches the crystal facets in turn and the bookmark's tassel sways.

name: Vaulted Shiplap Wood Ceiling with Exposed Beam
note: White-washed pine shiplap running up both slopes of a vault to the ridge, the left slope catching more light than the right, each board a hair different with soft grain, a dark nickel gap and a few knots ghosting through the wash. A chunky rough-sawn oak ridge beam with saw marks, drying checks and black iron strap brackets with bolt heads. A warm band of late sun from the gable window slides across the boards with dust motes glinting in it.

name: Capiz Shell Tiered Coastal Chandelier
note: A white-washed iron frame of three tiers hung from a jute-wrapped chain, every ring strung with strands of thin round capiz shells on fishing line: translucent pearly discs, each a slightly different white with a faint pink-gold sheen, some turned edge-on, with warm bulbs inside glowing through them. The strands sway and the shells shimmer as they turn.

name: Oversized Arched Brass Floor-Leaning Mirror
note: A huge arch-topped mirror in a slim brushed-brass frame leaning back against the wall on two felt pads, with a soft shadow behind it, a linen throw draped over one side and a small trailing pothos in a terracotta pot at its foot. A glint slides down the arch and the pothos leaves sway.

name: Cozy Cushioned Window Seat Alcove with Shutters
note: A deep sage-painted alcove with a built-in window seat. A many-paned window sits at the back with louvred white shutters folded open against the side walls. The seat has a thick striped linen cushion with piping, scatter pillows in rust velvet, cream knit and mustard check, a chunky knit throw over the edge, an open book and a mug of cocoa, with two drawers and brass cup pulls below. A warm wall light glows in the nook. Outside it is raining on a green garden: drops trickle down the panes, the trees sway and steam curls from the mug.

name: Sliding Mirrored-Door Reach-In Closet
note: A built-in reach-in closet in white with a pale oak fascia and two full-height bypass doors of mirror in slim brushed-aluminium frames on top and floor tracks. Behind them is a warm-lit interior: an oak rail of shirts, knits, dresses and a coat, a shelf of folded sweaters and storage boxes with a warm LED strip beneath, and a slanted shoe rack. The front mirror door glides open to the left and back, and a glint slides down the glass.

name: Miniature Canopy Four-Poster Pet Bed
note: A little four-poster in oiled walnut with slim turned posts and ball finials, a woven-cane headboard, a thick sage linen mattress with piping, a cream bolster and a knit throw folded over the corner. Ivory linen valances hang round the canopy rails, sheer voile drapes are tied back at the four posts and a string of tiny warm lights loops along the top. The sheers sway and the little lights twinkle.

name: Queen Tufted Linen Upholstered Bed with Pillow-Top
note: A softly rounded upholstered frame in oatmeal linen with a tall button-tufted headboard and piped edges on slim walnut feet, a deep white pillow-top mattress with crisp white sheets, sage linen euro shams leaning on the headboard, two white sleeping pillows, an ochre velvet lumbar cushion with tassels and a sage linen duvet folded across the foot. A warm sheen glides across the tufted headboard and the lumbar's tassels sway.

name: 6-Drawer Mid-Century Teak Lowboy Dresser
note: A long low teak dresser with book-matched horizontal grain and six drawers in two banks, each with a sculpted recessed finger pull along its top edge, on splayed tapered legs with brass ferrules. On top are a stack of art books, a speckled ceramic vase of dried pampas and bunny tails, and a brass tray with a perfume bottle. The pampas plumes sway and a warm sheen slides along the oiled top.

name: Faux-Sheepskin Pelts & Woven Wool Runner
note: A long flat-woven oatmeal wool runner with rust, ochre and charcoal bands, a stepped geometric border and knotted fringe, with two faux-sheepskin pelts (one ivory, one dove grey) thrown over it, their curly fluffy edges spilling onto the floor. A slow sheen drifts over the fur.

name: Washed Belgian Flax Linen Bedding & Chunky Knit Throw
note: Stone-washed Belgian flax bedding in clay, oatmeal, sage and natural, softly rumpled with frayed hems and stacked in a low woven seagrass basket with rope handles. A cream chunky-knit throw with fat loops spills over the rim with a pom tassel, and a sprig of dried lavender tied with twine lies on top. The pom swings and the lavender nods.

name: Hollywood Lighted Makeup Vanity Table with Drawer
note: A white lacquer vanity table with a slim centre drawer and gold tapered legs, and a big Hollywood mirror in a white frame ringed with round warm globe bulbs standing at the back. On the table are an acrylic organiser of lipsticks, a pressed-powder palette, a cup of brushes, a glass perfume bottle and a little blush ring dish. The bulbs glow and breathe, one flickers now and then, and a glint slides across the mirror.

name: Smart Sunrise Alarm, Air Purifier & Essential Oil Nebulizer
note: A tall cylindrical air purifier in a warm grey knitted fabric sleeve with a pale oak top, a perforated outlet and a soft air-quality ring. Next to it a frosted round sunrise lamp on a white stand with a dim clock below its face, and a little walnut and glass nebulizer with an upside-down amber bottle of lavender oil. The sunrise face slowly fills with dawn, deep red to orange to warm white, and fades back; the purifier ring breathes with air shimmering off its top, and a fine scented mist curls up from the nebulizer.

name: Padded Velvet Acoustic Headboard Wall & Walnut Paneling
note: Book-matched American walnut veneer across the top, with mirrored cathedral figure, a dark mineral streak and a satin oil finish under a warm wash of cove light, over a slim brushed-brass reveal. Below, floor-height channel-tufted olive velvet: each channel a padded roll with the silvery edge sheen and deep crown of real velvet, stitched seams and soft crush marks in the pile, on a walnut plinth with a brass edge. A sheen rolls slowly across the channels and a glint slides along the brass.

name: Floating Fluted Marble Nightstand with Hidden Safe
note: A block of honed Calacatta marble floating clear of the floor, its front carved into deep vertical flutes, with a polished brass line along the top edge, grey and gold veins across the top and sides and a warm LED wash glowing on the floor beneath. One flute is really a door: now and then it swings open a crack to show a brass keypad glowing behind, then closes. The under-glow breathes and a glint runs along the brass.

name: Ergonomic Italian Leather & Walnut Lounge Chair
note: Moulded walnut plywood shells for the seat, lower back and upper back cradle plump cognac aniline leather cushions with button tufts, with padded leather armrests on walnut arms, all on a polished aluminium five-star swivel base. A warm sheen glides over the leather.

name: Hand-Embroidered Silk Kimono Tapestry in Shadowbox
note: A deep black-lacquer shadowbox with a gilded inner fillet, lined in ivory silk and lit by a hidden warm strip along the top. Inside, a crimson silk furisode hangs by its sleeves on a bamboo pole: hand-embroidered cranes in white silk with black necks and red crowns, gold-couched clouds and plum blossoms, gold seigaiha waves round the hem and sleeve ends, an ivory and gold collar, soft drape folds and the kimono's own shadow on the lining, behind glass. Light slides slowly across the silk and the gold threads glint.

name: Heated Herringbone Ash Wood with Sunken Plush Perimeter
note: A raised island of pale oiled ash herringbone (blond-grey blocks with fine straight grain and a soft matte sheen) edged with a bronze nosing, stepping down to a wide sunken border of deep ivory-greige plush carpet round the walls. Warmth shimmers up off the heated ash and a glint travels along the bronze.

name: alabaster Sphere Touch-Dimming Dawn-Simulator Lamp
note: A hand-turned globe of translucent alabaster with honey and cream veins and a few darker mineral threads, glowing from within, seated in a hammered brass cup on a slim walnut plinth with a brass touch ring. A slow dawn runs through the stone, deep amber warming to soft white and back, and the touch ring pulses.

name: Tufted Cashmere & Brass Cabriole-Leg Bench
note: A long bench in warm dove cashmere: a deep crowned seat with diamond tufting (puffy pillowed diamonds with pleats folding into every covered button), soft pleats down the sides, a piped edge and an apron finished with a close row of polished brass nailheads, on four sculpted polished-brass cabriole legs with rounded knees and pad feet. A soft sheen drifts across the cashmere and a glint runs down the brass legs.

name: Wooden Mechanical Watch Winder, Silk Eye Mask & Artisanal Candle
note: A burl-walnut watch winder with a glass lid and brass pull, a gold automatic watch on a cream suede cushion inside; a folded champagne silk eye mask; and an amber glass candle vessel with a hand-poured "Fig & Cedar" label and a crackling wooden wick. The winder turns the watch slowly, the candle flame flickers and a thin wisp rises from the wick.

name: Tray Ceiling with Concealed Warm Cove Illumination
note: A smooth warm-greige satin ceiling stepping up into a deep tray framed by a white crown moulding. Inside is champagne Venetian plaster with soft polished clouding, washed by warm light from an LED strip hidden on the cove ledge (brightest at the edges, fading to the middle), with a hand-cast plaster ceiling rose at the centre and four trimless pin lights in the outer band. The cove glow breathes softly and a slow sheen drifts across the polished plaster.

name: Brushed Gold & Frosted Glass Cloud Chandelier
note: A brushed-gold canopy and slim rod holding a billowing cloud of hand-blown frosted glass globes in many sizes, each on its own short gold stem from a central gold hub, glowing soft warm white from inside with a brighter core and a crisp sheen on the frosting. The globes breathe in a slow wave through the cloud and a glint runs down the gold.

name: Backlit Ornate Gilded Parisian Dressing Mirror
note: A tall Louis XV floor mirror leaning on the wall in a thick hand-carved frame, water-gilded in warm gold, with a ribbed acanthus moulding, a beaded inner edge, a scallop-shell crest between curling C-scrolls and carved roses at the foot. A warm LED strip hidden behind the frame washes the wall in a soft golden halo, and a blush velvet pouf on a gilt band sits beside it. The halo breathes, a glint slides down the glass and the gilding catches tiny twinkles.

name: Floor-to-Ceiling French Windows with Juliet Balcony
note: Tall cream-painted French doors with slim divided panes and polished brass espagnolette bolts, both swung wide into the room under a fixed transom. Outside is a wrought-iron Juliet railing with scrolls and gilded tips, and window boxes of red geraniums with trailing ivy. Ivory silk sheers hang on a brass rod either side. The view is a golden-hour sky over terracotta and zinc rooftops with chimney pots and a distant dome. The sheers billow in, swallows wheel across the sky, the geraniums nod and the sun glows.

name: Custom Walk-In Boutique Closet with Illuminated Island
note: A boutique wall of figured walnut with a champagne-gold crown and warm light coves: a hanging bay of silk dresses and a camel coat, a centre bay of lit glass cubbies holding handbags, and a bay of angled lit shoe shelves, with drawers below. In front stands a walnut island with a glass top glowing over a navy velvet tray of watches, rings and a pendant, champagne pulls and a light under the plinth, and a white orchid and a red handbag on top. The island glows and its jewels twinkle, a soft wave of light passes along the cubbies and the dresses sway.

name: Heated Orthopedic Memory-Foam Pet Bunk Attached to Master Bed
note: A walnut-framed bunk on brass feet with two polished brass hook arms and a leather strap at the back that clip it to the side rail of the big bed. Inside are a dusty-blue velvet U-bolster and a cream sherpa cover over layered orthopedic memory foam, with one corner folded back to show the egg-crate layer, plus a little heart pillow, a brass name plaque and a slim heat controller on its cord. A warm glow breathes over the cushion, heat shimmer rises and the controller ring pulses.

name: King Solid Walnut Four-Poster Canopy Bed with Silk Drapes
note: Tall hand-turned solid walnut posts with brass collars and finials, a carved arched walnut headboard with a gilded inlay line and a low footboard, under a canopy of champagne silk valances with a gold bullion fringe and heavy champagne silk drapes at each post held with gold tassel tiebacks. On the bed lie an ivory silk duvet with a turned-down band, four pillows and a bolster, and a gold-thread throw across the foot. The silk drapes sway and a sheen glides across the duvet.

name: Shagreen & Brushed Brass 8-Drawer Master Credenza
note: A long credenza faced in sea-green shagreen, the pebbled ray-skin texture, framed by brushed brass inlay strips: eight drawers in two rows with slim brass bar pulls, a honed stone top with a polished brass edge, on a recessed brass plinth. On top are an alabaster sphere lamp glowing warm, a stack of linen books under a rock crystal, and a black lacquer jewellery tray with a watch and a pearl strand. The lamp glow breathes and glints slide along the brass.

name: Plush Hand-Loomed Tibetan Silk & Cashmere Carpet
note: A deep hand-knotted carpet in soft slate-blue cashmere wool with Tibetan cloud scrolls and a central medallion worked in ivory and champagne-gold silk, a narrow tiger-stripe guard border, a hand-bound edge and gentle colour banding. A slow sheen travels across and the silk scrolls glow.

name: 1000-Thread-Count Mulberry Silk Sheets & Goose-Down Cloud Comforter
note: A lofty ivory goose-down comforter folded into a plump cloud with sewn-through baffle boxes, on a stack of champagne, blush and ivory mulberry silk sheets with a liquid sheen, and a pair of silk pillowcases folded on top with a gold-embroidered monogram tag, all tied round with a wide champagne satin ribbon and bow. A satin sheen glides across the silk folds and the ribbon tails stir.

name: Executive Leather-Inlay Walnut Writing Desk
live: Lamp glows, page lifts, globe turns
note: A twin-pedestal desk in figured walnut with a forest-green leather writing surface tooled in gold leaf, three drawers each side with brass bail pulls and a centre drawer with a brass keyhole, on moulded plinths. On top are a brass banker's lamp with a green glass shade, an open leather journal with a ribbon, a fountain pen on its stand, a cut-crystal inkwell and a small brass globe. The lamp glow breathes, the journal's page lifts and settles, and the globe slowly turns.

name: Concealed Ceiling Projector for Bedtime Movies
note: A walnut ceiling disc with a brushed-brass ring whose hatch has slid open. A matte-black cinema projector with a brass vent band has dropped out of it on a brass telescoping arm, its glass lens glowing as it throws a soft warm beam across the room. The beam flickers with the colours of the film, dust motes glint in it and the status light breathes.

name: Soundproof Silk-Woven & Starlight-Projecting Smart Walls
live: Starlight drifts, a star shoots by
note: Floor-to-ceiling pillowed acoustic panels upholstered in hand-woven shot silk (midnight indigo warp, plum weft) with visible slubs and a soft moving moire, joined by champagne-gold pin trims. A hidden cove washes warm light down from the top and a warm amber reveal glows along the skirting. A warm starfield and a soft milky-way band are projected onto the silk: the sky drifts slowly across, the stars twinkle and now and then a shooting star crosses.

name: Voice-Activated Smart Nightstand with Inductive Charging & Tea Brewer
note: A softly rounded ivory lacquer cabinet on a champagne-gold plinth, topped with a slab of backlit honey onyx. A glowing champagne charging ring is set into the onyx with a phone resting on it, and a sunken brew well holds a glass teapot of steeping tea on a warm hotplate. A woven ivory speaker band runs across the front with a gold voice light bar, above a hidden drawer with a slim gold pull. The tea slowly deepens to amber while steam curls up, the charging ring pulses and the voice light ripples as if it is speaking.

name: Zero-Gravity Floating Meditation & Reading Pod Chair
note: An egg-shaped pod in ivory lacquer with champagne-gold edges, open to the front and lined with quilted pearl silk, hovering over a black-glass base disc that glows warm underneath. A slim gold reading arm arcs over from the shell to a small warm lamp. The lining's sheen drifts, the levitation glow breathes, the reading lamp glows and soft motes rise through the gap.

name: Living kinetic Sand-Mandala & Bioluminescent Wall Mural
note: A deep forest-night mural sprayed onto the wall with a feathered edge: glowing mycelium threads branching out from the centre, foxfire mushrooms with amber caps, curled fern fiddleheads and moss in soft lime-gold light, and fireflies. At its heart a brass drum under a glass dome holds a hand-poured sand mandala in terracotta, ochre, ivory, lapis, black and gold sand. The mandala's rings slowly turn against each other, the inner lotus breathes, sand flows round the groove, pulses of light travel out along the mycelium and fireflies drift.

name: Cloud-Cushion Memory-Stone Heated Floor with Nighttime Footstep Glow
note: Big pillowed slabs of warm pearl-grey memory stone, each softly domed with a velvety bevel, set in fine seams holding a thread of warm night light. Soft footprints press into the stone one after another from the door toward the bed, each glowing warm amber and fading like a memory, while the seams breathe.

name: Levitating Moon-Phase Orb with Melatonin-Sync Glow
note: A detailed moon with grey-ivory regolith, dark maria and rayed craters floating on nothing above a walnut and brass maglev base whose ring glows a sleepy amber, giving off a warm, blue-free light. The moon turns slowly as it floats and bobs, its phase shadow sweeps across over a long cycle, and the base ring breathes.

name: Heated Massage & Shoe-Valet Smart Bedside Lounge Bench
note: A long bench in ivory nappa leather with deep channel quilting along its top, on a polished champagne-gold plinth. Under the seat is an open, warmly lit shoe valet holding velvet slippers and tan loafers on a walnut shelf, and a slim touch strip on one end shows heat and massage icons. Warmth glows and breathes along the channel seams, massage rollers ripple slowly along under the leather, and the valet light and icons pulse.

name: Levitating Dream-Crystal Orb & Smart Hydration Elixirs
note: A faceted rose-quartz crystal floating over a black onyx and gold base whose ring glows warm, with a soft light inside the crystal, beside a gold rack of three slim glass elixir vials (amber chamomile, rose and pale honey) with glowing level marks. The crystal floats, turns and sparkles, the base ring breathes and tiny bubbles rise in the vials.

name: 3D Holographic Aurora Borealis & Deep-Space Sleep Dome
note: A deep night-blue lacquered ceiling with a fine gold pinstripe opens into a great shallow dome framed by a champagne-gold rim, with a warm amber reveal glowing round it. The dome falls away into deep space: a dense starfield, soft rose, violet and amber nebula clouds and the Milky Way, with aurora curtains in emerald fading to rose hanging across it. The sky turns slowly, the aurora ripples and drifts, stars twinkle and now and then a shooting star crosses.

name: Floating Bioluminescent Feather-Halo Light Sculpture
note: A slim polished champagne-gold halo hovers in the air with nothing holding it, under a pale glowing disc set flush in the ceiling. From the halo hang long soft feathers that glow from within like deep-sea creatures, pearl-white at the quill warming to gold at the tips, with fine glowing barbs. The halo bobs gently, a bead of light runs round it, the feathers ripple one after another as their glow drifts through gold, rose and lilac, and glowing motes drift down.

name: 360-Degree Holographic Wardrobe Try-On Smart Mirror
note: A tall frameless smart mirror with a slim brushed champagne-gold edge on a low gold foot, facing a round champagne try-on turntable. A warm hologram of an outfit stands in a soft column of light above the turntable and slowly turns all the way round, cycling through a silk gown, a belted trench and a jumpsuit, while the glass shows the same look beside a swatch carousel and a turning 360 icon. A scan line sweeps up, motes of light rise and the turntable ring rotates.

name: Motorized Panoramic Glass Wall Opening to Sky-Terrace
note: A floor-to-ceiling wall of four near-frameless glass panels in slim champagne-bronze profiles, under a header with a warm LED cove. The middle two panels slide apart on a motor to open the room onto a sky terrace: a teak deck, a glass balustrade with a brass cap rail, an infinity pool on the edge, two cream loungers and an olive tree in a stone planter, above a golden-hour sea of clouds with mountain peaks. The panels glide open and closed, the clouds drift below, the pool shimmers and the olive sways.

name: AI Automated Carousel Wardrobe with Virtual Outfit Mirror
note: A tall ivory lacquer wardrobe with champagne-gold pinstripes, crown and plinth. Its wide open bay is a warm-lit conveyor where garments ride a gold oval track, the front row gliding one way and the back row the other, under a soft spotlight. The right panel is a virtual outfit mirror where a dress form tries on each outfit in turn beside colour swatches and a breathing gold status ring. The carousel turns, the mirror cycles outfits and a scan line sweeps up.

name: Floating Cloud-Cradle Pet Sleep Pod with Lullaby Hum
note: A cradle of soft ivory cloud puffs hovering over a pearl base disc ringed in champagne gold, with a peach-glow cushion and a tiny star pillow in its hollow and warm light pooled on the base beneath. The cloud bobs gently, the glow breathes with it, little lullaby notes drift up and tiny gold stars circle around it.

name: Levitating Zero-Gravity Smart Sleep Pod with Circadian Climate Control
live: Pod floats, light follows the day
note: A pearl-white oval sleep pod with a champagne-gold rim, floating above a low pearl plinth on a pool of warm light. Inside are a plush quilted mattress, ivory pillows and a soft blush duvet. A translucent canopy hood arches over the head end, its light strip shifting through the colours of the day, from dawn amber to soft gold to dusk peach. The pod bobs gently and warm air wisps rise from the climate vents round the rim.

name: Seamless Touch-Open Smart Dresser with Ultrasonic Jewelry Cleaner
note: A handle-less dresser in matte ivory lacquer with hairline seams and a slim champagne touch strip, on a floating plinth lit from beneath. A built-in ultrasonic cleaning basin is set into the top: a shallow glass well glowing warm, with rings turning slowly in the shimmering water. One drawer glides open at a touch to show a blush velvet organizer of rings and earrings, then closes again. The basin bubbles and ripples, and the touch strip and under-glow breathe.

name: Heated Sound-Dampening Cloud-Fiber Sanctuary Rug
note: A thick oval of cloud-white fibre built up from soft cumulus billows, quilted into sound-dampening concentric channels with fine stitching, finished with a rolled pillow rim bound in champagne silk piping. A warm amber glow seeps out from under the edge onto the floor. Warmth breathes out from the centre in slow rings and a soft sheen drifts across the billows.

name: Self-Making Temperature-Regulating Cashmere & Silver-Ion Smart Bedding
note: Dove-grey cashmere bedding woven with a faint grid of silver-ion thread, stacked on a slim champagne-gold charging tray. The top layer folds itself: it lifts, turns over and settles with a crisp fold, then unfolds again. A warm-to-cool band of light travels along an embedded thread, the silver grid glints and a small control puck beside it shows a breathing temperature ring.

name: Holographic Dream-Journaling & Smart Beauty Station
note: A curved ivory waterfall desk with a champagne-gold edge and a softly glowing base, a round smart mirror on a slim gold stem that sweeps a warm scan ring over a face outline beside little skin-reading arcs, and a projector puck casting a warm hologram of a dream journal that writes itself while dream symbols drift around it: a crescent moon, a cloud and stars. A rose-quartz roller and three glass serum bottles with gold caps sit on the desk.

name: Neural-Wave Lucid Dream Inducer & Oxygen-Enriched Micro-Climate Hub
note: A two-tier honed travertine plinth banded in champagne gold, its top planted with a ring of living moss and tiny white flowers around a gold cradle. Above it floats a pearl orb with a slow rose-and-amber dream swirl inside, circled by two crossed polished-gold gyroscope rings, and beside it a silk-wrapped neural headband rests on a slim brass stand. The orb breathes and its swirl turns, soft waves ripple out around it, glints travel along the rings, oxygen-rich mist rolls out of the gap under the plinth and the headband's gold dots pulse slowly.

name: Cinderblock Walls with Graffiti Tags & Foil Sheets
note: Grey-painted cinderblock in running bond, the paint thin over the pitted block faces, with deep mortar joints, damp tide marks and white efflorescence near the floor and rust streaks under an old bracket. Spray-paint tags and bubble throw-ups in hot pink, yellow and violet drip down the wall, sheets of crinkled kitchen foil are taped up with silver duct tape to bounce the light, and a party flyer is stapled up. The foil glints as coloured light passes and a loose foil corner flutters.

name: Single Crackling Portable PA Speaker on Tripod
note: A battered off-brand plastic PA box leaning a little on a cheap wobbly tripod: scuffed black plastic with a cracked top corner held together with silver duct tape, a dented perforated grille over the woofer, a peeling star sticker and a moulded top handle. On the side panel one knob is missing and the power light flickers; the tripod clamp is reinforced with zip ties, one leg has a tape repair and the power cord trails off into a tangle on the floor. The woofer pumps unevenly and the box buzzes and crackles with little static sparks.

name: Spool-Top Table with Neon Stickers
note: An old industrial cable spool stood on end as a table: rough plywood flanges with splintered edges, stencilled rings and an arrow, a stained centre hole with four rusty bolts, a slatted barrel, peeling neon stickers, drink rings, bottle caps and a dented can. Beside it an upturned red plastic crate holds a candle stuck in a green bottle; the flame flickers and a loose sticker corner lifts in the draft.

name: Glow-in-the-Dark Plastic Wall Stars
note: A loose spray of cheap pale-green glow-in-the-dark plastic stars, a crescent moon, a ringed planet and a comet stuck straight onto the wall with blobs of white sticky tack, a couple peeling off and one fallen, leaving a grey tack mark. In the dark club they glow a soft yellow-green. The glow charges up under a passing light and slowly fades, and the peeling star curls in the air.

name: Duct-Taped Cardboard Breakdance Mat on Concrete
note: A bare garage slab of grey troweled concrete with saw-cut joints, a hairline crack and oil and drink stains. In the middle lies a breakdance mat of three flattened appliance boxes duct-taped together with silver tape, still printed with arrows and a fragile-glass mark, with dark circular scuffs where heads and backs spun, a sneaker skid and a water ring. One tape strip peels up at the corner, there are chalk marks, and an orange extension cord snakes along the wall. The loose tape end flutters and dust swirls over the spin spot.

name: Clip-On Colored Party Bulb & Tin-Foil Ball
note: A cracked, yellowed plastic ceiling rose with a cobweb, a white flex with a lump of electrical tape, a black bakelite lampholder with a chipped ring and a cheap painted-blue party bulb, the paint scratched off in one spot and dust on its shoulder. Beside it hangs a lumpy ball of crumpled kitchen foil on a bit of string, held to the ceiling with a strip of masking tape. The bulb flickers now and then, both sway in the draught and the foil ball twists, its glints winking.

name: Plastic Stackable Stool Used as Drink Rest
note: A faded red moulded-plastic stacking stool: a round seat with a finger hole and ribbed rim, four splayed ribbed legs and a square brace ring, chalky and scuffed with a stack mark worn into the seat and a sticky drink ring. A sweating beer can stands on the edge with a drop of condensation running down it. It still works as a seat.

name: Red Plastic Party Cups & Glowsticks
note: The mess after a party game: three red plastic cups with beer in a triangle, a short stack of empties, one cup knocked over in a spilled puddle, a crumpled napkin, a bottle cap and snapped glowsticks (a green stick, a pink bracelet and a yellow one bent in a V) pulsing softly.

name: Exposed Garage Rafters with Christmas Lights
note: No ceiling at all, just the underside of the garage roof: rough OSB roof deck with its chip pattern and stamped grade marks between raw pine rafters running front to back, a forgotten fluorescent tube fixture, cobwebs in the corners and a cheap string of multicoloured Christmas lights swagged from rafter to rafter. The bulbs twinkle out of step and the cobwebs sway in the draught.

name: Oscillating Fan with Soap-Bubble Wand
note: A cheap pedestal fan gone yellow with age: a cracked round base with a strip of tape and a row of piano-key switches (one stuck down), a scuffed pole, grey dust on the blades and a bent bit of cage taped back. Someone has wired a yellow plastic bubble wheel to the pole with a twisted coat hanger, its rings dipping into a pink tray of soapy water. The head turns side to side, the wheel turns through the soap and bubbles drift off. Tap to switch on more bubbles.

name: Peeling Dartboard on the Wall
note: A tired bristle dartboard hung slightly crooked on a cheap plywood backboard. The bristle is faded and fuzzy, peppered with holes, with a frayed chunk missing near the top, a bent wire and two numbers worn off the ring. The dark green paint is flaking off to bare wood, missed throws have riddled the board around it, a cracked corner is patched with masking tape and chalk tally marks sit in the corner. Two darts are in the board (one with a torn flight) and a third is stuck in the backboard. It hangs from a picture wire on a nail; a curl of loose paint and the peeled tape end sway in the air.

name: Plastic Cooler & Folding Table Drink Station
note: A white plastic folding table with grey steel legs (one foot cap missing) holding a cheap plastic punch bowl with a ladle, a 2-litre soda bottle, a red cup and a torn bag of ice slumped in a puddle; underneath sits a scuffed red picnic cooler with its white lid slightly ajar. Condensation runs down the soda bottle.

name: Small Cardboard Breakdance Square for Pet
note: A pet-sized breakdance mat cut from a flattened box: two cardboard panels taped together with silver duct tape, a printed arrow and a fold crease, a scuffed spin circle worn into the middle and one corner curling up, with a chewed rubber squeaky ball and a little knotted rope toy on it. The ball rocks and the curled corner lifts in a draft.

name: Folding Table with Cracked Bed-Sheet Banner
note: A folding table with a cracked bed-sheet banner and a cheap 2-deck controller. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Torn Vinyl Diner Bench Against the Wall
note: A two-seat diner booth bench against the wall: cracked oxblood vinyl with a channel-stitched tall back, a chrome edge strip and a scuffed chrome kick plate, a long split in the seat with yellow foam bulging out, an X of silver duct tape over another tear, a split seam on the back, faded patches where everyone sits and a wad of pink gum under the front edge. A loose flap of torn vinyl lifts and settles. Seats two.

name: Stained Garage Rubber Mat
note: A heavy charcoal rubber garage mat with a raised coin-dot grip pattern, faded grey where it has been walked on, a big oil stain with a rainbow sheen, a muddy tyre track across one end, a torn notch in the edge, sawdust and grit, a flattened bottle cap and a scuffed sneaker print. The oily rainbow sheen shimmers.

name: Secondhand Boombox & Tangled Aux Cord
note: A secondhand 80s chrome boombox from a thrift store: two big speaker cones, a tuner window with a VU meter and a flip-down cassette deck, but the chrome is dull and scratched, the left woofer grille is dented with a torn hole, a peeling smiley sticker sits on the right grille, one tuning knob is missing (bare shaft), a cracked corner is held with grey duct tape and the antenna has a twist of electrical tape. A tangled aux cord trails off the side. Tap to play: the door shuts, the reels roll and the woofers pump.

name: Upended Milk Crate by the Wall
note: A faded blue plastic milk crate turned upside down by the wall: thick lip at the floor, handle slots near the bottom, three rows of open holes, white stress scuffs, a cracked top corner and a half-peeled round sticker. A yellowed square of foam is strapped on top with two strips of black duct tape, and one loose tape end flutters.

name: Beanbag & Floor Fan in the Corner
note: Four mismatched, slumped bean bags in the corner: faded denim vinyl split along a seam and leaking foam beads, brown corduroy, faded red vinyl with a silver tape patch, and a small grey fleece one with a stain. A yellowed plastic floor fan with a dusty guard blows at them, its cord snaking to the wall, and a crumpled can lies on the floor. The fan blades spin and a bead trickles out of the split now and then. Seats four.

name: Black Acoustic Foam Pyramid Panels
note: Walls lined edge to edge with square charcoal acoustic foam panels, each a field of soft pyramids whose faces catch the light differently, glued up a little crooked with gaps, one corner peeling off its glue dab, dust on the tips and a black rubber skirting. A pink and amber party-light wash slowly sweeps across, picking out the pyramid relief.

name: Pair of 12-Inch Active Club Monitors
note: Two matching black monitor cabinets in textured paint, toed in a little on rubber isolation pads atop a low black carpeted riser. Each has an exposed 12-inch woofer with a steel rim and screws, a flared horn above it, a bass port slot and a small amber power light; a cable runs between them and a can of soda sits on the riser. Both woofers pump to the beat, sound rings spread and a warm glow pulses along the riser edge.

name: Round Chrome Cocktail High-Top Table
note: A standard bar high-top: a round white laminate top with a chrome edge band (a small chip, faint drink rings), a chrome column with a chrome foot ring, and a heavy round chrome base scuffed at the rim, with a folded beer mat wedged under one edge. A tea-light flickers in a frosted glass beside a folded napkin.

name: Custom Pink Neon 'Good Vibes' Flamingo Sign
note: A hand-bent pink neon flamingo standing on one leg, with a coral beak tip and a warm white eye, and 'good vibes' in looping script beneath in white-pink neon. The glass tubes sit off the wall on a clear acrylic backing cut to shape, fixed with four chrome standoffs, with a black cable running down to a little dimmer. The neon breathes and hums, and now and then the lettering stutters before catching.

name: Black-and-White Checkerboard Vinyl Dance Floor
live: Party lights glide over the tiles
note: Budget 12-inch vinyl tiles in a black-and-white checkerboard, the whites gone a little ivory, with dark seams, black heel scuffs and grey skid arcs, a chipped corner showing the grey backing, a lifted tile edge, a sticky soda spill and a glossy polish sheen. Magenta, amber and violet party-light pools glide slowly across it.

name: 12-Inch Rotating Glass Mirror Disco Ball & Pinspot
note: A 12-inch glass mirror ball on a short chain under a black ceiling motor with a green power light, lit by a small black pinspot on a ceiling bracket whose warm white beam hits it from the side. The ball turns with real tiles catching the light, its rays rotate, specks of light circle the room and dust motes drift in the beam.

name: Glowing Acrylic Pedestal Bistro Stand
note: A rented party LED pedestal: a tapered frosted-plastic column with a mould seam and a round frosted top, lit from inside by a cheap colour-changing LED that fades through magenta, amber, violet and pink. A small remote and a drink with a straw sit on top, a barcode rental sticker is on the base and a charge cable trails off.

name: Cocktail Shaker Set, Ice Tongs & Neon Coasters
note: A budget bar set on a little stack of neon acrylic coasters: a three-piece steel shaker with a small dent and water spots, a double jigger, claw ice tongs and a twisted bar spoon, and two ice cubes melting on the top coaster. The coaster edges pulse and condensation slides down the shaker.

name: Black Painted Ceiling with Steel Lighting Truss
live: PAR cans pulse and swap colours
note: The whole ceiling sprayed flat black, joists, a duct and conduit included, so it disappears. Across the middle hangs a silver aluminium box truss on short chains, its chords laced with zigzag braces, with six PAR cans clamped underneath in coloured gels and their cables taped along the top. The cans pulse and swap colours to the beat, throwing soft light cones down into the room.

name: Compact Halloween Mini Fog Machine
note: A little black plastic fog box from a seasonal shop: scuffed body with vent slats, a carry handle, an orange pumpkin badge, a translucent bottle of purple fog juice half full plugged into the top and a brass nozzle with a sticky drip under it. A wired remote on a coiled cord lies on the floor beside a small puddle of fluid, and a plastic toy spider sits on top. The ready light blinks, the nozzle glows and short light puffs drift out. Tap for short, light puffs of fog.

name: Neon Pinball Machine
note: A second-hand pinball cabinet: angled playfield under glass, two flippers, three pop bumpers, slingshots, a lit backglass with a score display and neon trim. It stands on square black legs with chrome leg bolts (one leveller shimmed with a folded beer mat); the side art is chipped to bare wood at the corners and scratched, a split on the backbox corner is held with duct tape and one neon tube flickers. Tap to play a ball.

name: Tiki Bamboo Home Bar Counter
note: A budget home tiki bar: a plywood box faced with split bamboo poles (one cracked), bamboo corner posts, a varnished dark wood counter with a fringe of dry grass thatch along the edges, and a tiki mug, a coconut cup with a paper umbrella and a pineapple at the ends. The back is plain plywood with a shelf. The thatch stirs in a light breeze.

name: Mini Light-Up Disco Podium & Pet Shades
note: A low pet-sized light-up disco podium: a black frame with silver edging and a grid of frosted squares lit by colour LEDs that flash in a chasing pattern, a mini clip-on spotlight and a pair of little star-shaped pet sunglasses left on the edge. Two pets can perform on it.

name: Plywood DJ Booth with Graffiti Front Panel
note: A plywood booth with a graffiti front, two turntables and a club mixer. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Black Faux-Leather L-Shaped Club Banquette
note: A budget L-shaped club banquette in shiny black faux leather: channel-stitched back cushions, plump seat cushions with sitting creases, rolled arms and short chrome legs. The cheap leatherette is cracking and peeling to the brown fabric backing on the arm tops and front edges, with a strip of black tape over one split, and a loose flake lifts in the draft. Seats four.

name: UV-Reactive Neon Splatter Carpet Runner
note: A cheap black low-pile carpet runner flicked and spattered with UV paint in hot pink, highlighter yellow, tangerine and lime: big splats with droplets, flick lines and drips, bound with a neon pink edge tape and scuffed grey down the middle. The blacklight pulses and the splatters glow brighter and dimmer with it.

name: 2-Channel USB Laptop DJ Controller
note: A 2-channel controller and laptop on a black DJ desk. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Chrome & Red Vinyl Swivel Bar Stool
note: A second-hand diner bar stool: four splayed chrome tube legs with a foot ring rubbed dull where feet rest, a swivel plate and a ribbed chrome band holding a domed red vinyl cushion. The vinyl has split across the top and is patched with an X of silver duct tape; the chrome is pitted with rust near the floor, one rubber foot cap is missing and a wad of pink gum is stuck under the seat. The loose seat wobbles on its swivel.

name: Lava Lamp & Blacklight Tapestry Alcove
note: A classic rocket-shaped lava lamp with a speckled silver base and cap, violet liquid and orange wax, on a cheap black pressboard cube table with a chipped corner. The table is draped in a black-light tapestry throw with a fluorescent mandala and fringe, lit by a little clip-on black-light bulb. The wax blobs rise, stretch and sink, the tapestry colours pulse and the black light flickers now and then.

name: Brick Walls with Neon Tube Accent Strips
note: Warm red-brown brick in running bond, every brick its own shade, with sanded mortar, a few chipped edges and soot-dark headers, the lower courses painted matt black. Two real glass neon tubes run along it on clear clips, a straight hot-pink line up high and an amber wave lower down, their cable dropping to a transformer box, each throwing a soft glow on the brick. The neon hums with a faint flicker and the glow breathes.

name: Stacked Horn-Loaded Bass Bins & Line-Array Towers
note: In the middle a 2 x 2 stack of big folded-horn bass bins in black textured paint with steel corner protectors, each horn mouth folding back into a deep throat where the driver works. Either side stands a ground-stacked line array: a sub base and eight slim curved elements on brushed-steel hinges under a flybar, with perforated grilles and little status lights. The drivers pump deep in the horns, pressure ripples roll out of the mouths, the status lights flicker and the floor dust hops.

name: Infinity-Mirror LED Coffee Table
note: A matte black box coffee table on a recessed plinth with a glass top over an infinity mirror: a ring of warm-white LEDs reflected again and again into a tunnel that seems to drop through the floor, a thin LED line along the glass edge and two cocktails in coupe glasses on black coasters. Light runs around the rings and the colour drifts slowly from warm white to soft rose and back.

name: Framed Gold & Platinum Vinyl Record Awards
note: Three award frames in satin black with a thin silver fillet: a big gold record in the centre and a platinum and a smaller gold either side, each record mounted over its cover-art panel on black suede with a small engraved plaque, the grooves catching the light behind glass, with a brass picture light above the centre frame. Light rings sweep round the grooves and a glint slides across the glass.

name: 70s Retro Light-Up Acrylic Disco Squares
live: Squares light up in chase patterns
note: A grid of frosted acrylic squares in a black frame, each lit from beneath in strong seventies colours (amber, tangerine, hot pink, violet, gold and lime), the frosting showing a soft hot spot in the middle of each square and the lights glowing over the frame. The squares light up in travelling chase patterns, a diagonal wave and then rows, while the colours swap.

name: DMX Moving-Head Beam Spotlights & Strobe Bar
note: A matte black lighting stand with tripod legs and rubber feet and a telescoping brushed aluminium mast, carrying a T-bar with two compact moving heads on top and a slim LED strobe bar beneath. A DMX cable runs down the mast, held with strips of gaffer tape, to a little controller clamped halfway with blinking lights. The heads pan and sweep tight warm beams of amber, rose, white and violet, and the strobe bar fires quick white bursts.

name: Brushed Brass Hourglass Cocktail Side Table
note: A tall cocktail side table on an hourglass base of two brushed-brass cones meeting at a slim waist ring, with a round white Carrara marble top edged in brass. A coupe cocktail with an orange twist sits on a linen napkin, and a soft highlight slides up and down the brass.

name: LED Flashing Ice Cubes & Acrylic Champagne Bucket
note: A clear acrylic champagne bucket with moulded handles, filled with water and light-up LED ice cubes, a champagne bottle standing in it and three more LED cubes scattered beside it. Every cube cycles through warm white, rose, amber and violet at its own pace, lighting the water and the table.

name: Mirrored Coffered Ceiling with Suspended Disco Balls
note: A grid of deep coffers between glossy black beams, every coffer lined with a mosaic of little mirror squares catching the club lights and edged with a slim warm LED line, with three mirror balls of different sizes hanging on chains. The balls turn with their facets flashing, and a scatter of light specks sweeps across the ceiling.

name: High-Output Club Haze Machine & UV Blacklight Cannons
note: A sleek matte black hazer with brushed aluminium carry rails, a fan grille and a small amber readout, sitting on a black road case with aluminium edging, ball corners and butterfly latches, with two compact UV cannons on floor yokes tilted up at the room. The fan turns and haze drifts out of the nozzle, and the UV cannons breathe a violet glow that picks out fluorescent specks. Tap for a medium haze.

name: 2-Player Dance-Mat Rhythm Arcade Cabinet
note: An upright rhythm cabinet with a big screen, light-up marquee, speakers and two floor pads with arrow panels. Chrome safety bars with black foam grips stand behind each pad, and the arrow panels and step edge are scuffed with shoe marks from heavy use. Arrows scroll up the screen and the pad panels light on the beat. Tap and two creatures dance.

name: Backlit Frosted Acrylic & Chrome Nightclub Bar
note: A nightclub bar faced in frosted white acrylic panels on chrome standoffs, lit warm-white from behind so the LED strips glow softly through, with a black quartz counter with a fine sparkle and a chrome edge, a chrome foot rail, three cocktails and a cup of straws on top. The bartender side is black with shelves of bottles. The backlight breathes and a soft band of light sweeps across the acrylic.

name: Tiny Turntable Scratch-Pad & Pet Headphone Booth
note: A pet-sized DJ booth in white lacquer and birch plywood: on top a cat scratch pad made like a turntable (a corrugated cardboard record you can scratch, on a white deck with a little tonearm), a tiny two-knob mixer with a blinking light and a felt toy record, with small padded pink pet headphones hanging on a hook at the side. The scratch record turns slowly.

name: Brushed Aluminum Truss Booth with Acrylic Light Shield
note: Brushed aluminium truss with an edge-lit acrylic shield, two CDJs, a mixer and a laptop. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Tufted Purple Velvet Horseshoe VIP Booth
note: A horseshoe VIP booth in deep aubergine velvet: diamond button-tufted backs, piped seat cushions and rolled arms on a black lacquer plinth with a recessed warm light line. A soft sheen drifts across the velvet. Seats five.

name: Plush Leopard-Print Lounge Rug
note: A deep plush faux-fur rug in a warm honey-gold leopard print, with broken black rosettes around amber centres, scattered spots and a dense soft pile with lighter tips, softly rounded corners and fur curling over the edge. A soft sheen glides through the plush.

name: Dual Direct-Drive Vinyl Turntables & 4-Channel Club Mixer
note: Two direct-drive turntables and a 4-channel mixer, with a crate of records under the desk. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Illuminated LED Glow-Cube Seat
note: A frosted-plastic cube seat lit from inside by a colour-changing LED, with soft rounded edges, a faint mould seam and a round charcoal felt pad on top. A little remote and a charge cable lie on the floor beside it. The cube fades slowly through magenta, amber, violet and coral, faster when the party is on.

name: Sound-Dampened Velvet Pod with Oxygen Bar
note: A round emerald-velvet drum seat on a brass ring, wrapped by a tall curved hood: velvet outside, charcoal acoustic felt inside, with a brass-piped rim. On the inside back wall is a little walnut oxygen bar: three glass aroma flasks in amber, rose and mint with clear tubes looping to a hanging nose cannula, lit warm from underneath. Bubbles rise in the flasks and the light breathes.

name: 3D Geometric Mirror-Tile & Sound-Reactive LED Matrix Walls
note: The upper wall is clad in faceted champagne-tinted mirror tiles, triangles tilted at different angles so each catches the room differently, edged with a slim brushed-bronze rail. Below runs a band of black glass hiding an LED matrix where a sound-reactive equaliser dances in warm pixel bars. The bars bounce to the music and sparkles flash across the mirror facets.

name: Custom Gold-Anodized Funktion-One Style Acoustic Wall Stack
note: A three-box horn stack in piano-black lacquer with champagne-gold anodised horns: a folded bass horn at the bottom, a big square mid-range flare with a bullet phase plug, and twin round treble horns either side of a slim ribbon on top, with gold edge trims and pinstripes, standing on gold spikes on a black marble plinth. The drivers pump in the throats, warm light breathes deep in the horns and a soft glint slides across the gold.

name: Black Marble & Gold Champagnes-Trough VIP Table
note: A slab of black marble with white and gold veining over a black lacquer cabinet base banded in brushed brass. Down the middle runs a sunken brass-lined trough packed with crushed ice holding three champagne bottles with gold foil necks, and two coupes of champagne sit at the ends. The ice glints, bubbles rise in the glasses and a slow warm sheen slides across the marble.

name: Infinity-Tunnel LED Hexagonal Wall Sculpture
note: A honeycomb cluster of three deep hexagonal infinity mirrors in brushed gunmetal, a big one in the middle and two smaller ones beside it. Each has a two-way mirror front over a ring of LEDs, so the light repeats into a tunnel of shrinking hexagons in warm magenta, amber and gold, with a slim chrome bezel and a glow on the wall. The light chases inward down each tunnel and the colours shift from module to module.

name: Pressure-Sensitive Interactive RGB Matrix Dance Floor
note: Big panels of smoked black glass over a dense matrix of tiny LED pixels, set in brushed-steel seams. Where feet land, rings of light ripple out pixel by pixel in magenta, amber and violet, a slow warm colour wave rolls across the whole floor, and the glass carries soft reflections.

name: Full-Color RGB Animation Laser Projector & Giant Mirror Sphere
note: A round plinth of polished black marble with gold veins and a brushed brass band, a fluted brass column with two collars, a laser projector in a gloss black and brass housing halfway up and a giant mirror sphere turning on a brass hub at the top. The sphere throws warm specks round the room while the projector draws sweeping fans, a turning star and blinking bursts in rose, amber, gold, violet and red.

name: Crystal & Illuminated Chrome Ice-Bucket Stand
note: A polished-nickel champagne-bucket stand: a round weighted base with a warm light ring glowing underneath, a slim column and a three-arm cradle holding a cut-crystal ice bucket full of ice, lit warm from inside, with a champagne bottle angled in it and a white linen napkin draped over the rim. The glow breathes, the ice glints and condensation runs down the crystal.

name: Gold Ace-of-Spades Bottle Sparklers & Crystal Hookah/Vapor Carafe
note: VIP bottle service: a metallic gold champagne bottle with a black neck band and a lit ice-fountain sparkler clipped to its neck, beside a cut-crystal vapour carafe on a brass stem with a small brass bowl, tray and a coiled hose. The sparkler fountains bright sparks, the gold catches the flicker and a thin wisp of vapour curls up.

name: Motorized Kinetic Triangle LED Ceiling Grid
note: A ceiling of matte black triangular panels on hidden motors, every seam traced with a warm LED line. The panels tilt in slow waves so their faces catch more or less light, and the seams glow from rose through amber to gold as the wave passes.

name: Cryo CO2 Jet Blasters & Confetti Swirl Cannons
note: A low black lacquer cabinet with a champagne-gold grille, gold feet and a gold-rimmed pressure gauge hides the CO2 tank; braided gold hoses run to two jet heads on slim gold columns either side, and in front a gold confetti cannon with black bands sits angled up on a lacquer pedestal. The jets fire tall freezing white columns in bursts, the gauge needle twitches and the cannon swirls out metallic confetti in gold, rose gold, champagne and blush. Tap for heavy CO2 blasts.

name: LED Glow-in-the-Dark Billiards & Air Hockey Table
note: A flip-top games table in walnut with brass trim: a white air-hockey surface with red and navy lines, or an emerald billiards felt with brass-rimmed leather pockets and mother-of-pearl sights. It stands on two walnut pedestals with brass bands and feet, with warm LED light glowing under the rails and a small amber score display. Tap and two creatures play a live match.

name: Illuminated Onyx Wet Bar with Tiered LED Liquor Display
note: A wet bar faced in book-matched honey onyx lit from behind so the stone glows amber through its bands and veins, framed in brushed brass with a brass foot rail. The black marble counter has a brass edge, a small brass bar sink and a gooseneck tap, and at the back a three-step lit brass display of liquor bottles glowing from beneath in a slow wave.

name: VIP Velvet Pet Lounge with Mini Mocktail Dispenser
note: A round button-tufted burgundy velvet lounge pouf with brass piping, turned brass feet and a low curved bolster at the back, beside a little brass stand holding a glass mocktail dispenser full of fruit with a brass tap dripping into a small brass pet bowl. A soft sheen moves across the velvet. It is a seat.

name: 3D-Mapped Geometric Obsidian & Mirror-Shard DJ Altar
note: A faceted DJ altar: a black obsidian front cut into triangular facets with antique-mirror shards, brass seams between the facets, a dark bronze top on a brass band and a black plinth with a brass line. Two CDJs and a mixer sit on top; warm gold light lines sweep across the facets and the mirror shards catch the light. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Elevated Gold-Velvet & Mirror-Trimmed Bottle-Service Sanctuary
note: A horseshoe VIP booth in champagne-gold velvet with vertical channel-tufted backs and gold piping, raised on a plinth clad in warm antique-mirror panels framed in brass with a glowing toe line. In the middle of the horseshoe stands a brass bottle-service stand with an ice bucket and a champagne bottle. Glints run across the mirror and the ice catches the light. Seats five.

name: Metallic Silver-Thread & Black Velvet VIP Carpet
note: A deep black velvet runner embroidered in metallic silver thread: an art-deco pattern of stepped chevrons and sunburst fans down its length, a fine double guard line, a silver-bound edge and silver tassels at both ends, with crush marks in the velvet where the nap was brushed the other way. A glint travels along the silver threads and the velvet sheen shifts.

name: Quad-Deck Flagship CDJ Nexus Rig with Custom Gold Rotary Mixer
note: Four flagship CDJs around a gold rotary mixer on a wide gold-trimmed desk. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Sculpted Gold-Wireframe & Black Velvet High Barstool
note: A designer barstool on a twisting hourglass lattice of polished gold rods between a floor ring and a seat ring, with a separate gold foot ring on four short spokes, under a domed black velvet seat with a gold piped edge. A glint runs along the gold rods and a soft sheen drifts across the velvet.

name: Backstage Star Dressing Nook with Lighted Mirror & Mini-Fridge
note: A Hollywood-regency chaise longue in dusty-rose velvet with a channel-tufted half back, a rolled arm at the head, a champagne satin bolster, an ivory faux-fur throw over the foot, gold tapered legs and a brass base rim. At the foot stands a cream glass-door mini-fridge with warm-lit shelves of little bottles, a brass handle and a gold star, topped by a black lacquer bulb-framed dressing mirror, a perfume bottle and a lipstick. The mirror bulbs glow in a slow ripple, a glint slides over the mirror and a sheen drifts across the velvet.

name: Infinite-Depth Holographic Visualizer & Liquid-Light Plasma Walls
note: A wall of deep black glass with a thin champagne-gold line at the skirting. One endless tunnel of glowing rounded frames spans the whole wall, receding to a bright vanishing point, while warm liquid-light plasma in rose, amber, violet and gold flows and merges across the glass. The tunnel frames stream toward you endlessly and the plasma blobs drift, swell and merge.

name: Omnidirectional Sonic-Beam & Sub-Harmonic Levitation Bass Reactors
note: Two tapering towers of smoked obsidian glass ringed with champagne-gold driver bands, each band split by a warm amber light seam and capped with a polished dome and gold finial, and between them a black-gold sphere floating over a gold-ringed emitter disc. Amber light runs up the seams, pressure rings ripple out of the towers, warm sonic beams flow to the sphere as it bobs and turns, and rings roll across the floor. Tap to play: a haze ring rolls out across the floor.

name: Interactive Touch-Synth & Hologram-Visualizer VIP Table
note: An oval walnut table with a polished brass rim on an oval walnut column and brass foot. Set into the top is a black glass touch panel with twelve gold-ringed pads that light up in patterns with ripples, and above its centre floats a warm gold visualiser: a circle of light bars pumping like an equaliser with rings of light rising off it.

name: 12-Foot Cybernetic Chrome Mascot Head with Laser Eyes
note: A giant polished-chrome mascot head of the club's own robo-cat on a gunmetal wall plate: a mirror-bright dome with two angular ears lined in champagne gold, a wraparound black glass visor with two big round eyes, a grille muzzle with a little equaliser, panel seams, rivets and whisker light-bars. The eyes blaze and their warm laser beams sweep the room, the grille bounces to the beat and reflections slide across the chrome.

name: Kinetic Energy-Harvesting Levitation & Haptic Bass Dance Floor
note: A honeycomb of pearl-white hexagonal pads edged in champagne gold, hovering a hair above a dark energy well, with warm gold light glowing up through the gaps from the harvesters beneath. With every bass beat a ring of pads dips and lifts outward from the centre, golden energy pulses spread through the gaps and sparks race to the edges.

name: Volumetric 3D Hologram Dancer & Ion-Plasma Lightning Generator
note: A stepped emitter dais in gloss black lacquer with a champagne-gold band and a glowing gold lens, throwing a warm column of light in which a rose-gold hologram dancer drawn in light grooves with scanlines and the odd glitch. Either side stands a lightning generator: a walnut and brass base, a glass tube over a copper coil and a polished brass sphere on top. The dancer dances, light motes rise, ripples spread over the floor and rose-violet lightning jumps between the spheres and crackles into the air.

name: Autonomous Floating Drone Coaster Table
note: A magnetic levitation side table: a walnut and brass base holds a round walnut tray top with a brass rim hovering in mid-air, a warm light glowing in the gap. Two tiny brass-and-black coaster drones, each carrying a drink on its back, hover beside it with their rotors spinning. The top bobs gently and the drones bob out of step.

name: Levitating Plasma Drink Orbs & Holographic VIP Wristband Dock
note: A walnut and brass dock with a brass post holding woven VIP wristbands in rose, gold and black with brass tags, a soft gold light ring turning above it, and three blown-glass drink spheres floating around it, each holding an amber or rose cocktail lit warm from inside with a gold straw. The spheres bob and drift out of step and their glow breathes.

name: 360-Degree Immersion Dome with Floating Laser Halo Rigs
note: The middle of the ceiling opens into a deep projection dome ringed in a brushed champagne-gold torus, wrapped in a slow warm nebula of rose, amber, violet and gold with a faint star field and gold meridian lines tracing its curve. Below it three slim gold halo rings float on nothing, each trimmed with a running LED band and firing fans of warm laser beams down into the room. The nebula drifts, stars twinkle, the halos bob out of step and their laser fans sweep.

name: Zero-Gravity Bubble-Cloud & Scent-Synced Euphoria Mist Matrix
note: A sculptural mist fountain: a black marble drum with white veining and a brass inlay ring on a polished brass toe ring, a fluted smoked-bronze column with brass collars and a warm-lit brass mist bowl. Above it three brushed-brass rings float one over another, each set with six tiny nozzle pins breathing fine mist, and a hand-blown glass orb with an amber glow drifts on top, circled by iridescent soap bubbles. The rings bob out of step and turn slowly. Tap for the densest, longest-lasting mist in the club.

name: Full-Body Holographic Rhythm-Battle Arena & VR Pod
note: A round dance stage of walnut veneer on a polished brass base, its centre an under-lit honey onyx disc ringed with brass inlay and four brass arrow inlays. Two slim brass columns carry a brass halo ring overhead with six warm spot lamps pointing in. In the middle a hologram of a squish creature made of warm gold scan-lines bounces to the beat while the arrows light in sequence, a beat ring ripples across the onyx and rhythm chevrons float up; a cream VR headset with a tan leather strap hangs on the right column.

name: Robotic Dual-Arm Cyber-Bartender & Molecular Levitating Drink Bar
note: A black lacquer bar faced with vertical brass reeding and a warm under-glow, with a black marble counter edged in brass. Behind it a pair of ivory and brass robot arms on a lacquered column work the bar: the left shakes a brass cocktail shaker in bursts, the right tips a bottle and pours into a coupe. At one end a brass levitation pad holds a sphere of cocktail floating in mid-air, wobbling, with tiny droplets orbiting it.

name: Floating Holo-Idol Stage with Backup Laser Clones for Pet
note: A pet-sized walnut stage with a brass rim hovering on magnets over a black lacquer base, warm footlights chasing along the front and two brass arcs at the back carrying little spot lamps. On it a warm gold hologram of a dancing pet bounces while two fainter rose and amber clones copy its moves a beat behind. Two pets can perform here.

name: Levitating Hydraulic Cyber-Stage with 360-Degree Hologram Deck
note: A black lacquer DJ stage banded in brass, raised off its lacquer base on brass hydraulic cylinders with chrome rods, with a dark bronze top. Two touch decks with warm gold jog rings flank the mixer, a warm under-glow spills on the floor and a dashed gold halo circles the booth. Tap the booth and a creature steps up in boss shades and a studio headset: one paw holding the ear cup, the other pumping the crowd, head bobbing to the beat while the decks spin and the EQ pumps.

name: Floating Anti-Gravity VIP Cloud Booth with Private Sound Dome
note: A floating horseshoe VIP booth in cloud-soft ivory boucle with plump stacked back cushions and two champagne silk pillows, on a brushed-brass skirt with a warm under-light line. It hovers over a polished black marble plinth edged in brass while warm cloud puffs drift beneath it. A translucent champagne-glass sound dome on brass ribs rises from the back, with a warm pendant light inside and a rim of tiny speaker lights. Pulses of light climb the ribs and the plinth glow breathes as the booth bobs. Seats five.

name: Fiber-Optic Beat-Synced Waveform Lounge Tapestry
note: A deep midnight-plum plush rug woven through with fibre-optic strands: a long audio waveform of glowing bars runs down its length in a warm gradient from rose to amber to gold, framed by two thin light lines, with cut fibre ends sparkling through the pile like stars. The waveform bars bounce to the beat, the frame lines pulse and the fibre tips twinkle.

name: Gesture-Controlled Neural Synth & Holographic Sound-Sculpting Array
note: A round walnut synth table with a brass edge on a fluted walnut pedestal and a polished brass base. A walnut-cased modular synth with a slanted black panel of brass knobs, a small amber scope and coloured patch cables sits between the two brass antennas of a theremin, an upright pitch rod and a volume loop, played by moving your paws in the air. Above the table a warm gold light-sculpture of the sound loops, turns and reshapes, with sparks drifting off it.

name: Sound-Pulsing Levitating Magnetic Lounge Pod
note: A round lounge pod in tufted cognac leather, cradled in a polished brass bowl and hovering above a walnut magnetic base with a brass band and a black onyx top that glows warm in the gap. The pod bobs gently while gold sound rings ripple out across the floor, faster when the party is on.

name: Zero-G Chill-Out Sensory Deprivation & Hydration Lounge
note: An ivory lacquer float pod: a long egg-shaped shell with a brass rim, filled with warm amber-lit water and a floating neck pillow, hovering over a black marble oval plinth with a brass edge. At the foot, a slim brass hydration stand holds a carafe of water with citrus slices and mint, and a glass. The pod bobs, the plinth glow breathes with it, slow ripples spread across the water and light shimmers on its surface.

name: Hand-Lettered Paper Banner Quote
note: A hand-lettered paper banner clipped to a twine with two wooden clothespins, with marker doodles. Write any words you like.

name: Painted Driftwood Plank Quote Sign
note: A weathered driftwood plank with distressed white painted letters and a little starfish, hanging from a jute rope. Write any words you like.

name: Script Vinyl Wall Quote Decal
note: A matte script vinyl decal with a flourish and a leaf sprig, stuck straight onto the wall. Write any words you like.

name: Brass Wire Script Wall Quote
note: Thick cut-brass script letters standing off the wall, with little sparkles running along them. Write any words you like.

name: Glowing Neon Script Wall Quote
note: Pink neon script on a clear acrylic panel with chrome standoffs. It lights up the wall and flickers now and then. Write any words you like.

name: Mirror-Polished Calacatta Gold Marble Floor
