note: Pristine showroom marble with gold inlay and a moving shine.

name: Painted Wooden 'Kitchen' Sign
note: A hand-painted pine board in soft cream, chipped to bare wood at the edges, with your word painted in barn red inside a sage border, a crossed spoon and fork and a little heart. It hangs on a red gingham ribbon tied in a bow on a nail and sways a little. Tap to change the writing.

name: Solid Oak & Carrara Marble 4-Seat Round Dining Table
note: Table only - fits 4 dining chairs (sold separately). A round table with a bullnosed Carrara marble top over a thin brass inlay ring and an oak apron, on a turned oak pedestal with four sabre feet in brass toe caps. Four places are set with gold-rimmed chargers, white plates, linen napkins, cutlery and wine glasses around a ceramic bowl of clementines between two brass candlesticks whose tapers flicker, while a soft sweep of light crosses the marble.

name: Walnut Trestle & Calacatta Marble 6-Seat Dining Table
note: Table only - fits 6 dining chairs (sold separately). A book-matched Calacatta marble slab on a walnut apron over two solid walnut trestles joined by a stretcher with wedged through-tenons. A sage linen runner carries a long walnut dough bowl of lemons, olive branches swaying in a stoneware jug, three brass candlesticks with flickering tapers, and a bottle of red with two glasses.

name: Royal Ebony & Gold-Veined Nero Marble 8-Seat Banquet Table
note: Table only - fits 8 dining chairs (sold separately). A banquet table in gloss ebony: two turned pedestals on gold bun feet with fluted shafts, gold rings and rosettes, joined by a stretcher with a gold urn finial, under an apron with gold beading and a gold band. The Nero Marquina top glows with smoky depth and fine gold veins. A burgundy velvet runner with gold borders holds two five-light gold candelabra flickering over warm pools of light, red roses in a gold urn, and champagne on ice in a silver bucket beside two coupes with rising bubbles.

name: Walnut & Linen Button-Tufted Dining Chair
note: An oiled walnut dining chair with tapered front legs in brass caps and back legs that rise into posts with turned finials. A thick linen seat with brass nailheads along the front and a button-tufted linen back with diamond pleats, in your colour. A sage silk ribbon bow with a sprig of eucalyptus is tied to the back of the top rail, its tails swaying.

name: Brushed Brass & Velvet Channel-Back Dining Chair
note: A dining chair on slim tapered brushed-brass legs and a brass seat frame, with a plump velvet seat and a tall rounded channel-back in velvet, wrapped in a brushed-brass shell. The sheen drifts slowly across the velvet as the light moves, and a glint slides down the brass legs now and then. Pick the velvet colour.

name: Royal Ebony & Gold-Leaf Tufted Velvet Dining Chair
note: A royal dining chair in gloss ebony: turned legs with gold-leaf bands and gold ball feet, a seat rail with a gold-leaf bead and rosettes, and an oval medallion back in an ebony frame with a gold-leaf ring and a little gold crown on top. The deep button-tufted velvet seat and back have gold buttons. The velvet sheen drifts and the gold leaf twinkles. Pick the velvet colour.

name: Tufted Velvet Chesterfield Sofa on Walnut Feet
note: A classic chesterfield in soft velvet with real deep buttoning across the back and inside both arms: buttons in a diamond grid, pleats folding between them and down to the seat. Rolled scroll arms, piped seat cushions, walnut bun feet on brass castors, two velvet pillows with tassels, a knit throw and an open paperback.

name: Cognac Leather Chesterfield with Brass Nailheads
note: A deep-buttoned chesterfield in pebbled cognac leather, rubbed to a warm patina on the seat fronts and scroll tops, with soft creases where you sit. Dark welts with cream saddle stitching, brass nailheads, turned walnut bun feet, tartan pillows, a red tartan wool throw over one arm and a gilt-banded leather book with reading glasses on the other.

name: Ivory Bouclé Channel-Tufted Sofa on a Calacatta Marble Plinth
note: An ivory channel-tufted sofa in nubby bouclé on a Calacatta marble plinth with grey and gold veins and a brushed brass band. Mustard velvet pillows, a fluffy sheepskin over one arm and a travertine tray with a lit candle and matches on the other.

name: Royal Velvet & Gold-Leaf Grand Chesterfield
note: A grand four-seat chesterfield in crushed royal velvet with deep tufting, gold piping and gold nailheads, on a gold-leaf apron with bullion fringe and gilded bun feet. A carved gilt shell crest with acanthus scrolls crowns the back; gold damask pillows and an emerald bolster embroidered with a crown and gold tassels.

name: Chalk Hopscotch Court
note: A clean chalk hopscotch court on concrete: numbered squares 1 to 10 in bright chalk colours and a HOME arc. Needs 3 players: one hops, one tosses the stone, one waits, in a 2-minute loop.

name: Driveway Basketball Hoop
note: A driveway hoop: steel pole, glass backboard with the red square, orange rim and white net over a concrete court with a key. Needs 3 players for a 2-minute pickup game that loops.

name: Backyard Soccer Goal
note: A regulation-style white goal with a full net, back stanchions and painted box lines on striped turf. Needs 3 players (a keeper and two strikers): they dribble, pass and shoot into the net in a 2-minute match that loops.

name: Round Sport Trampoline with Safety Pad
Chunky ABC Building Blocks
note: Chunky beech toy blocks with painted borders and embossed letters, numbers, stars and hearts on every face, a little chipped from play. Four stacked in a wobbly tower and two loose ones on the floor.

name: Colour-Picker LED Strip Cove Kit
note: An LED strip hidden in a wall cove washes the wall with colour. Pick a colour set and a pattern.

name: Layered LED Pixel Wall with Custom Patterns
Tri-Layer Halo Ring & Beam Light Rig
Multi-Layer Laser, Halo & Pixel Light Show
note: A truss arch with a pixel wall, three halo rings and four sweeping laser heads, all in one colour set and pattern.

name: Handwritten Cardboard Sign Taped to the Wall
Gilded Rococo Marble Coffee Table with Crystal Decanters
note: A gilded rococo coffee table: an oval white marble top over a gold-leaf apron carved with C-scrolls and bead rows, on fluted cabriole legs. A cut-crystal carafe of water and two tumblers with ice and lemon on a gold tray, a vase of layered roses with buds, leaves and baby’s breath, and a leather book with a gilt title.

name: Royal Patisserie Display Case with Cakes, Macarons & Croissants
note: Royal Collection: the most expensive piece in this room. An ivory lacquer cabinet with fluted doors, champagne-gold knobs and gold bun feet under a glass case with slim gold posts, a mirrored back and warm lights that breathe. Inside: a strawberry fraisier, a chocolate opera cake with gold leaf, a lemon meringue tart and a raspberry dome below, and a pyramid of pastel macarons, eclairs and fruit tartlets on the glass shelf. On the Calacatta top: a three-tier cake on a gold stand under a crystal dome, a twinkling gold crowned Pâtisserie Royale crest, a basket of steaming croissants and a gold service bell.

name: Royal Cinema Seats
note: Three crimson velvet cinema seats with tall arched channel-tufted backs framed in gold, padded arms on mahogany with gold medallions, on a mahogany step with little floor lights. Gold cup holders hold a soda and a gold tub of popcorn.

name: Gilded Grand Cinema Popcorn Carriage
note: A gilded royal popcorn carriage: burgundy panels with gold scrollwork and crowns, gold spoked wheels, twisted gold columns, a marquee roof and sign ringed with bulbs and a velvet crown on top. Tap it: the bulbs chase, the copper kettle rocks and popcorn bursts out.
playS: Bulbs chasing · kettle popping… tap to stop
